cobblemon.species.relicbudew.name: RelicBudew
cobblemon.species.relicbudew.desc: Relic Budew appreciates the traditional aspects of warfare, and despite its young age, enjoys an entertaining duel. It claps on the victor using the buds on its head.
cobblemon.species.relicroselia.name: RelicRoselia
cobblemon.species.relicroselia.desc: A warrior in training, Roselia hone their skills, becoming fearsome despite their short size. They are known for their excellent offensive and defensive capabilities.
cobblemon.species.relicroserade.name: RelicRoserade
cobblemon.species.relicroserade.desc: Ho-OH's ashes caused rapiers to grow out of Relic Roserade's flower buds. It will only take off its mask to a dying opponent and hides its identity at all other times.
cobblemon.species.relicspinda.name: RelicSpinda
cobblemon.species.relicspinda.desc: By the grace of Ho-Oh’s ashes, Spinda walked the wheel of life and attained enlightenment. Strategists and sages alike sought out its guidance.
cobblemon.species.relickoffing.name: RelicKoffing
cobblemon.species.relickoffing.desc: After being touched by Ho-Oh's ashes Koffing used the gas inside itself to become a combustion engine. The gas inside its body is reportedly similar to rocket fuel.
cobblemon.species.relicweezing.name: RelicWeezing
cobblemon.species.relicweezing.desc: Supposedly, Relic Weezing have the explosive force of a thermobaric bomb. However, being planted to the ground, it finds catching prey difficult.
cobblemon.species.relicskiddo.name: RelicSkiddo
cobblemon.species.relicskiddo.desc: Locals in the surrounding area noticed that Relic Skiddo had reemerged, as many of the trees in the forest had been rammed down. This means a Skiddo is about to evolve, and wants to hone its skills.
cobblemon.species.relicgogoat.name: RelicGogoat
cobblemon.species.relicgogoat.desc: Relic Gogoat’s DNA was altered, and rocky outcrops grew all over its body. Old records tell of a mounted Relic Gogoat ending a month-long siege in a matter of seconds, by turning the castle gates to splinters with a full-speed horn bash. No momentum was lost.
cobblemon.species.relicaipom.name: RelicAipom
cobblemon.species.relicaipom.desc: Relic Aipom are known for their throwing skills. Trees, and occasionally an unfortunate Trevenant, are their usual targets for practice.
cobblemon.species.relicambipom.name: RelicAmbipom
cobblemon.species.relicambipom.desc: Ho-Oh’s ashes awakened Ambipom’s hidden martial spirit. Its karate chops are said to crush a steel cuirass like paper.
cobblemon.species.relictentacool.name: RelicTentacool
cobblemon.species.relictentacool.desc: Relic Tentacool's Source of power is the orb it holds in its tentacles. It is incredibly vulnerable without the orb, so it will defend it with its life.
cobblemon.species.relictentacruel.name: RelicTentacruel
cobblemon.species.relictentacruel.desc: Exposed to Ho-Oh’s ashes, its brain grew and reshaped its head, causing it to resemble a steepled hat. It magnifies its power with an orb plucked from a Staryu.
cobblemon.species.relicledyba.name: RelicLedyba
cobblemon.species.relicledyba.desc: Relic Ledyba are often seen training with a Relic Ledian counterpart. It is said that they form close bonds with their mentors, and gift them with tarts made of Combee honey to gain favour.
cobblemon.species.relicledian.name: RelicLedian
cobblemon.species.relicledian.desc: In exchange for their ability to fly, Ledian were gifted steel armor to battle along side their human comrades. Relic Ledian seem to have a strong sense of justice and protect those weaker than themselves.
cobblemon.species.relicflabebe.name: RelicFlabebe
cobblemon.species.relicflabebe.desc: Relic Flabébé can only be seen by those whom have had a near death experience, hence their late discovery.
cobblemon.species.relicfloette.name: RelicFloette
cobblemon.species.relicfloette.desc: Relic Floette gather around hospitals to herd the newly departed. They seem to work as assistants for the Relic Florges in the area.
cobblemon.species.relicflorges.name: RelicFlorges
cobblemon.species.deltabulbasaur.name: DeltaBulbasaur
cobblemon.species.deltabulbasaur.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. The crystal growing from its back uses its mental energy to grow.
cobblemon.species.deltaivysaur.name: DeltaIvysaur
cobblemon.species.deltaivysaur.desc: Its body naturally changes in order to help counteract the crystal's growing weight. Its crystal resonates with increased brain activity.
cobblemon.species.deltavenusaur.name: DeltaVenusaur
cobblemon.species.deltavenusaur.desc: In order to increase its psychic powers, a shard of its crystal is embedded in its forehead. Even when it sleeps, its crystal is capable of providing protection.
cobblemon.species.deltacharmander.name: DeltaCharmander
cobblemon.species.deltacharmander.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. While the flame on its tail does not appear immediately after its birth, it burns more fiercely with age.
cobblemon.species.deltacharmeleon.name: DeltaCharmeleon
cobblemon.species.deltacharmeleon.desc: Its claws tear into its foe's spirit. When facing powerful opponents, the flame on its tail gives off the appearance of a face.
cobblemon.species.deltacharizard.name: DeltaCharizard
cobblemon.species.deltacharizard.desc: The flame on its tail grows in the presence of strong opponents. Its breath gives the impression of being engulfed in magma but causes no physical harm.
cobblemon.species.deltasquirtle.name: DeltaSquirtle
cobblemon.species.deltasquirtle.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. Though its shell causes it to stand out when hiding in the shadows, it conceals itself using the cloth on its back.
cobblemon.species.deltawartortle.name: DeltaWartortle
cobblemon.species.deltawartortle.desc: Its tail splits to better conceal the back of its shell while it waits for foes. Its gloves help better channel its inner spirit energy.
cobblemon.species.deltablastoise.name: DeltaBlastoise
cobblemon.species.deltablastoise.desc: Though its shell now blends in with the darkness, it welcomes foolish opponents who attack it from behind. It concentrates its spirit into blasts of energy.
cobblemon.species.deltapidgey.name: DeltaPidgey
cobblemon.species.deltapidgey.desc: A Delta Species discovered by RuneBlad3. It uses its piercing gaze to petrify foes and then perches on top of their immobile bodies.
cobblemon.species.deltapidgeotto.name: DeltaPidgeotto
cobblemon.species.deltapidgeotto.desc: This Pokemon stealthily creeps around caves and labyrinths, hoping to catch intruders off guard with its glare. It avoids mirrors and pools of water at all costs.
cobblemon.species.deltapidgeot.name: DeltaPidgeot
cobblemon.species.deltapidgeot.desc: A living creature that looks directly into this Pokemon's eyes will be turned to stone. It breaks off very small pieces of its victims to help digest food.
cobblemon.species.deltapikachu.name: DeltaPikachu
cobblemon.species.deltapikachu.desc: When preparing for lift-off, it winds up its tail dozens of times. When it releases its tail, it experiences a tremendous burst of speed and soars into the air.
cobblemon.species.deltaraichu.name: DeltaRaichu
cobblemon.species.deltaraichu.desc: Flying at high speeds have led to it losing most of its hair. Despite gaining weight due to its obsession with pancakes, it darts around in the air faster than a jet.
cobblemon.species.deltadiglett.name: DeltaDiglett
cobblemon.species.deltadiglett.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zazulitao. As it prefers to create tunnels within the snow, it is common for explorers to fall into the holes that it creates.
cobblemon.species.deltadugtrio.name: DeltaDugtrio
cobblemon.species.deltadugtrio.desc: Since the triplets think exactly alike, they can work together to avoid producing avalanches. This no longer applies when one of them falls asleep.
cobblemon.species.deltagrowlithe.name: DeltaGrowlithe
cobblemon.species.deltagrowlithe.desc: A Delta Species discovered by LunarDusk. They are fiercely loyal to reputable trainers and those of high status.
cobblemon.species.deltaarcanine.name: DeltaArcanine
cobblemon.species.deltaarcanine.desc: If placed in front of castles or temples, this Pokemon will watch the entrance without moving. Its strength is determined by its claws, teeth, and eyes.
cobblemon.species.deltatentacool.name: DeltaTentacool
cobblemon.species.deltatentacool.desc: A Delta Species discovered by xxxHexxxx. Foes grabbed by its tentacles are slowly drained of their strength while succumbing to its poison.
cobblemon.species.deltatentacruel.name: DeltaTentacruel
cobblemon.species.deltatentacruel.desc: It is seldom seen except when disposing of the remains of carcasses. The sacs on its head produce more poison when it senses a foe nearby.
cobblemon.species.deltageodude.name: DeltaGeodude
cobblemon.species.deltageodude.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. They are easily mistaken for parts of ruins and may surprise travelers attempting to use them for a bench.
cobblemon.species.deltagraveler.name: DeltaGraveler
cobblemon.species.deltagraveler.desc: They station themselves among ruins and act as guardians. Despite rarely moving, they quickly rush across the ground to drive away intruders who bring ill will.
cobblemon.species.deltagolem.name: DeltaGolem
cobblemon.species.deltagolem.desc: Despite possessing no discernible organs, it moves with both a mind and will of its own. It can sense trespassers from the heart of its living space.
cobblemon.species.deltadoduo.name: DeltaDoduo
cobblemon.species.deltadoduo.desc: A Delta Species discovered by TheTurtleScream. Though it possesses two independent brains, one brain will always inevitably usurp control over the other.
cobblemon.species.deltadodrio.name: DeltaDodrio
cobblemon.species.deltadodrio.desc: Even while aware of mind control, the three heads are cooperative with one another. As one head falls asleep, another awakens and becomes the manipulator.
cobblemon.species.deltagrimer.name: DeltaGrimer
cobblemon.species.deltagrimer.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. With sand absorbed into its circulation, it can vanish into surrounding sand to escape from predators.
cobblemon.species.deltamuk.name: DeltaMuk
cobblemon.species.deltamuk.desc: It puts anything it finds in its massive mouth and hunts smaller Pokemon as prey. It tracks sand everywhere it goes, making it tedious to care for indoors.
cobblemon.species.deltakoffing.name: DeltaKoffing
cobblemon.species.deltakoffing.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zero_Breaker. It discharges electricity when hit physically. It uses this as a defensive mechanism against predators.
cobblemon.species.deltaweezing.name: DeltaWeezing
cobblemon.species.deltaweezing.desc: The sound it makes when dispensing electricity has been compared to a lightning bolt striking nearby.
cobblemon.species.deltatangela.name: DeltaTangela
cobblemon.species.deltatangela.desc: A Delta Species discovered by winkright. It lures prey towards its home in the earth before grabbing and pinning them.
cobblemon.species.deltascyther.name: DeltaScyther
cobblemon.species.deltascyther.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. Its scythes are immensely sharp but also very fragile, and can easily be shattered when hit from the side.
cobblemon.species.deltaelectabuzz.name: DeltaElectabuzz
cobblemon.species.deltaelectabuzz.desc: After midnight they can be seen congregating on rooftops. However, they always make sure to return to their original positions before morning.
cobblemon.species.deltamagmar.name: DeltaMagmar
cobblemon.species.deltamagmar.desc: It can now breath underwater using the oxygen in the tank on its back. It returns to the surface once per week in order to refuel.
cobblemon.species.deltaditto.name: DeltaDitto
cobblemon.species.deltaditto.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. When rearranging its cell structure to transform itself, it sometimes makes a mistake and becomes a different type.
cobblemon.species.deltakabuto.name: DeltaKabuto
cobblemon.species.deltakabuto.desc: A Delta Species discovered by PokeNerd123. Though they buzz harmlessly when alone, a swarm can decimate a city's worth of crops within minutes.
cobblemon.species.deltakabutops.name: DeltaKabutops
cobblemon.species.deltakabutops.desc: This Pokemon's changes during evolution led to it becoming a carnivore instead of an herbivore. It hovers above trees in search of prey.
cobblemon.species.deltasnorlax.name: DeltaSnorlax
cobblemon.species.deltasnorlax.desc: Trees and plants tend to grow on this Pokemon’s back because it moves so little. It loves eating food while playing with tiny Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.deltadratini.name: DeltaDratini
cobblemon.species.deltadratini.desc: A Delta Species discovered by PokeNerd123. Because its body constantly releases electrical energy, it prefers to hide within the depths of the ocean.
cobblemon.species.deltadragonair.name: DeltaDragonair
cobblemon.species.deltadragonair.desc: Having better control over its power, it can sometimes be seen peeking above the ocean surface. If it sneezes, it looses a massive discharge of electricity.
cobblemon.species.deltadragonite.name: DeltaDragonite
cobblemon.species.deltadragonite.desc: A courageous and kind Pokemon, it braves storms to lead shipwrecked crews to land. It can travel underwater at a speed of 400 knots.
cobblemon.species.deltacyndaquil.name: DeltaCyndaquil
cobblemon.species.deltacyndaquil.desc: A Delta Species discovered by 1ofthe4rocketbros. When placed in darkness, it will automatically generate more and more electricity from its tesla coil.
cobblemon.species.deltaquilava.name: DeltaQuilava
cobblemon.species.deltaquilava.desc: Its DNA continuously changes and reconstructs its body into a machine. As it becomes more dependent on electricity, it makes its home in power plants.
cobblemon.species.deltatyphlosion.name: DeltaTyphlosion
cobblemon.species.deltatyphlosion.desc: On stormy nights it ventures outdoors and pulsates in response to lightning strikes. When calm, it can induce macroshock in humans from 100 feet away.
cobblemon.species.deltahoothoot.name: DeltaHoothoot
cobblemon.species.deltahoothoot.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Aboodie. Its ears are sensitive enough to hear a snowflake fall upon the snow on the ground from across the forest.
cobblemon.species.deltanoctowl.name: DeltaNoctowl
cobblemon.species.deltanoctowl.desc: Rather than flee from physical attacks, at times it will stare down the opponent's attack head on, startling them, and then freezing them to the bone.
cobblemon.species.deltachinchou.name: DeltaChinchou
cobblemon.species.deltachinchou.desc: A Delta Species discovered by CommanderPhoenix. When it senses danger, it emits bright flames and fades into the shadows.
cobblemon.species.deltalanturn.name: DeltaLanturn
cobblemon.species.deltalanturn.desc: The flames it produces are extraordinarily hot. Due to its reclusive nature, lost travelers that stumble upon it may mistake its presence for the gateway to hell.
cobblemon.species.deltapichu.name: DeltaPichu
cobblemon.species.deltapichu.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. As it is still inept at flying, it practices gliding from high altitudes at incredible speed.
cobblemon.species.deltaaipom.name: DeltaAipom
cobblemon.species.deltaaipom.desc: A Delta Species discovered by SixteenDraws and EchoTheThird. It sneakily places the end of its tail on people's shoulders, making others wonder if they saw a white hand.
cobblemon.species.deltasunkern.name: DeltaSunkern
cobblemon.species.deltasunkern.desc: A Delta Species discovered by DankRabbit and EchoTheThird. It is able to emit a purple fire that poisons its enemies.
cobblemon.species.deltasunflora.name: DeltaSunflora
cobblemon.species.deltasunflora.desc: Sunflora convert fire and poison into nutrition. It purges its enemy's uncleanliness with fire.
cobblemon.species.deltayanma.name: DeltaYanma
cobblemon.species.deltayanma.desc: A Delta Species discovered by SapphirePhoenix. Though it specializes in camouflage, it is also a great flier capable of quickly chasing down lured prey.
cobblemon.species.deltawooper.name: DeltaWooper
cobblemon.species.deltawooper.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. This mischievous Pokemon likes to surprise people on Halloween with tons of candy.
cobblemon.species.deltaquagsire.name: DeltaQuagsire
cobblemon.species.deltaquagsire.desc: Despite its appearance, this Delta Species is kind to every Pokemon it meets. It glows with Halloween spirit.
cobblemon.species.deltamisdreavus.name: DeltaMisdreavus
cobblemon.species.deltamisdreavus.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. This Pokemon does its best to bring everyone into the holiday spirit. It's only happy when everyone else is.
cobblemon.species.deltagirafarig.name: DeltaGirafarig
cobblemon.species.deltagirafarig.desc: A Delta Species discovered by nico. The tail's insults temper the Pokemon's iron will, becoming stronger as the Pokemon grows.
cobblemon.species.deltadunsparce.name: DeltaDunsparce
cobblemon.species.deltadunsparce.desc: A Delta Species discovered by LunarDusk. Despite having a menacing appearance, it is quite friendly and skates across ponds' surfaces.
cobblemon.species.deltascizor.name: DeltaScizor
cobblemon.species.deltascizor.desc: Its exoskeleton is coated with a thick layer of ice. The layer of ice reforms once per year.
cobblemon.species.deltashuckle.name: DeltaShuckle
cobblemon.species.deltashuckle.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zazulitao. Every punch that it takes causes its crank to turn; when its limit is reached, it bashes into foes with its head.
cobblemon.species.deltaremoraid.name: DeltaRemoraid
cobblemon.species.deltaremoraid.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Missingo_OP. The farther it goes away from pools of lava, the more rapidly the magma on its head cools down and hardens.
cobblemon.species.deltaoctillery.name: DeltaOctillery
cobblemon.species.deltaoctillery.desc: It hides its tentacles behind its beard-like smokescreen and attacks without warning. Against stronger foes, it will grab them and submerge them in lava.
cobblemon.species.deltaelekid.name: DeltaElekid
cobblemon.species.deltaelekid.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Ubodot. Though it tries to remain as still as possible around humans, it cannot withstand heavy rain, causing it to flee indoors.
cobblemon.species.deltamagby.name: DeltaMagby
cobblemon.species.deltamagby.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Ubodot. Though it is a Water-type Pokemon, it is incapable of breathing underwater and aims to hold its breath longer everyday.
cobblemon.species.deltatreecko.name: DeltaTreecko
cobblemon.species.deltatreecko.desc: A Delta Species discovered by SixteenDraws. It takes up residence within dojos where it trains against humans and Pokemon alike.
cobblemon.species.deltagrovyle.name: DeltaGrovyle
cobblemon.species.deltagrovyle.desc: As its skill grows, so does its fighting spirit. Its strength is great enough to stand on par with black belts.
cobblemon.species.deltasceptile.name: DeltaSceptile
cobblemon.species.deltasceptile.desc: After becoming a master of its dojo, it begins to regain its primal instincts. Its draconic traits cause it to have no equal within the karate world.
cobblemon.species.deltatorchic.name: DeltaTorchic
cobblemon.species.deltatorchic.desc: A Delta Species discovered by NoNameDummy. From birth it has the ability to give orders to other wild Pokemon and have them obey without question.
cobblemon.species.deltacombusken.name: DeltaCombusken
cobblemon.species.deltacombusken.desc: It lazes about while giving its underlings commands. Its power is believed by some to have been bestowed upon it by gods of unknown origin.
cobblemon.species.deltablaziken.name: DeltaBlaziken
cobblemon.species.deltablaziken.desc: It soars to amazing heights, storing power that it draws from the sun. Even when it cannot be seen from the ground below, it keeps a watchful eye on those it protects.
cobblemon.species.deltalotad.name: DeltaLotad
cobblemon.species.deltalotad.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Kalorian. It is known to entertain small Pokemon by performing magic tricks for them.
cobblemon.species.deltalombre.name: DeltaLombre
cobblemon.species.deltalombre.desc: From morning until night, it trains and practices its magic. During the evening it puts on magic shows for large crowds.
cobblemon.species.deltaludicolo.name: DeltaLudicolo
cobblemon.species.deltaludicolo.desc: Its knowledge and strength make it a common source of advice for its community. It produces massive barriers to protect those important to it.
cobblemon.species.deltaseedot.name: DeltaSeedot
cobblemon.species.deltaseedot.desc: A Delta Species discovered by SketchyGamer. Its face flashes at varying frequencies depending on its mood at time.
cobblemon.species.deltanuzleaf.name: DeltaNuzleaf
cobblemon.species.deltanuzleaf.desc: Though it has a cloud around its waist, it is still too heavy to levitate. It clings to its cloud desperately whenever someone gets too close to it.
cobblemon.species.deltashiftry.name: DeltaShiftry
cobblemon.species.deltashiftry.desc: It is said to appear suddenly during thunderstorms. When it needs to feed, it will insert its arms into electrical outlets.
cobblemon.species.deltaralts.name: DeltaRalts
cobblemon.species.deltaralts.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird and Zero_Breaker. It uses its own ice and electricity to help make its trainer's life easier.
cobblemon.species.deltakirlia.name: DeltaKirlia
cobblemon.species.deltakirlia.desc: This Pokemon loves dancing to swing music. As it grows more excited from dancing, it generates sparks and snow begins to fall within the surrounding area.
cobblemon.species.deltagardevoir.name: DeltaGardevoir
cobblemon.species.deltagardevoir.desc: To protect its trainer, it can drop the temperature of itself and its surroundings to 0°K. It discharges sparks when nuzzling trainers to keep them from freezing.
cobblemon.species.deltasableye.name: DeltaSableye
cobblemon.species.deltasableye.desc: A Delta Species discovered by SketchyGamer. It digs deep holes into the earth in search of charcoal and molten rocks, which it uses for food.
cobblemon.species.deltamawile.name: DeltaMawile
cobblemon.species.deltamawile.desc: A Delta Species discovered by spimission. Luring foes with its innocence and sweet appearance, it devours them and sends nutrients through the vines on its head.
cobblemon.species.deltaaron.name: DeltaAron
cobblemon.species.deltaaron.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Draexzhan. Cracks in its armor allow more and more flames to escape as it takes damage.
cobblemon.species.deltalairon.name: DeltaLairon
cobblemon.species.deltalairon.desc: A territorial Pokemon that defends its land by releasing bursts of flames from within its armor. Deafening explosions can be heard when it collides with objects.
cobblemon.species.deltaaggron.name: DeltaAggron
cobblemon.species.deltaaggron.desc: It aggressively pursues stronger opponents each and every day. The gouges in its armor generate more flames and allow it to boast more of its strength.
cobblemon.species.deltameditite.name: DeltaMeditite
cobblemon.species.deltameditite.desc: A Delta Species discovered by ensentiumseraph. Its powerful, goat-like legs allow it to scale steep mountain walls with little to no difficulty.
cobblemon.species.deltamedicham.name: DeltaMedicham
cobblemon.species.deltamedicham.desc: A deep love for nature runs through this Pokemon's veins. It will immediately begin dancing to music featuring pipes or cymbals.
cobblemon.species.deltaplusle.name: DeltaPlusle
cobblemon.species.deltaplusle.desc: A Delta Species discovered by powerpow. It is cheerful and warms up its friends using its fiery power.
cobblemon.species.deltaminun.name: DeltaMinun
cobblemon.species.deltaminun.desc: A Delta Species discovered by powerpow. It is quite jovial and cools down its friends using its icy power.
cobblemon.species.deltaroselia.name: DeltaRoselia
cobblemon.species.deltaroselia.desc: This Pokemon can be found on clear nights, dancing before the moon. If discovered, it puts onlookers to resting and flees into the shadows.
cobblemon.species.deltawailmer.name: DeltaWailmer
cobblemon.species.deltawailmer.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. Currently, it is still unknown how this Pokemon manages to keep itself in the air despite its weight.
cobblemon.species.deltawailord.name: DeltaWailord
cobblemon.species.deltawailord.desc: Hail falls over the land below as this Pokemon flies. It is suspected that the phrase 'the sky is falling' originated due to its shadow blanketing the ground.
cobblemon.species.deltanumel.name: DeltaNumel
cobblemon.species.deltanumel.desc: A Delta Species discovered by bradleyinabox. The first of its kind was known to have appeared at the ground zero of a nuclear explosion.
cobblemon.species.deltacamerupt.name: DeltaCamerupt
cobblemon.species.deltacamerupt.desc: This Pokemon feeds on nuclear radiation. It has been shown that atoms within its vicinity become more and more unstable as its temper reaches its peak.
cobblemon.species.deltafeebas.name: DeltaFeebas
cobblemon.species.deltafeebas.desc: A Delta Species discovered by 1ofthe4rocketbros. Though it desires to scare strangers, it is timid and oftentimes ends up frightening itself instead.
cobblemon.species.deltamilotic.name: DeltaMilotic
cobblemon.species.deltamilotic.desc: It is known to lurk within graveyards. Memories from the life of its skeleton inspire it to ruthlessly protect a worthy master.
cobblemon.species.deltasnorunt.name: DeltaSnorunt
cobblemon.species.deltasnorunt.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. It is said that this Pokemon helps to guard volcanoes and deep caves from intruders.
cobblemon.species.deltaglalie.name: DeltaGlalie
cobblemon.species.deltaglalie.desc: This Pokemon has the power to evaporate entire oceans with a single breath.
cobblemon.species.deltaclamperl.name: DeltaClamperl
cobblemon.species.deltaclamperl.desc: A Delta Species discovered by yungbro. It catches prey in its jaws by pretending to be an unassuming shellfish.
cobblemon.species.deltahuntail.name: DeltaHuntail
cobblemon.species.deltahuntail.desc: A savage creature which prefers to live in solitude within dark caves. If another organism ventures into its domain, it will assault them relentlessly.
cobblemon.species.deltagorebyss.name: DeltaGorebyss
cobblemon.species.deltagorebyss.desc: A friendly creature which prefers to share its living space with other cave-dwelling Pokemon. It prefers the warmth of tropical climates.
cobblemon.species.deltaspiderbeldum.name: DeltaSpiderBeldum
cobblemon.species.deltaspiderbeldum.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zero_Breaker. It builds webs in trees, ensnaring prey, and then subdues them with its venom.
cobblemon.species.deltaspidermetang.name: DeltaSpiderMetang
cobblemon.species.deltaspidermetang.desc: The string it produces is both unnaturally thin and impossibly strong. Clothing weaved together using its silk is flexible yet stronger than titanium.
cobblemon.species.deltaspidermetagross.d: Rather than resorting to capturing prey using webs, it resorts to other trickery. Foes entering its domain may see it as a tiger, a demon, or a giant spider.
cobblemon.species.deltaruinbeldum.name: DeltaRuinBeldum
cobblemon.species.deltaruinbeldum.desc: A Delta Species discovered by LunarDusk and Cowctus. It is said that beneath its rough exterior exists a crystal shard of unimaginable value.
cobblemon.species.deltaruinmetang.name: DeltaRuinMetang
cobblemon.species.deltaruinmetang.desc: As multiple altered Beldums come into contact with each other, their crystals resonate, causing their cores to fuse. They then reconstruct into a single entity.
cobblemon.species.deltaruinmetagross.des: After two altered Metang fuse into this Pokemon, all but the exterior of its body is composed of crystal. Additional crystals allow it to break free of its rocky shell.
cobblemon.species.deltaregirock.name: DeltaRegirock
cobblemon.species.deltaregirock.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Lucci85. Being made of sand, it can easily replenish itself and in some cases ward off Water-type attacks with ease.
cobblemon.species.deltaregice.name: DeltaRegice
cobblemon.species.deltaregice.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Lucci85. Though its entire body is composed of water, it is unable to alter its molecules into that of a gas or a solid.
cobblemon.species.deltaregisteel.name: DeltaRegisteel
cobblemon.species.deltaregisteel.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Lucci85. Its emergence from pools of magma is said to be blinding due to its core glowing with extreme heat.
cobblemon.species.deltaturtwig.name: DeltaTurtwig
cobblemon.species.deltaturtwig.desc: A Delta Species discovered by NoNameDummy. Made from sand, the shell on its back hardens as it floats along the ocean's surface. As it dives, the shell softens.
cobblemon.species.deltagrotle.name: DeltaGrotle
cobblemon.species.deltagrotle.desc: It lives along the water's surface in oceans. During the day, it dives underwater regularly to refresh the sea life taking shelter on its back.
cobblemon.species.deltatorterra.name: DeltaTorterra
cobblemon.species.deltatorterra.desc: As it moves in the ocean continuously, pirates store their loot in its back for safekeeping. It oftentimes participates in treasure hunts for younger Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.deltashinx.name: DeltaShinx
cobblemon.species.deltashinx.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. A single scratch from it is toxic enough to faint targets as it flees into the wild.
cobblemon.species.deltaluxio.name: DeltaLuxio
cobblemon.species.deltaluxio.desc: This Pokemon's poison is potent enough to cause fainting just from standing downwind of it.
cobblemon.species.deltaluxray.name: DeltaLuxray
cobblemon.species.deltaluxray.desc: One drop of its venom is potent enough to incapacitate 2000 Rattata.
cobblemon.species.deltabudew.name: DeltaBudew
cobblemon.species.deltabudew.desc: A Delta Species discovered by 1ofthe4rocketbros and EchoTheThird. It hides itself from the sun during the day and stares longingly at the moon at night.
cobblemon.species.deltaroserade.name: DeltaRoserade
cobblemon.species.deltaroserade.desc: Its fans are capable of whipping up vicious gales. Though shy, it will become aggressive if its dance is interrupted.
cobblemon.species.deltacombee.name: DeltaCombee
cobblemon.species.deltacombee.desc: A Delta Species discovered by LunarDusk. The middle body hosts a reactor; it uses this to power up its Fire-type moves.
cobblemon.species.deltavespiquen.name: DeltaVespiquen
cobblemon.species.deltavespiquen.desc: It hovers in the air with electromagnetic force produced from its reactor. If it doesn't consume enough food for fuel, it will be unable to fly.
cobblemon.species.deltaambipom.name: DeltaAmbipom
cobblemon.species.deltaambipom.desc: It plays pranks by frightening people with its detachable head. If its spirit leaves its body, its body is left without arms.
cobblemon.species.deltadrifloon.name: DeltaDrifloon
cobblemon.species.deltadrifloon.desc: A Delta Species discovered by yungbro. It is formed by the passionate spirits of people and Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.deltadrifblim.name: DeltaDrifblim
cobblemon.species.deltadrifblim.desc: Though it is drowsy during the daytime, it flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
cobblemon.species.deltabuneary.name: DeltaBuneary
cobblemon.species.deltabuneary.desc: A Delta Species discovered by nico. It uses its techniques to rob the weak, causing its parents to scold it constantly.
cobblemon.species.deltalopunny.name: DeltaLopunny
cobblemon.species.deltalopunny.desc: Having found inner peace, it fights for the future. As a parent, it never seems to be able to take its eyes off of its mischievous children.
cobblemon.species.deltamismagius.name: DeltaMismagius
cobblemon.species.deltamismagius.desc: This Pokemon loves making snow-ghosts with humans. It has an unquenchable love for the holidays.
cobblemon.species.deltamunchlax.name: DeltaMunchlax
cobblemon.species.deltamunchlax.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Sparrows413. This Pokemon lays in the fields all day after eating, absorbing nutrients from the sun.
cobblemon.species.deltariolu.name: DeltaRiolu
cobblemon.species.deltariolu.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Ubodot. It practices sanitizing and preserving the bodies of the deceased, showing them one final formAspects of respect.
cobblemon.species.deltalucario.name: DeltaLucario
cobblemon.species.deltalucario.desc: The afterlife and rebirth of souls are sacred to this Pokemon. It will fiercely guard any tomb or cemetery that it comes across from graverobbers.
cobblemon.species.deltacroagunk.name: DeltaCroagunk
cobblemon.species.deltacroagunk.desc: A Delta Species discovered by pokefan1241. Its cheeks hold large amounts of fire. It generates thick smog to sneak up behind its opponents and attack them.
cobblemon.species.deltatoxicroak.name: DeltaToxicroak
cobblemon.species.deltatoxicroak.desc: Its knuckles generate flames so intense that they can be used as fiery knives. Stabbing with these flames can easily melt holes in steel.
cobblemon.species.deltatangrowth.name: DeltaTangrowth
cobblemon.species.deltatangrowth.desc: A vicious Pokemon which spreads its tendrils beneath the ground, ensnaring unsuspecting trespassers. It uses their cries for help to lure more prey.
cobblemon.species.deltaelectivire.name: DeltaElectivire
cobblemon.species.deltaelectivire.desc: After midnight they can be seen congregating on rooftops. However, they always make sure to return to their original positions before morning.
cobblemon.species.deltamagmortar.name: DeltaMagmortar
cobblemon.species.deltamagmortar.desc: With additional armor, this Pokemon can easily endure pressures at the bottom of the ocean. Its cannons serve as defense from lurking dangerous opponents.
cobblemon.species.deltayanmega.name: DeltaYanmega
cobblemon.species.deltayanmega.desc: Using its wings to generate massive gusts, it blends in with surrounding foliage and tricks prey into seeking shelter beneath its leaves.
cobblemon.species.deltagallade.name: DeltaGallade
cobblemon.species.deltagallade.desc: A master swordfighter, it uses both Electric- and Ice-type attacks to defeat opponents. Over time it numbs its opponents and decreases their reaction speeds.
cobblemon.species.deltafroslass.name: DeltaFroslass
cobblemon.species.deltafroslass.desc: This Pokemon has the power to evaporate entire oceans with a single breath.
cobblemon.species.deltasnivy.name: DeltaSnivy
cobblemon.species.deltasnivy.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Aboodie. They usually formAspects small colonies in the midst of raging seas, where they are protected from predators.
cobblemon.species.deltaservine.name: DeltaServine
cobblemon.species.deltaservine.desc: Despite rarely coming up above the water's surface, on rainy days they use the cover of clouds to laze about on rocks and take in the fresh sea air.
cobblemon.species.deltaserperior.name: DeltaSerperior
cobblemon.species.deltaserperior.desc: Though they viciously protect their domains from outsiders, they admire and welcome the company of trainers who brave the oceans to meet them.
cobblemon.species.deltapurrloin.name: DeltaPurrloin
cobblemon.species.deltapurrloin.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zero_Breaker. This Pokemon wanders the city streets while scaring people with its illusions.
cobblemon.species.deltaliepard.name: DeltaLiepard
cobblemon.species.deltaliepard.desc: This Pokemon makes use of illusions and trickery to catch its prey.
cobblemon.species.deltavenipede.name: DeltaVenipede
cobblemon.species.deltavenipede.desc: A Delta Species discovered by DankRabbit. It is highly aggressive and will attempt to set its surroundings on fire when agitated.
cobblemon.species.deltawhirlipede.name: DeltaWhirlipede
cobblemon.species.deltawhirlipede.desc: Though it prefers to remain still and blend in with its surroundings, when threatened it bursts forward at high speed and then crashes into its opponent explosively.
cobblemon.species.deltascolipede.name: DeltaScolipede
cobblemon.species.deltascolipede.desc: Though it prefers to remain still and blend in with its surroundings, when threatened it bursts forward at high speed and then crashes into its opponent explosively.
cobblemon.species.deltawaterpetilil.name: DeltaWaterPetilil
cobblemon.species.deltawaterpetilil.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Steads42. It can be seen from within submarines, frolicking along the deep sea floor.
cobblemon.species.deltawaterlilligant.de: The flame atop its head burns so intensely that not even water can douse it. It has been know to help guide diving humans to safety.
cobblemon.species.deltafairypetilil.name: DeltaFairyPetilil
cobblemon.species.deltafairypetilil.desc: A Delta Species discovered by shadowsofme. It gracefully descends upon weary travelers, restoring their morale and energy in the process.
cobblemon.species.deltafairylilligant.de: Capable of producing massive barriers that provide weaker Pokemon with a sanctuary, it observed the Torren Region from afar during its greatest times of crisis.
cobblemon.species.deltadarumaka.name: DeltaDarumaka
cobblemon.species.deltadarumaka.desc: A Delta Species discovered by potatoking12. Being quite mischievous, it runs through streets at night while making strange noises.
cobblemon.species.deltadarmanitan.name: DeltaDarmanitan
cobblemon.species.deltadarmanitan.desc: When facing weakened foes, it can sometimes possess them by passing through them. It still tries to use doors despite passing straight through them.
cobblemon.species.deltamaractus.name: DeltaMaractus
cobblemon.species.deltamaractus.desc: A Delta Species discovered by mushgloom. They move systematically, causing their gears and motors to produce an almost musical sound effect.
cobblemon.species.deltaberrydwebble.name: DeltaBerryDwebble
cobblemon.species.deltaberrydwebble.desc: A Delta Species discovered by MorallyIncorrect. It makes homes in various berry bushes until they stop producing fruit.
cobblemon.species.deltaberrycrustle.name: DeltaBerryCrustle
cobblemon.species.deltaberrycrustle.desc: With its powerful pincers, it tills the earth and plants berries from the hedge on its back, creating future homes for itself and its offspring.
cobblemon.species.deltacakedwebble.name: DeltaCakeDwebble
cobblemon.species.deltacakedwebble.desc: A Delta Species discovered by DankRabbit. It entices strangers with its sweet scent, taking offense if they do not immediately attempt to taste its frosting.
cobblemon.species.deltacakecrustle.name: DeltaCakeCrustle
cobblemon.species.deltacakecrustle.desc: While it does not mind sharing its pastry with others, it will stab thieves with its fork. Its body is quite cold in order to preserve the freshness of its cake.
cobblemon.species.deltascraggy.name: DeltaScraggy
cobblemon.species.deltascraggy.desc: A Delta Species discovered by DankRabbit. Despite being a Grass-type, it is quite adept at hunting Bug-types for food.
cobblemon.species.deltascrafty.name: DeltaScrafty
cobblemon.species.deltascrafty.desc: The tuft of grass on its head is surprisingly hard; it can be used to break through rocks.
cobblemon.species.deltayamask.name: DeltaYamask
cobblemon.species.deltayamask.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Palfi. This Pokemon formed from radioactive waste that was carelessly dumped in landfills.
cobblemon.species.deltacofagrigus.name: DeltaCofagrigus
cobblemon.species.deltacofagrigus.desc: This Pokemon frequents nuclear landfills in order to keep surrounding areas free from radiation. Destroying its exterior would produce an explosion exceeding 720 kilotons.
cobblemon.species.deltasolosis.name: DeltaSolosis
cobblemon.species.deltasolosis.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Steads42. Its survival is dependent upon its soul remaining bound to its rock.
cobblemon.species.deltaduosion.name: DeltaDuosion
cobblemon.species.deltaduosion.desc: As its power grows, so do the number of rocks under its control. Each rock appears to have a mind of its own.
cobblemon.species.deltareuniclus.name: DeltaReuniclus
cobblemon.species.deltareuniclus.desc: Extraordinarily cunning, it can survive any attack so long as a fragment of itself remains within a rock.
cobblemon.species.deltaemolga.name: DeltaEmolga
cobblemon.species.deltaemolga.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird. On cold nights they spit hot embers on their tails and feet to ignite them. The ensuing blaze can be seen for miles.
cobblemon.species.deltakarrablast.name: DeltaKarrablast
cobblemon.species.deltakarrablast.desc: A Delta Species discovered by bradleyinabox. For unknown reasons, this Pokemon is extremely friendly towards Shelmet.
cobblemon.species.deltaescavalier.name: DeltaEscavalier
cobblemon.species.deltaescavalier.desc: It drenches the shell of a Shelmet in its own saliva before wearing it, creating a sugary, white coating. The steel armor is then resistant to Fire-type attacks.
cobblemon.species.deltafoongus.name: DeltaFoongus
cobblemon.species.deltafoongus.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Ubodot. It disguises itself as a harmless umbrella and then frightens people attempting to grab it by licking their hand.
cobblemon.species.deltaamoonguss.name: DeltaAmoonguss
cobblemon.species.deltaamoonguss.desc: Though not always malicious in nature, they offer to shield Pokemon from the rain using their arms only to play pranks once the Pokemon's guard has dropped.
cobblemon.species.deltalitwick.name: DeltaLitwick
cobblemon.species.deltalitwick.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Aboodie. It shares its flames with others by occupying dark spaces and illuminating its surroundings.
cobblemon.species.deltalampent.name: DeltaLampent
cobblemon.species.deltalampent.desc: It has been known to appear next to children having nightmares, basking them in its warmth and eliminating all negative thoughts and emotions.
cobblemon.species.deltachandelure.name: DeltaChandelure
cobblemon.species.deltachandelure.desc: Its flames will never harm its trainer. On the contrary, being engulfed in its flames purifies both the body and soul while also increasing a person's lifespan.
cobblemon.species.deltaaxew.name: DeltaAxew
cobblemon.species.deltaaxew.desc: A Delta Species discovered by NoNameDummy. It takes large bites out of docked boats, forcing local fishermen to invest in boats made of extremely strong metal.
cobblemon.species.deltafraxure.name: DeltaFraxure
cobblemon.species.deltafraxure.desc: Growing bolder as it becomes stronger, it prefers to bite boats being used by fishermen. However, sometimes they are careless and are pierced by fish hooks.
cobblemon.species.deltahaxorus.name: DeltaHaxorus
cobblemon.species.deltahaxorus.desc: Its dorsal fin fuses with an anchor during evolution. Though it loses its ability to quickly navigate through water, it becomes a very fearsome foe on land.
cobblemon.species.deltagolett.name: DeltaGolett
cobblemon.species.deltagolett.desc: A Delta Species discovered by RuneBlad3. It battles in arenas every day, honing its skills in the hopes that it will one day become a champion.
cobblemon.species.deltagolurk.name: DeltaGolurk
cobblemon.species.deltagolurk.desc: It fights barehanded even against armed foes, as no weapon is capable of piercing its armor. No one knows what its face looks like without wearing its helmet.
cobblemon.species.deltapawniard.name: DeltaPawniard
cobblemon.species.deltapawniard.desc: A Delta Species discovered by EchoTheThird and Zero_Breaker. It flies through the air and strikes at its prey.
cobblemon.species.deltabisharp.name: DeltaBisharp
cobblemon.species.deltabisharp.desc: It commands a large group of Pawniard. A single swing of its arm is enough to summon a hurricane.
cobblemon.species.deltaheatmor.name: DeltaHeatmor
cobblemon.species.deltaheatmor.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Radryl and EchoTheThird. The mechanisms inside of its body allow it to churn acids at high velocity and fire them from its arms.
cobblemon.species.deltadeino.name: DeltaDeino
cobblemon.species.deltadeino.desc: A Delta Species discovered by NoNameDummy. Being blind, they use their tongues to sense objects around them through different scents. They bite anything that moves.
cobblemon.species.deltazweilous.name: DeltaZweilous
cobblemon.species.deltazweilous.desc: As its heads are quite competitive, it faces problems if both heads try to swallow its prey whole. It can spit venom over the length of an Olympic swimming pool.
cobblemon.species.deltahydreigon.name: DeltaHydreigon
cobblemon.species.deltahydreigon.desc: It uses its smaller heads to scout out an area before dominating anything it considers prey. Though females of this species are shy, males should be avoided at all costs.
cobblemon.species.deltalarvesta.name: DeltaLarvesta
cobblemon.species.deltalarvesta.desc: A Delta Species discovered by 1ofthe4rocketbros. It prefers to remain in solitude, away from all forms of life. When its anger peaks, it is able to distort dimensions.
cobblemon.species.deltavolcarona.name: DeltaVolcarona
cobblemon.species.deltavolcarona.desc: Contact with humans causes it to release lethal toxins into the air for miles. Experiments suggest that it can warp space and summon black holes.
cobblemon.species.deltameloetta.name: DeltaMeloetta
cobblemon.species.deltameloetta.desc: A Delta Species discovered by mushgloom. It became a mime after finding itself without a voice, but it is suspected that finding its voice would unlock its powers.
cobblemon.species.deltafroakie.name: DeltaFroakie
cobblemon.species.deltafroakie.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Ubodot. The leaves around its neck help keep its neck warm while jumping through the trees at high speed.
cobblemon.species.deltafrogadier.name: DeltaFrogadier
cobblemon.species.deltafrogadier.desc: It can hurl the leaves produced around its neck at alarming speed, even slicing through tree trunks.
cobblemon.species.deltagreninja.name: DeltaGreninja
cobblemon.species.deltagreninja.desc: It hides within the deepest of foliage, only appearing to intimidate intruders. It blocks its enemies easily using its armor before incinerating them.
cobblemon.species.deltaamaura.name: DeltaAmaura
cobblemon.species.deltaamaura.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Steads42. This Pokemon floats around unnoticed in the ocean until it comes into contact with humans and greets them.
cobblemon.species.deltaaurorus.name: DeltaAurorus
cobblemon.species.deltaaurorus.desc: This Pokemon willingly offers rides to other Pokemon and ferries them to other islands. It can float in the ocean endlessly so long as the sun is shining.
cobblemon.species.deltagoomy.name: DeltaGoomy
cobblemon.species.deltagoomy.desc: A Delta Species discovered by AChosen_Username. Its body is mainly composed of mud and is extremely squishy when touched.
cobblemon.species.deltasliggoo.name: DeltaSliggoo
cobblemon.species.deltasliggoo.desc: It requires water in order to maintain its shape and health. Dryness is a sign of a sick Sliggoo.
cobblemon.species.deltagoodra.name: DeltaGoodra
cobblemon.species.deltagoodra.desc: It expels and absorbs water continually on a daily basis. The occasional pebble that makes its way into its body can be expelled by belching.
cobblemon.species.deltaphantump.name: DeltaPhantump
cobblemon.species.deltaphantump.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zero_Breaker. It protects all woodland Pokemon as a spirit guardian of the forest.
cobblemon.species.deltatrevenant.name: DeltaTrevenant
cobblemon.species.deltatrevenant.desc: It guards the forest and would lay down its life to protect weaker Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.deltabergmite.name: DeltaBergmite
cobblemon.species.deltabergmite.desc: A Delta Species discovered by Zero_Breaker. Nearly impervious to physical attacks, its rate of regeneration exceeds the damage that it does receive.
cobblemon.species.deltaavalugg.name: DeltaAvalugg
cobblemon.species.deltaavalugg.desc: The rocks covering its body are as hard as steel. Its rampage is ferocious enough to destroy an entire mountain range.
cobblemon.species.deltanoibat.name: DeltaNoibat
cobblemon.species.deltanoibat.desc: A Delta Species discovered by LunarDusk. It uses blades of grass to create earsplittingly high frequencies of sound which stun its prey.
cobblemon.species.deltanoivern.name: DeltaNoivern
cobblemon.species.deltanoivern.desc: A Delta Species discovered by LunarDusk. It uses camouflage to stalk its enemies, but its heavy metal prevents it from flying.
cobblemon.species.deltahoopa.name: DeltaHoopa
cobblemon.species.deltahoopa.desc: A Delta Species discovered by TerraTerraCotta. The clouds produced around its torso allow it to remain in the air even while it is asleep.
cobblemon.species.deltahoopaunleashed.de: A Delta Species discovered by TerraTerraCotta. The clouds produced around its torso allow it to remain in the air even while it is asleep.
cobblemon.species.ufi.name: UFI
cobblemon.species.ufi.desc: An unidentified infantile Pokemon, from beyond the visible universe. It has taken up residence in the Oort Cloud.
cobblemon.species.spacemew.name: SpaceMew
cobblemon.species.shadowmewtwo.name: ShadowMewtwo
cobblemon.species.shyleon.name: Shyleon
cobblemon.species.shyleon.desc: An exceptionally timid Pokemon always wearing a mask that covers it face. The mask itself seems to be its power source.
cobblemon.species.shyleonterrestrial.des: The Red Energy enhanced its ability to camouflage. It is almost impossible to detect Shyleon in its habitat.
cobblemon.species.shyleonxenoversal.name: ShyleonXenoversal
cobblemon.species.shyleonxenoversal.desc: It Aquired magic powers after absorbing the Blue Energy. It was revered as a deity by an ancient civilization.
cobblemon.species.shyleonastral.name: ShyleonAstral
cobblemon.species.shyleonastral.desc: Shyleon's real form. In ancient times, it fought with its brothers alongside Luxflon to defeat the Chaos throughout the universe.
cobblemon.species.trishout.name: Trishout
cobblemon.species.trishout.desc: Despite its size, it can already shout very loudly. If it cries too much, it becomes voiceless and coughs smoke.
cobblemon.species.trishoutterrestrial.de: It has become more competitive thanks to the Red Energy. It goes wild during battle, releasing scorching flames from its horn.
cobblemon.species.trishoutxenoversal.des: The Blue Energy has given it an overwhelming explosive power. It ejects air from the ports on its body to boost its fiery roars.
cobblemon.species.trishoutastral.name: TrishoutAstral
cobblemon.species.trishoutastral.desc: Trishout's real form. In ancient times, it fought with its brothers alongside Luxflon to defeat the Chaos throughout the universe.
cobblemon.species.shulong.name: Shulong
cobblemon.species.shulong.desc: Its blue covering skin is very elastic and can rebound attacks. However, it is extremely sensitive to cold.
cobblemon.species.shulongterrestrial.des: The energy of Planet Earth has turned its skin into a coriaceous armor. After every wound, it comes back harder.
cobblemon.species.shulongxenoversal.name: ShulongXenoversal
cobblemon.species.shulongxenoversal.desc: Blue Energy has made it vicious and territorial. No one is able to take on it underwater.
cobblemon.species.shulongastral.name: ShulongAstral
cobblemon.species.shulongastral.desc: Shulong's real form. In ancient times, it fought with its brothers alongside Luxflon to defeat the Chaos throughout the universe.
cobblemon.species.sparkowl.name: Sparkowl
cobblemon.species.sparkowl.desc: It has a peaceful nature and attacks only when threatened. First it paralyzes the enemy with a weak electric shock, then runs away.
cobblemon.species.shawkbird.name: Shawkbird
cobblemon.species.shawkbird.desc: You can see flocks of Shawkbird during storms. If you touch one of them while it's flying, you will get zapped.
cobblemon.species.harrowk.name: Harrowk
cobblemon.species.harrowk.desc: It lives on mountaintops that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. It stores electricity in its cloud, then plummets down to strike its prey.
cobblemon.species.yemin.name: Yemin
cobblemon.species.yemin.desc: It constantly undertakes an intense meditation training. As a result of this, it is always super focused in battles.
cobblemon.species.kungfur.name: Kungfur
cobblemon.species.kungfur.desc: Thanks to the strong experience it has acquired in countless battles, it teaches weak Pokemon to fight. It is very strict as an instructor.
cobblemon.species.masgot.name: Masgot
cobblemon.species.masgot.desc: It defends from predators assuming the form of bigger Pokemon. It is very popular among Bug Maniacs.
cobblemon.species.fire_masgot.name: Masgot
cobblemon.species.fire_masgot.desc1: It defends from predators assuming the formAspects of bigger Pokemon. It is very popular among Bug Maniacs.

cobblemon.species.fairy_masgot.desc1: It defends from predators assuming the formAspects of bigger Pokemon. It is very popular among Bug Maniacs.
cobblemon.species.bremand.name: Bremand
cobblemon.species.bremand.desc: It is said this Pokemon represents the soul of music. It has full control over its voice so that it can adapt to any kind of song.
cobblemon.species.bassistbremand.name: BassistBremand
cobblemon.species.bassistbremand.desc: It is said this Pokemon represents the soul of music. It quietly strims its tail, but occasionally it can play unexpectedly energetic grooves.
cobblemon.species.drummerbremand.name: DrummerBremand
cobblemon.species.drummerbremand.desc: It is said this Pokemon represents the soul of music. Thumping its chest with two drumsticks, it boost the morale to anyone who's listening.
cobblemon.species.guitaristbremand.name: GuitaristBremand
cobblemon.species.guitaristbremand.desc: It is said this Pokemon represents the soul of music. The electrifying solos it plays with its big whiskers will make your hair stand on end.
cobblemon.species.puppillon.name: Puppillon
cobblemon.species.puppillon.desc: It takes control of other Pokemon to do whatever it wants. However, it does this not with malevolence, but just because it is bashful.
cobblemon.species.hangead.name: Hangead
cobblemon.species.hangead.desc: It controls Pokemon and human beings as puppets using its strings. Feeding on their life energy, it turns their bodies in soul-less empty shells.
cobblemon.species.nunvil.name: Nunvil
cobblemon.species.nunvil.desc: Behind its lovely graceful appearance lies a spiteful side. It will terrify its enemies just for fun.
cobblemon.species.whisteract.name: Whisteract
cobblemon.species.whisteract.desc: Whisteract haunts abandoned mansions, jealously guarding everything inside. It's said to be very vengeful towards raiders.
cobblemon.species.blingrimm.name: Blingrimm
cobblemon.species.blingrimm.desc: It is a real miners' nightmare. A single touch of its metal claws and you will be badly intoxicated.
cobblemon.species.blingrudge.name: Blingrudge
cobblemon.species.blingrudge.desc: Compressing and releasing its spiked tail, it will pierce even the thickest walls. It builds complicated tunnels in mazes to exhaust its preys.
cobblemon.species.hikiloo.name: Hikiloo
cobblemon.species.hikiloo.desc: Hikiloo is a perfect partner for beginners. It will always follow orders by its Trainer it sees as a leader.
cobblemon.species.mylomute.name: Mylomute
cobblemon.species.mylomute.desc: Extremely loyal and intelligent Pokemon. It is widely used for pulling sleds since it can scent the safe route even in a blizzard.
cobblemon.species.kidoon.name: Kidoon
cobblemon.species.kidoon.desc: It's incredible fertile in ponds and swamps. It feeds on microorganisms it filters with its large mouth.
cobblemon.species.honchen.name: Honchen
cobblemon.species.honchen.desc: Revered as a deity in the past. Somewhere in the world, there's still the tradition to welcome the new year dedicating it a dance.
cobblemon.species.eldiwanmeowth.name: EldiwanMeowth
cobblemon.species.eldiwanmeowth.desc: Due to its delicate fur and its psychic powers, even veteran Trainers find it difficult to raise this Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.persage.name: Persage
cobblemon.species.persage.desc: It can see the future through its crystal ball. Those who ask it for prediction more than three times will be cursed for life.
cobblemon.species.koinkoin.name: Koinkoin
cobblemon.species.koinkoin.desc: The more it moves, the more is the gold it drops from its navel. After an intense struggle, its Trainer will make plenty of Nuggets.
cobblemon.species.beefle.name: Beefle
cobblemon.species.beefle.desc: It runs around full of vitality and charges into bigger and stronger Pokemon. Its external shell hardens over time.
cobblemon.species.punchbug.name: Punchbug
cobblemon.species.punchbug.desc: They hang on tree branches, letting Beefle punching them to store the energy required to evolve.
cobblemon.species.hercurcules.name: Hercurcules
cobblemon.species.hercurcules.desc: It overcomes opponents with its huge body. It categorically refuses to battle against a Pokemon it doesn't deem worthy.
cobblemon.species.chigami.name: Chigami
cobblemon.species.chigami.desc: Its skin has the same properties as the paper. Apparently origamis were invented looking at this exact Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.grudako.name: Grudako
cobblemon.species.grudako.desc: According to the legend, this origami crane came to life thanks to a mystical melody after the death of its child creator.
cobblemon.species.sabolt.name: Sabolt
cobblemon.species.sabolt.desc: Information about this Pokemon is shrouded in mystery. It is said to have appeared after a power outage.
cobblemon.species.saboltterrestrial.name: SaboltTerrestrial
cobblemon.species.saboltterrestrial.desc: It looks like the Red Energy had somehow affected this Pokemon. Wrapped in the darkness of its cloak, it shoots thunderbolts all of sudden.
cobblemon.species.saboltxenoversal.name: SaboltXenoversal
cobblemon.species.saboltxenoversal.desc: It appears to be affected by the Blue Energy too, becoming fierce and savage. It fires immense dark lightning bolts from its mane charged with electricity.
cobblemon.species.gachigachoo.name: Gachigachoo
cobblemon.species.gachigachoo.desc: It withstands low temperatures thanks to its thick fur coat. If you rub that, it will charge with static electricity and electrocute.
cobblemon.species.hystearic.name: Hystearic
cobblemon.species.hystearic.desc: If someone tries to yank them out of the ground while they're sleeping, these Pokemon will shriek out loud making even large size Pokemon dizzy.
cobblemon.species.wystearia.name: Wystearia
cobblemon.species.wystearia.desc: It chatters non-stop in the shade of its foliage. Whoever accidentally catches the sound waves from its floreal antennas will have to swallow it endless babble.
cobblemon.species.pepequeno.name: Pepequeno
cobblemon.species.pepequeno.desc: It is coated with an oily, spicy substance. Pretending to be a Berry, it waits for someone to bite it. Then it laughs out loud on its own joke.
cobblemon.species.scovile.name: Scovile
cobblemon.species.scovile.desc: The color of its tail is indicative of its body temperature and its actual mood. If it rampages, it will burn everything down.
cobblemon.species.excalibould.name: Excalibould
cobblemon.species.excalibould.desc: This rock pile came to life thanks to the combative spirit of past paladins that inhabited the sword wedged in it.
cobblemon.species.madieval.name: Madieval
cobblemon.species.madieval.desc: It is said that the mystical energy which fills this Pokemon and makes its stones float around is somehow related to the Moon's influence.
cobblemon.species.rockapye.name: Rockapye
cobblemon.species.rockapye.desc: Despite its clumsy appearance, it is a very quick learner if followed step by step. Each Rockapye has a diffferent handprint.
cobblemon.species.troglolith.name: Troglolith
cobblemon.species.troglolith.desc: It is supposed to be the missing evolutionary link. In ancient times, males and females used to raise wild Pokemon in two very different ways.
cobblemon.species.sputnink.name: Sputnink
cobblemon.species.sputnink.desc: Apparently it was found on Earth after a meteor impact. It blends in an ink puddle, then sneaks out to attack.
cobblemon.species.nebyura.name: Nebyura
cobblemon.species.nebyura.desc: A Pokemon from outer space. Using its terrible psychic powers it can drive creatures it establishes mental connection with crazy.
cobblemon.species.birigiri.name: Birigiri
cobblemon.species.birigiri.desc: They swim around thanks to the energy they share with the whole shoal. Due to its high calorie value, Chubiburny is known to be their favorite prey.
cobblemon.species.chubiburny.name: Chubiburny
cobblemon.species.chubiburny.desc: Its pelt contains sugary high-calorie substances. It peacefully basks in the sunlight, ignoring Birigiri's bites.
cobblemon.species.goombear.name: Goombear
cobblemon.species.goombear.desc: It can freely stretch its limbs by burning off everything it has eaten. Before hibernation or when it has no food, it will even burn its own stilts.
cobblemon.species.manticoeur.name: Manticoeur
cobblemon.species.manticoeur.desc: This Pokemon has a moody temper. It lures prey with its sweet face, then sucker punches them using its stinger.
cobblemon.species.fatail.name: Fatail
cobblemon.species.fatail.desc: Extremely slick, it has a tendency to take advantage on its fellows. Only a few Trainers are able to develop a trustful relationship with it.
cobblemon.species.reindear.name: Reindear
cobblemon.species.reindear.desc: It judges the behavior of other Pokemon, then marks them with tags. It rewards with a gift those who have been nice.
cobblemon.species.reindigo.name: Reindigo
cobblemon.species.reindigo.desc: Contrary to popular belief, it is a gentle soul. Actually, the cause for its constantly sullen face seems to lie in the excessive weight of its antlers.
cobblemon.species.sosqwatch.name: Sosqwatch
cobblemon.species.sosqwatch.desc: It wanders around on snowy mountains with its own original style. It assists whoever's been stranded by avalanches and keeps them warm.
cobblemon.species.vroombug.name: Vroombug
cobblemon.species.vroombug.desc: It has an excellent balance and drives around running on a tire. Once that is over worn, it looks for another new one.
cobblemon.species.skravroom.name: Skravroom
cobblemon.species.skravroom.desc: Rival gangs compete for territories in really noisy speed races that make anyone around run away.
cobblemon.species.chikaboo.name: Chikaboo
cobblemon.species.chikaboo.desc: It has to take care of itself from birth. It doesn't know how to provide food yet, so it plays on others' pity to survive.
cobblemon.species.peckabone.name: Peckabone
cobblemon.species.peckabone.desc: It feeds merely on what it steals from predators. First it deters them with the skull-like pattern, then digs into its target.
cobblemon.species.rexquiem.name: Rexquiem
cobblemon.species.rexquiem.desc: Said to only reveal to people and Pokemon about to die to drag them to the afterlife. It is also known as 'the Emissary of the Devil'.
cobblemon.species.scaracno.name: Scaracno
cobblemon.species.scaracno.desc: This Pokemon is supposed to be a physical manifestation of the Bug-type phobia mankind has always had since ancient times.
cobblemon.species.scaracluo.name: Scaracluo
cobblemon.species.scaracluo.desc: The fear of dangers lurking in the darkness, usually seen among children, has somehow spawned this weird Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.scarphasmo.name: Scarphasmo
cobblemon.species.scarphasmo.desc: According to several tales, a mad scientist created this creature by combining parts of different Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.tokakle.name: Tokakle
cobblemon.species.tokakle.desc: It's not graffiti...that's a Pokemon! It mixes up on city walls and mocks on anyone else who comes its way.
cobblemon.species.donanas.name: Donanas
cobblemon.species.donanas.desc: This very shy Pokemon rarely counterattacks. When in danger, it withdraws in its shell as hard as steel.
cobblemon.species.chimaooze.name: Chimaooze
cobblemon.species.chimaooze.desc: The most polluted areas of cities are infested by Chimaooze. When they senses danger, they team up together to eliminate the threat.
cobblemon.species.monster_chimaooze.name: Chimaooze
cobblemon.species.bandeon.name: Bandeon
cobblemon.species.bandeon.desc: It can perfectly replicate the sound of any musical instrument. Once it learns a melody, this Pokemon will never forget it.
cobblemon.species.scaleon.name: Scaleon
cobblemon.species.scaleon.desc: It takes flight by spreading its big ears as if they were wings. It viciously threaten anyone who enters its den in the mountains.
cobblemon.species.porygonwes.name: PorygonWES
cobblemon.species.porygonwes.desc: It was updated with the most cutting-edge technology ever created. It was originally meant to be an assistant in PokeWES.
cobblemon.species.dusmee.name: Dusmee
cobblemon.species.dusmee.desc: It desperates for attention and makes everything with the sole purpose of getting noticed. When it fails, it starts whining as a baby.
cobblemon.species.egohiss.name: Egohiss
cobblemon.species.egohiss.desc: It periodically sheds its skin trying to remove any flaws. Because this process makes Egohiss blind, its tail serves as a radar that senses its surroundings.
cobblemon.species.egorgeon.name: Egorgeon
cobblemon.species.egorgeon.desc: It has a paralyzing glare it refracts through the scales on its body. In this way, it catches prey and dresses them up with its old leather.
cobblemon.species.chiripe.name: Chiripe
cobblemon.species.chiripe.desc: It has the habit of swinging back and forth while hanging upside down on trees. Because of that, it is usually mistaken for a fruit.
cobblemon.species.batnana.name: Batnana
cobblemon.species.batnana.desc: Its diet has changed and now it is trying to take its first steps into hunting. However, it is very clumsy and makes preys slip away.
cobblemon.species.vesperfum.name: Vesperfum
cobblemon.species.vesperfum.desc: It is a perfect hunter. Pretending to be a flower, it waits for preys to approach attracted by its scent, then strikes lightning-fast.
cobblemon.species.croakling.name: Croakling
cobblemon.species.croakling.desc: It uses its fingers as a sling to shoot ignited rocks with its extremely elastic membranes. Its aim is not that good though.
cobblemon.species.bullverin.name: Bullverin
cobblemon.species.bullverin.desc: It membranes toughen up during evolution, turning similar to glass. When it blows up, spits out fiery cannonballs.
cobblemon.species.croakraze.name: Croakraze
cobblemon.species.croakraze.desc: All of its fights is a spectacular show. Surrounded by flames, it melts the glass on its arms, leaving an elegant trail of crystals behind.
cobblemon.species.inflant.name: Inflant
cobblemon.species.inflant.desc: It floats because of its large ears. Really competitive, it always looks for an opponent to challenge in swimming.
cobblemon.species.floatusk.name: Floatusk
cobblemon.species.floatusk.desc: Floatusk will plough into everything and everyone to prove its strength. It swells water to look bigger.
cobblemon.species.swelephant.name: Swelephant
cobblemon.species.swelephant.desc: Before a fight, it pumps water in its muscles to strengthen its fists. However, this power-up has a specific time limit.
cobblemon.species.luxflon.name: Luxflon
cobblemon.species.luxflon.desc: A legendary Pokemon that protects planet Earth. It has full control over nature it can shape at its will.
cobblemon.species.dragalisk.name: Dragalisk
cobblemon.species.dragalisk.desc: Sealed in the Xenoverse, lusting for power. By planting its tail in the ground, it subtracts vital energy from the planet, making it sterile and infertile.
cobblemon.species.dielebi.name: Dielebi
cobblemon.species.dielebi.desc: It seems somehow related to Celebi. Unlike its counterpart, Dielebi travels across past and future alternate dimensions.
cobblemon.species.reginalous.name: Reginalous
cobblemon.species.reginalous.desc: Its body is formed by Anomalous energy from various dimensions. It creates strong winds of bright pink color that changes the alterations of each dimension.
cobblemon.species.elekidx.name: ElekidX
cobblemon.species.elekidx.desc: The sparks it scatters from its head can easily cause fires or explosions. It is a real ticking bomb!
cobblemon.species.electabuzzx.name: ElectabuzzX
cobblemon.species.electabuzzx.desc: Bumping its fists together, it creates strong explosions. It will discharge its fury around when enraged.
cobblemon.species.electaburst.name: Electaburst
cobblemon.species.electaburst.desc: The excessive energy unleashed during evolution split up its body. It combines thunders and flares to set off terrible explosions all around.
cobblemon.species.spiritombx.name: SpiritombX
cobblemon.species.spiritombx.desc: Some theories assert that this is Spiritomb's real appearence--it's the one we already know who comes from the Xenoverse.
cobblemon.species.carvanhax.name: CarvanhaX
cobblemon.species.carvanhax.desc: It perpetually floats upside down on the surface of the water. Apparently, it doesn't feed on anything to survive.
cobblemon.species.sharpedox.name: SharpedoX
cobblemon.species.sharpedox.desc: This Pokemon may have appeared long time ago, since very ancient sailors' tales already told of a creature used to devour ships to make them its den.
cobblemon.species.pyukumukux.name: PyukumukuX
cobblemon.species.pyukumukux.desc: It is way bigger than the actual Pyukumuku. Expelling its internal organs, it propels itself to strike its opponent.
cobblemon.species.pikachux.name: PikachuX
cobblemon.species.pikachux.desc: It is a real anomaly between X Pokemon. Its nature makes it friendly even to human.
cobblemon.species.pikachufemalex.name: PikachuFemaleX
cobblemon.species.pikachufemalex.desc: It is a real anomaly between X Pokemon. Its nature makes it friendly even to human.
cobblemon.species.joltikx.name: JoltikX
cobblemon.species.joltikx.desc: They sneak up falling from the sky in large groups, so they can overcome their small size. Then they bring the prey to Galvantula.
cobblemon.species.galvantulax.name: GalvantulaX
cobblemon.species.galvantulax.desc: It freezes the air around its nest. Then it traps prey in a thick ice web, slowly leading them to hypothermia.
cobblemon.species.smearglex.name: SmeargleX
cobblemon.species.smearglex.desc: It produces a delicious low-calory cream, but it becomes rancid if not kept cool.
cobblemon.species.chientilly.name: Chientilly
cobblemon.species.chientilly.desc: It secretes ice-fresh cream from its tail. If the quality doesn't match its high requirements, it throws that away.
cobblemon.species.gastlyx.name: GastlyX
cobblemon.species.gastlyx.desc: Compressed by an enormous pressure, it body is protected by a shell as hard as steel. Nobody knows how it looks inside this shell.
cobblemon.species.haunterx.name: HaunterX
cobblemon.species.haunterx.desc: It catches even the most elusive preys with its claws. It tortures them and once it's had enough, it lets them go.
cobblemon.species.gengarx.name: GengarX
cobblemon.species.gengarx.desc: Because its intelligence is exceptional, Gengar can communicate with any formAspects of life. However, it uses this gift for not-so-ethical purposes.
cobblemon.species.yamaskx.name: YamaskX
cobblemon.species.yamaskx.desc: Its calcareous shell resembles an ancient water jar. It is unknown if men's artifacts were inspired by this Pokemon or vice versa.
cobblemon.species.cofagrigusx.name: CofagrigusX
cobblemon.species.cofagrigusx.desc: Its limbs are made of pure cristalline water. Some people believe that a single sip of that water will give you everlasting life.
cobblemon.species.ponytax.name: PonytaX
cobblemon.species.ponytax.desc: A thick cloud mane makes it float in the air. It is still a green baby, so it can only clumsily fly around.
cobblemon.species.rapidashx.name: RapidashX
cobblemon.species.rapidashx.desc: A peaceful tempered X Pokemon. However, if it gets furious, it wraps itself in thunderclouds and triggers raging lightning storms.
cobblemon.species.storm_rapidashx.name: RapidashX
cobblemon.species.storm_rapidashx.desc1: A peaceful tempered X Pokemon. However, if it gets furious, it wraps itself in thunderclouds and triggers raging lightning storms.
cobblemon.species.rapidashstorm.name: RapidashStorm
cobblemon.species.rapidashstorm.desc: A peaceful tempered X Pokemon. However, if it gets furious, it wraps itself in thunderclouds and triggers raging lightning storms.
cobblemon.species.cacneax.name: CacneaX
cobblemon.species.cacneax.desc: Because its appearance resembles a severed head, everyone who fights this Cacnea is scared to death.
cobblemon.species.cacturnex.name: CacturneX
cobblemon.species.cacturnex.desc: Its internal body is made of a straw-like material. It shoots its needles to cast cursed spell against enemies.
cobblemon.species.swirlixx.name: SwirlixX
cobblemon.species.swirlixx.desc: The appealing sweet fragrance it releases vaguely resembles that of Leppa Berries. Behind its delicious appearence lies an acid filling.
cobblemon.species.slurpuffx.name: SlurpuffX
cobblemon.species.slurpuffx.desc: Anyone who digests its sweets will feel a strong sense of nausea. The more you eat them, the bigger Slurpuff gets.
cobblemon.species.budewx.name: BudewX
cobblemon.species.budewx.desc: If you put your ear to its sound organ, you will hear the sound of a soft breathing. When it's fired up, the sound becomes deafening.
cobblemon.species.roseliax.name: RoseliaX
cobblemon.species.roseliax.desc: Using the auricular organs on its arms, Roselia amplifies the range of its voice. It can even break rocks at full volume.
cobblemon.species.roseradex.name: RoseradeX
cobblemon.species.roseradex.desc: It waves its stings to modify any sound wave at will. If it interferes with its opponent's heartbeat, it will cause them irreparable harm.
cobblemon.species.mareaniex.name: MareanieX
cobblemon.species.mareaniex.desc: When frightened, it shoots fire and sparks from the top of its head. It appears to be pretty friendly with others of the same specie.
cobblemon.species.toxapexx.name: ToxapexX
cobblemon.species.toxapexx.desc: The special toxin it secretes, when heated, shines brightly. It lures preys and traps tem, using its body as a cage.
cobblemon.species.greninjax.name: GreninjaX
cobblemon.species.greninjax.desc: It moves under cover of darkness. It throws knives of hell fire at its opponents, piercing their flesh and leaving them with atrocious burns.
cobblemon.species.mewtwox.name: MewtwoX
cobblemon.species.mewtwox.desc: It has been further genetically modified by Team Dimension. Its psychic powers are frightening.
cobblemon.species.raichux.name: RaichuX
cobblemon.species.raichux.desc: Gym Leader Surge's faithful companion, it has been brought back to life after a terrible accident. It is as fast as fragile.
cobblemon.species.bisharpx.name: BisharpX
cobblemon.species.bisharpx.desc: The Bisharp owned by Dimension Sergeant S. The consciences of both A & B's Bisharp coexist in this Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.scovilex.name: ScovileX
cobblemon.species.scovilex.desc: The Scovile owned by Dimension Colonel Dahlia. When ingested, its seeds will electrocute the body from the inside.
cobblemon.species.tyranitarx.name: TyranitarX
cobblemon.species.tyranitarx.desc: The Tyranitar owned by Dimension General Victor. It generates a defeaning buzz by vibrating its wings.
cobblemon.species.dittox.name: DittoX
cobblemon.species.dittox.desc: Following a great number of experiments, it became extremely unstable, but it developed the ability to Transform even without seeing its target.
cobblemon.species.aegislashx.name: AegislashX
cobblemon.species.aegislashx.desc: It's mentioned in legends as the companion of the First King. It uses its momentum to move at high speeds.
cobblemon.species.tapufinix.name: TapuFiniX
cobblemon.species.tapufinix.desc: One of the four beast from Xenoverse, Dragalisk's elite soldiers. It is held by the Cardinal Chua.
cobblemon.species.tapulelex.name: TapuLeleX
cobblemon.species.tapulelex.desc: One of the four beast from Xenoverse, Dragalisk's elite soldiers. It is held by the Cardinal Niva.
cobblemon.species.tapukokox.name: TapuKokoX
cobblemon.species.tapukokox.desc: One of the four beast from Xenoverse, Dragalisk's elite soldiers. It is held by the Cardinal Peyote.
cobblemon.species.tapubulux.name: TapuBuluX
cobblemon.species.tapubulux.desc: One of the four beast from Xenoverse, Dragalisk's elite soldiers. It is held by the Cardinal Abraham.
cobblemon.species.dragaliskx.name: DragaliskX
cobblemon.species.dragaliskx.desc: This being, created to replace the Dark Lord, is a concentration of pure Fury energy. Although it's smaller to the original Dragalisk, it's still very powerful and lethal.
cobblemon.species.shyleonx.name: ShyleonX
cobblemon.species.shyleonx.desc: Made of pure X Energy, this serpentine Pokemon wraps around enemies until it chokes them.
cobblemon.species.trishoutx.name: TrishoutX
cobblemon.species.trishoutx.desc: Made of pure X Energy, this Pokemon attacks its enemies ruthlessly until you knock them out.
cobblemon.species.shulongx.name: ShulongX
cobblemon.species.shulongx.desc: Made of pure X Energy, this Pokemon stuns its enemies from behind, then takes advantage of them and hits them relentlessly.
cobblemon.species.unownearth.name: UnownEarth
cobblemon.species.unownearth.desc: Their appearance resembles the symbol in Dragalisk's mouth, which is why the Cardinals have considered them profane since time immemorial.
cobblemon.species.unownxenoverse.name: UnownXenoverse
cobblemon.species.unownxenoverse.desc: For centuries they have been considered sacred as their appearance resembles the symbol on the Luxflon's gem.
cobblemon.species.bublit.name: Bublit
cobblemon.species.bublit.desc: When Bublit is happy, it emits a warm, vivid light from its body. The dimmer the light, the more unhappy or unwell the Bublit is. On occasion, massive gatherings of Bublit are encountered, resulting in swathes of ocean lit up at night.
cobblemon.species.nautilite.name: Nautilite
cobblemon.species.nautilite.desc: Electrical charges produced in its body propel it and allow it to sustain flight on its long, blanket-like tentacles. They seemingly communicate via a pattern of flashes from their eyes.
cobblemon.species.tentalcyon.name: Tentalcyon
cobblemon.species.tentalcyon.desc: Tentalcyon tend to be rather aloof and elusive. Though usually solitary, they've been noted to gather during thunderstorms, swooping around and feeding on the electrical energy. Their cloak-like tentacles pulsate with colours in a mesmerising manner, which they use to stun their enemies and escape.
cobblemon.species.friney.name: Friney
cobblemon.species.friney.desc: Friney's tapered, aerodynamic body makes it an excellent swimmer. They love to challenge other Pokemon to races, effortlessly taking advantage of the ocean currents to gain the upper hand.
cobblemon.species.ripplier.name: Ripplier
cobblemon.species.swordier.name: Swordier
cobblemon.species.swordier.desc: Swordier's nose grew so long that it broke off. Now, it wields the sharp blade as a sword. Whenever a Swordier comes across another of its kind, they will bow, and battle each other. It is dangerous to try to intervene.
cobblemon.species.nomstar.name: Nomstar
cobblemon.species.nomstar.desc: Nomstar are insatiable eaters that can't resist biting everything they come across. Much to their frustration, their teeth are rubbery and can barely penetrate anything. The end result is a drooling mess.
cobblemon.species.disastar.name: Disastar
