cobblemon.species.duplicat.desc: This Mon has the ability to create and identical copy of itself or its opponent. These copies only last a few minutes before fading away.
cobblemon.species.nucleon.name: Nucleon
cobblemon.species.nucleon.desc: One of the only non-feral nuclear Mon. It's theorized that its bond with its trainer when it was an Eevee allows it to stay in control.
cobblemon.species.ratsy.name: Ratsy
cobblemon.species.ratsy.desc: They use the paint-like substance on their tails to mark their territory. They are considered pests as they will paint over brand new buildings.
cobblemon.species.raffiti.name: Raffiti
cobblemon.species.raffiti.desc: They spray paint to create signs that only Raffiti can understand. Their knowledge of color theory has led some to consider them artists on par with humans.
cobblemon.species.gargryph.name: Gargryph
cobblemon.species.gargryph.desc: They spend most of their time standing so still they are often mistaken for statues. They perch on the rooftops of Venisi, guarding it from outside attackers.
cobblemon.species.masking.name: Masking
cobblemon.species.masking.desc: It is capable of disguising itself as anything it likes. Although it appears to be a bird Mon, this is just an illusion. No one has seen its true formAspects.
cobblemon.species.dramsama.name: Dramsama
cobblemon.species.dramsama.desc: A sinister and vengeful Mon, it puts its foes into an eternal resting and steals their souls to add to its tail.
cobblemon.species.antarki.name: Antarki
cobblemon.species.antarki.desc: Said to be the ghost of a Mon that died before its time. It guides lost souls into the afterlife using the light of its small star.
cobblemon.species.chupacho.name: Chupacho
cobblemon.species.chupacho.desc: It comes out at night to suck the blood from sleeping prey. Its needles contain a numbing toxin that can incapacitate an enemy in minutes.
cobblemon.species.luchabra.name: Luchabra
cobblemon.species.luchabra.desc: It comes out at night to suck the blood from sleeping prey. Its needles contain a numbing toxin that can incapacitate an enemy in minutes.
cobblemon.species.linkite.name: Linkite
cobblemon.species.linkite.desc: The spirit of a Mon that died inside its Pokeball. It has forgotten its original appearance so it takes the formAspects of a Substitute decoy.
cobblemon.species.chainite.name: Chainite
cobblemon.species.chainite.desc: A malicious and dangerous Mon, it seeks revenge against the trainer who abandoned it. Its shackles were reinforced in order to keep its violence in check.
cobblemon.species.pufluff.name: Pufluff
cobblemon.species.pufluff.desc: It constantly wraps itself in its long tail to protect it from the cold. Despite this, it always seems to shiver as if it is freezing.
cobblemon.species.alpico.name: Alpico
cobblemon.species.alpico.desc: Its two tails are coated with a waxy material that allows it to glide over snow and ice. They are often seen hurtling down mountains at high speeds.
cobblemon.species.anderind.name: Anderind
cobblemon.species.anderind.desc: Its eyes are covered by a shield that protects it from blowing snow and ice. The one that can perform the wildest flips and tricks is deemed the leader.
cobblemon.species.colarva.name: Colarva
cobblemon.species.colarva.desc: The older they get, the sharper the ice spikes on their back become. Stepping on one buried under the snow is an unpleasant experience.
cobblemon.species.frosulo.name: Frosulo
cobblemon.species.frosulo.desc: It encases itself in a hard shell of unmelting ice and hangs upside-down from the ceilings of Lanthanite Cave, awaiting evolution.
cobblemon.species.frosthra.name: Frosthra
cobblemon.species.frosthra.desc: They leave a shimmering trail of ice crystals behind them as they fly. They are prized in many regions for their rarity and beauty.
cobblemon.species.fafurr.name: Fafurr
cobblemon.species.fafurr.desc: This Mon's shaggy coat keeps it warm in freezing weather. They are sought after by hunters for their silky fur.
cobblemon.species.fafninter.name: Fafninter
cobblemon.species.fafninter.desc: A gentle guardian of the mountains, this Mon will often escort lost travelers and Mon to safety by giving them a ride on its back.
cobblemon.species.shrimputy.name: Shrimputy
cobblemon.species.shrimputy.desc: It is able to fire a barrage of super-heated blasts from its cannon. Despite its small size, it is a very capable predator.
cobblemon.species.krilvolver.name: Krilvolver
cobblemon.species.krilvolver.desc: Called 'the ranger of the sea'. Its reaction times are nigh-instantaneous and its aim with its pistol is excellent due to its highly advanced eyesight.
cobblemon.species.lavent.name: Lavent
cobblemon.species.lavent.desc: It lives within igneous crevasses at the bottom of the sea and absorbs geothermal energy. When prey comes close, it spits out scalding hot water.
cobblemon.species.swabone.name: Swabone
cobblemon.species.swabone.desc: A favorite Mon of pirates. The bandanna it wears indicates which ship's crew it belongs to. It craves treasure and will hoard any gold and jewels it finds.
cobblemon.species.skelerogue.name: Skelerogue
cobblemon.species.skelerogue.desc: It requires seemingly no sustenance such as food or air. Although it can't swim, it will walk across the bottom of the sea until it makes it to shore.
cobblemon.species.navighast.name: Navighast
cobblemon.species.navighast.desc: Said to be the spirit of a mad pirate captain reincarnated as a Mon. Its spectral flames are icy cold to the touch.
cobblemon.species.stenowatt.name: Stenowatt
cobblemon.species.stenowatt.desc: It flaps its wings to generate electricity, which it stores in its tail. It channels the stored energy into its legs to run faster.
cobblemon.species.jungore.name: Jungore
cobblemon.species.jungore.desc: Its hide is studded with pieces of solid gold. Because of how valuable this Mon is on the black market, its population dwindled until it became extinct in the wild.
cobblemon.species.majungold.name: Majungold
cobblemon.species.majungold.desc: Its enormously heavy arms are made of solid gold. This Mon has developed extraordinarily strong muscles to hold them up.
cobblemon.species.hagoop.name: Hagoop
cobblemon.species.hagoop.desc: Its body exudes a sticky slime that protects its soft flesh. It traps prey in the slime and delivers a lightning shock through its whiskers.
cobblemon.species.haagross.name: Haagross
cobblemon.species.haagross.desc: The slime covering its body is toxic and corrosive. Between that and its electric bite, it has no known predators. They proliferate in contaminated areas.
cobblemon.species.xenomite.name: Xenomite
cobblemon.species.xenomite.desc: A species that spontaneously appeared in irradiated zones. It is thought to have hatched from a corrupt egg.
cobblemon.species.xenogen.name: Xenogen
cobblemon.species.xenogen.desc: A bizarre life formAspects which thrives in irradiated locations. It is a parasitic creature that latches on to any prey and absorb its life force.
cobblemon.species.xenoqueen.name: Xenoqueen
cobblemon.species.xenoqueen.desc: It is known to spit radioactive acid capable of melting through steel. It is a ruthless predator that will attack any living creature, human or Mon.
cobblemon.species.hazma.name: Hazma
cobblemon.species.hazma.desc: They Appear in the afterMath of nuclear fallOut. They sponGe Up radiation and can rinSe an irradiated area over time.
cobblemon.species.geigeroach.name: Geigeroach
cobblemon.species.geigeroach.desc: It’s simple body structure allows it survive intense levels of radiation. They multiply rapidly and will eat anything in sight.
cobblemon.species.minicorn.name: Minicorn
cobblemon.species.minicorn.desc: Its small stature, gentle demeanor and delicate features make it beloved by young children. A popular line of toys is based on it.
cobblemon.species.kiricorn.name: Kiricorn
cobblemon.species.kiricorn.desc: The hair in its mane is made of gossamer-thin threads and is impossibly soft. It will only allow those it trusts to touch it.
cobblemon.species.oblivicorn.name: Oblivicorn
cobblemon.species.oblivicorn.desc: It’s powers are strongest at night when the moon is not visible. Only a veteran trainer can tame one well enough to ride it.
cobblemon.species.luxi.name: Luxi
cobblemon.species.luxi.desc: Simply being around a Luxi is said to increase one's fortune. Ceramic statues of them are good luck charms.
cobblemon.species.luxor.name: Luxor
cobblemon.species.luxor.desc: It polishes its jade tail until it glimmers with lustrous sheen. A clipping of this Mon's hair is said to bring good luck for 30 days.
cobblemon.species.luxelong.name: Luxelong
cobblemon.species.luxelong.desc: A Mon so rare and gentle, simply seeing one is said to bless someone with good fortune for a whole year.
cobblemon.species.praseopunk.name: Praseopunk
cobblemon.species.praseopunk.desc: A mysterious life-formAspects that emerged one day out of a computer. When it unites with its twin, its powers multiply in strength.
cobblemon.species.neopunk.name: Neopunk
cobblemon.species.neopunk.desc: A highly intelligent Mon capable of traveling through cyberspace. Found in pairs alongside its twin, Praseopunk.
cobblemon.species.sheebit.name: Sheebit
cobblemon.species.sheebit.desc: These Mon live in packs in mountainous regions. They will often headbutt each other to improve their strength.
cobblemon.species.terrabbit.name: Terrabbit
cobblemon.species.terrabbit.desc: It uses its large, flexible tails to balance itself while it deals a series of rapid kicks and punches to its opponent.
cobblemon.species.laissure.name: Laissure
cobblemon.species.laissure.desc: A mighty Mon that is spoken of in legends. It causes earthquakes by pounding the ground with its massive tails.
cobblemon.species.volchik.name: Volchik
cobblemon.species.volchik.desc: They gather together during thunderstorms. Their chirping sounds like static electricity.
cobblemon.species.voltasu.name: Voltasu
cobblemon.species.voltasu.desc: It perches on rocky outcropping and looks at the sky for many hours. They can fortell changes in the weather.
cobblemon.species.yatagaryu.name: Yatagaryu
cobblemon.species.yatagaryu.desc: A fearsome Mon told about in legends. It has the power to summon thunderstorms at will.
cobblemon.species.devimp.name: Devimp
cobblemon.species.devimp.desc: A Mon that is said to come from a separate plane of existence. It is very curious about the world around it and often gets into mischief as a result.
cobblemon.species.fallengel.name: Fallengel
cobblemon.species.fallengel.desc: It acts like a soldier, obeying orders without hesitation. It seems to have no moral compass and will do whatever its master commands.
cobblemon.species.beliaddon.name: Beliaddon
cobblemon.species.beliaddon.desc: Its kind came out of a fiery chasm which contained an otherworldly portal. A furnace hotter than the sun burns within its chest. If it burns you, the pain will never fade.
cobblemon.species.seikamater.name: Seikamater
cobblemon.species.seikamater.desc: Its belly is filled with super hot lava that it sprays at its opponent through the nozzle on its abdomen. Its aim is precise.
cobblemon.species.garlikid.name: Garlikid
cobblemon.species.garlikid.desc: Garlikid believes itself to be a savior of all Monkind. It will pick fights with anyone it considers villainous.
cobblemon.species.baitatao.name: Baitatao
cobblemon.species.baitatao.desc: Called the “Boiling Wrath”. Heat from it’s scales cause the water around it to boil. It attacks ships, melting the hull on contact.
cobblemon.species.leviathao.name: Leviathao
cobblemon.species.leviathao.desc: Called the “Unstoppable Spear”. The ice horn on its head can easily penetrate solid steel. It battles Baitatao and Krakanao for dominance over the sea.
cobblemon.species.krakanao.name: Krakanao
cobblemon.species.krakanao.desc: Called the “Inescapable Malestrom”. It causes massive whirlpools that drag everything - ships, Mon and people alike - into its bottomless maw.
cobblemon.species.lanthan.name: Lanthan
cobblemon.species.lanthan.desc: Legends say that it helped formAspects part of the Tandor region. Along with its brothers Actan and Heatran, it placed metallic ores in the planet's crust.
cobblemon.species.actan.name: Actan
cobblemon.species.actan.desc: One of the Legendary Mon that formed the Tandor Region. It taught humans about the use of radioactive metals.
cobblemon.species.urayne.name: Urayne
cobblemon.species.urayne.desc: An artificial Mon created to be a source of unlimited energy. The more radioactive fuel it consumes, the greater its power becomes. At max potential, it can split atoms.
cobblemon.species.betaurayne.name: BetaUrayne
cobblemon.species.betaurayne.desc: An artificial Mon created to be a source of unlimited energy. The more radioactive fuel it consumes, the greater its power becomes. At max potential, it can split atoms.
cobblemon.species.aotius.name: Aotius
cobblemon.species.aotius.desc: W h i t e l i g h t s h i n e s
cobblemon.species.mutios.name: Mutios
cobblemon.species.mutios.desc: B l a c k s h a d e p r o t e c t s
cobblemon.species.zephy.name: Zephy
cobblemon.species.zephy.desc: A mysterious Mon that appears to be a cross between Plusle and Articuno. In legends, it visited artists and gave them ideas for their next masterpiece.
cobblemon.species.mozz.name: Mozz
cobblemon.species.mozz.desc: It munches on leaves to absorb their photosynthetic properties. Its mossy coat allows it to camouflage among the treetops.
cobblemon.species.mosseer.name: Mosseer
cobblemon.species.mosseer.desc: Its PSI powers allow it a glimpse into the futures of those around it. It shares this knowledge in vague psychic visions and dreams.
cobblemon.species.daemoth.name: Daemoth
cobblemon.species.daemoth.desc: It's said that the eyes on DAEMOTH's wings can see many different futures. It hides from people to protect them from the fate it foresees.
cobblemon.species.chiklit.name: Chiklit
cobblemon.species.chiklit.desc: A poor flyer, it glides and hops from branch to branch to traverse the forests where it lives. It uses tiny bursts of fire to prey on smaller bug-type Pokemon and fend off attackers.
cobblemon.species.burnychus.name: Burnychus
cobblemon.species.burnychus.desc: A primal bird Pokemon that fights fiercely with barbed talons and fire breath. They are highly protective of their young.
cobblemon.species.pyropteryx.name: Pyropteryx
cobblemon.species.pyropteryx.desc: Descended from a common ancestor of bird and dinosaur Pokemon. Its developed feathers allow it to glide, leaving scorching flames in its wake.
cobblemon.species.findolf.name: Findolf
cobblemon.species.findolf.desc: A resilient Pokemon that thrives on land as well as it does in the water. To defend itself, it sprays a forceful water jet from the blowhole on its head.
cobblemon.species.delfender.name: Delfender
cobblemon.species.delfender.desc: The tanks on its shoulders can store water as well as air. This allows it to navigate many environments. It has a helpful and brave personality.
cobblemon.species.hydrocean.name: Hydrocean
cobblemon.species.hydrocean.desc: They are adept at putting out fires and conducting search-and-rescue operations. Its palms produce freezing rays that can douse a burning building.
cobblemon.species.minyan.name: Minyan
cobblemon.species.minyan.desc: Called the 'tiny master of evil', it tries to cause discord but often ends up messing up and fleeing in embarrassment.
cobblemon.species.vilucard.name: Vilucard
cobblemon.species.vilucard.desc: It constantly plots dastardly schemes to spread chaos and fear. However, its plans are always foiled by Herolune.
cobblemon.species.lunapup.name: Lunapup
cobblemon.species.lunapup.desc: Although small, it is very brave. it won't hesitate to protect weaker pokemon in danger. they can often be heard howling at the moon.
cobblemon.species.herolune.name: Herolune
cobblemon.species.herolune.desc: t rises with the moon to do battle with its sworn nemesis, Vilucard. it has a strong sense of justice and will protect those who cannot defend themselves.
cobblemon.species.selkid.name: Selkid
cobblemon.species.selkid.desc: They gather together on rocky shoals and sing together in harmony. Their human-like voices can be misleading because they sound like a child.
cobblemon.species.syrentide.name: Syrentide
cobblemon.species.syrentide.desc: Their song is hypnotic, and all who hear it are immobilized. Legends tell of shipwrecks that were caused by sailors who were captivated by their song.
cobblemon.species.cavamie.name: Cavamie
cobblemon.species.cavamie.desc: A cheerful, mild-natured Pokemon that is agreeable and affectionate to all. Their friendly attitude makes them popular as family pets.
cobblemon.species.capymigo.name: Capymigo
cobblemon.species.capymigo.desc: It has a tranquil nature and cannot be bothered by anything, even the most persistent annoyance. Just being near it is said to have a calming effect.
cobblemon.species.humborb.name: Humborb
cobblemon.species.humborb.desc: It harvests nectar all day, which its belly converts into a high-powered fuel. If one is low on energy, others will share their nectar reserves.
cobblemon.species.navibri.name: Navibri
cobblemon.species.navibri.desc: It has a flawless sense of direction, and can memorize migratory routes across hundreds of miles. They act as scouts for the flock.
cobblemon.species.turbolibri.name: Turbolibri
cobblemon.species.turbolibri.desc: It has a flawless sense of direction, and can memorize migratory routes across hundreds of miles. They act as scouts for the flock.
cobblemon.species.alteranledian.name: AlteranLedian
cobblemon.species.alteranledian.desc: LEDIAN in Altera display unique patterns and behavior. It recklessly charges into battle, channeling star energy into its kicks and punches.
cobblemon.species.squrmy.name: Squrmy
cobblemon.species.squrmy.desc: Underestimated by many, this little worm dreams of greatness. However, its body is soft and vulnerable, so it hides underground most of the time.
cobblemon.species.durtwurm.name: Durtwurm
cobblemon.species.durtwurm.desc: It secretes a sticky substance that it uses to attach clods of dirt to its body as protection. It rolls its body like a wheel to get around quickly.
cobblemon.species.wurmiterra.name: Wurmiterra
cobblemon.species.wurmiterra.desc: It secretes a sticky substance that it uses to attach clods of dirt to its body as protection. It rolls its body like a wheel to get around quickly.
cobblemon.species.alteranowten.name: AlteranOwten
cobblemon.species.alteranowten.desc: Alteran OWTEN is beloved by many due to its cute appearance and lovely singing voice. It knows this, and is not above using cuteness to get what it wants
cobblemon.species.alteraneshouten.name: AlteranEshouten
cobblemon.species.alteraneshouten.desc: People and Mon of all sorts follow it around to hear it sing. Analyzing its songs has determined that it views these hangers-on with disdain.
cobblemon.species.tanupy.name: Tanupy
cobblemon.species.tanupy.desc: TANUPY have a keen sense of smell, and use it to locate food. They have been known to get into mischief stealing food from traveling Trainers.
cobblemon.species.tanscure.name: Tanscure
cobblemon.species.tanscure.desc: TANSCURE are sharp-eyed hunters known for traveling in packs. When raised carefully, they are loyal, but wild ones can be dangerous with their sharp fangs.
cobblemon.species.sluchuu.name: Sluchuu
cobblemon.species.sluchuu.desc: Although its appearance resembles PIKACHU, it is in fact a mollusk Pokemon more closely related to SHELLOS and GOOMY. It prefers a solitary lifestyle, and will not hesitate to shock those that disturb it.
cobblemon.species.gullitt.name: Gullitt
cobblemon.species.gullitt.desc: GULLITT will obsessively seek out and consume garbage, even when it has healthier options. Due to its toxic diet, no predators will touch it.
cobblemon.species.garbagull.name: Garbagull
cobblemon.species.garbagull.desc: It gluts itself on garbage until it grows too heavy to fly. It is one of the only known species that preys upon TRUBBISH and GARBODOR.
cobblemon.species.alterannidoranwinterco: AAn old lineage of NIDORAN. The males and females look alike, but come in two distinct coats. This formAspects lives out in areas blanketed by snow.
cobblemon.species.alterannidoransummerco: An old lineage of NIDORAN. The males and females look alike, but come in two distinct coats. Its dark coat blends in with dry, rugged terrain.
cobblemon.species.nidorimewintercoat.des: By migrating from colder regions to more temperate regions, this Mon can find better food and shelter to prepare for evolution.
cobblemon.species.nidorimesummercoat.des: From its usual arid habitat, it traverses long distances to temperate regions in order to find a more hospitable environment to evolve.
cobblemon.species.nidoregina.name: Nidoregina
cobblemon.species.nidoregina.desc: It dwells in palaces of snow, its striking white coat gleaming even brighter than its surroundings. Its greatest rival is NIDOREGUS.
cobblemon.species.nidoregus.name: Nidoregus
cobblemon.species.nidoregus.desc: Those with the largest horns lead armies of NIDORIME. It clashes with NIDOREGINA on the borders between hot and cold regions.
cobblemon.species.roadillo.name: Roadillo
cobblemon.species.roadillo.desc: It travels great distances by rolling its body into a wheel-like shape. Its durable outer shell allows it to roll over rough, uneven surfaces with ease.
cobblemon.species.armarauder.name: Armarauder
cobblemon.species.armarauder.desc: Aggressively territorial, they claim large stretches of highway as their turf. Known to travel in gangs, they will even run large trucks off the road.
cobblemon.species.pouchelet.name: Pouchelet
cobblemon.species.pouchelet.desc: Lately, more and more of them have made cities their home. It has the unfortunate habit of playing dead, even in the middle of the road.
cobblemon.species.grimmposs.name: Grimmposs
cobblemon.species.grimmposs.desc: Ever the survivalist, some departed POUCHELET rise as ghost Pokemon. Having lost its fear of collisions, it floats through everything with glee.
cobblemon.species.deepwishiwashi.name: DeepWishiwashi
cobblemon.species.deepwishiwashi.desc: A variant Wishiwashi that dwells in dark caves and deep oceans. It uses the lights from its scales to communicate with others in its school.
cobblemon.species.salmini.name: Salmini
cobblemon.species.salmini.desc: When it finds things on the riverbed, it tends to carry them around in its mouth. Some think its preferences can help predict how it evolves.
cobblemon.species.salmosaultfreshwater.d: SALMINI that mature in fresh water evolve into this formAspects. It's fierce and territorial, and loves throwing stones as much as collecting them.
cobblemon.species.salmosaultsaltwater.de: SALMINI that mature in salty water evolve into this formAspects. It carries a shell that it plays like a trumpet. Getting interrupted infuriates it.
cobblemon.species.taroot.name: Taroot
cobblemon.species.taroot.desc: It buries itself in the ground to avoid being eaten, but its leaf always sticks out. It is highly nutritious and targeted by many for food.
cobblemon.species.daikongus.name: Daikongus
cobblemon.species.daikongus.desc: It uses its hefty body to crush opponents. It is so heavy that its stomp attacks create tremors in the ground, scaring off predators to TAROOT.
cobblemon.species.alteranshroomish.name: AlteranShroomish
cobblemon.species.alteranshroomish.desc: With its striking red cap, it sticks out in its forest habitat. Because it carries such a potent toxin, predators know to leave it alone.
cobblemon.species.alteranbreloom.name: AlteranBreloom
cobblemon.species.alteranbreloom.desc: Its strikes have less force behind them than its cousins from Hoenn. However, the deadly spores it delivers with each blow definitely pack a punch!
cobblemon.species.brontoloom.name: Brontoloom
cobblemon.species.brontoloom.desc: Breloom evolved after accumulating toxins in its cells. Poisonous mushrooms grow along the trails it makes as it plods through the forest.
cobblemon.species.magief.name: Magief
cobblemon.species.magief.desc: They are perceptive Pokemon able to see shiny objects from several miles away. They are known to horde treasures for the leaders of their flock.
cobblemon.species.corsuave.name: Corsuave
cobblemon.species.corsuave.desc: CORSUAVE are intelligent Pokemon employing cunning strategies to defeat enemies or evade threats. This nature makes them difficult to work with.
cobblemon.species.alteranzorua.name: AlteranZorua
cobblemon.species.alteranzorua.desc: An old fable describes a ZORUA cloaked in so many illusions that it turned into one itself. This formAspects is said to be its descendant.
cobblemon.species.zorotsune.name: Zorotsune
cobblemon.species.zorotsune.desc: Illusory beings constantly waft from the smoke that billows from this Mon's body. When its tricks get exposed, it slinks away into its pipe.
cobblemon.species.nursa.name: Nursa
cobblemon.species.nursa.desc: The mild shocks it delivers through its paw pads have a healing effect. It can use slightly stronger shocks to revive fainted Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.cuspide.name: Cuspide
cobblemon.species.cuspide.desc: Scientists have found that its exoskeleton has a similar composition to tooth enamel. For good health, it should be brushed twice daily.
cobblemon.species.tarandible.name: Tarandible
cobblemon.species.tarandible.desc: It lies still during the day, disguised as a Pokemon's skull. As it prowls at night, it makes an eerie noise that sounds like rattling bones.
cobblemon.species.gunafix.name: Gunafix
cobblemon.species.gunafix.desc: In the wild, it picks apart rocks deep underground to feed on rare ores. It has adapted to urban environments by taking refuge in factories.
cobblemon.species.fixinit.name: Fixinit
cobblemon.species.fixinit.desc: When properly trained, it can easily troubleshoot machinery. However, it loves to take things apart, so it can't be left unsupervised.
cobblemon.species.artifixt.name: Artifixt
cobblemon.species.artifixt.desc: When it gets going, it can disassemble then reassemble a car within minutes. Its tail spanners seem to have a mind of their own.
cobblemon.species.comite.name: Comite
cobblemon.species.comite.desc: It can retract its legs into its body and appear to be an ordinary rock. Stories say they arrived on an asteroid hundreds of years ago.
cobblemon.species.cometeor.name: Cometeor
cobblemon.species.cometeor.desc: It levitates in the air with powerful psychic energy. The crystals on its body flash many colors when it meets another of its kind.
cobblemon.species.astronite.name: Astronite
cobblemon.species.astronite.desc: It levitates in the air with powerful psychic energy. The crystals on its body flash many colors when it meets another of its kind.
cobblemon.species.spelotl.name: Spelotl
cobblemon.species.spelotl.desc: A bubble serves as a lens to amplify its psychic powers, letting it perceive the pitch-dark caves it lives in with perfect clarity.
cobblemon.species.salamancer.name: Salamancer
cobblemon.species.salamancer.desc: By focusing its power through a stalactite, SALAMANCER can manipulate water. It blocks passage into its lair by putting up watery barriers.
cobblemon.species.ledlite.name: Ledlite
cobblemon.species.ledlite.desc: When it draws in electric current through its tail, its head starts glowing. It can stay lit for a whole month on an hour's worth of charge.
cobblemon.species.insulatex.name: Insulatex
cobblemon.species.insulatex.desc: Its entire body is a battery that can store and discharge power at 99% efficiency. If it overcharges, it enters a wild frenzy.
cobblemon.species.negawatt.name: Negawatt
cobblemon.species.negawatt.desc: Its ruptured head constantly leaks power, requiring it to consume large amounts of electricity. It causes blackouts by attacking power lines.
cobblemon.species.sputya.name: Sputya
cobblemon.species.sputya.desc: It was created to assist in space exploration. Instead of rocket fuel, it converts sunlight into psychic energy for propulsion.
cobblemon.species.flager.name: Flager
cobblemon.species.flager.desc: A playful and somewhat feisty species that can often be a challenge for inexperienced trainers due to how energetic they are. FLAGER use their large paws to bat at any small moving object, including their own burning tails.
cobblemon.species.inflagetah.name: Inflagetah
cobblemon.species.inflagetah.desc: Its slim body is streamlined to be as aerodynamic as possible. It moves faster than the eye can follow, leaving a blazing trail behind.
cobblemon.species.jerbolta.name: Jerbolta
cobblemon.species.jerbolta.desc: The spines on its back stand rigid when charged with electricity. It is popular with children and young trainers due to its gentle demeanor.
cobblemon.species.karmilarie.name: Karmilarie
cobblemon.species.karmilarie.desc: When hunting, it generates inaudible but highly destructive sound waves. If it can't feed on life energy, it subsists on electricity.
cobblemon.species.alteranekans.name: AlteranEkans
cobblemon.species.alteranekans.desc: Alteran EKANS wrestle their prey rather than use venom. When faced with tougher foes, it wraps its body into a wheel shape and rolls away at high speed.
cobblemon.species.alteranarbok.name: AlteranArbok
cobblemon.species.alteranarbok.desc: Alteran ARBOK has developed a longer tail compared to its Kantonian formAspects, allowing it to wrangle prey with ease or let loose a flurry of powerful whips.
cobblemon.species.scarablaze.name: Scarablaze
cobblemon.species.scarablaze.desc: It gathers detritus into a fiery ball that it kicks around wherever it goes. Some ancient cultures believed this ball was a fragment of the sun.
cobblemon.species.cactana.name: Cactana
cobblemon.species.cactana.desc: It burrows into the ground to avoid the sun, its tail peeking out so it can still photosynthesize. It looks just like a regular cactus this way.
cobblemon.species.alteranhagoop.name: AlteranHagoop
cobblemon.species.alteranhagoop.desc: Its soft, fleshy body is coated in highly corrosive, high-temperature slime that ignites on contact with the air. It thrives in volcanic areas.
cobblemon.species.haagmaa.name: Haagmaa
cobblemon.species.haagmaa.desc: It melts down minerals and stores the byproducts in its abdomen. Though it lacks eyes, the feelers on its head can sense the tiniest vibrations.
cobblemon.species.flintling.name: Flintling
cobblemon.species.flintling.desc: Pieces of its stony hide were once fashioned into arrowheads. There is evidence that Flintling themselves were flung directly as weapons.
cobblemon.species.obsygnus.name: Obsygnus
cobblemon.species.obsygnus.desc: Its body is formed from razor-sharp volcanic glass. By superheating the blades on its forelegs, it can slice effortlessly through concrete.
cobblemon.species.emberge.name: Emberge
cobblemon.species.emberge.desc: This Pokemon is born at sites of calamitous fires. Though still hot to the touch, its flames only burn at 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
cobblemon.species.glubble.name: Glubble
cobblemon.species.glubble.desc: It sits in high places with its mouth wide open to gather rainwater. If it dries up, it stops moving.
cobblemon.species.garblgoyle.name: Garblgoyle
cobblemon.species.garblgoyle.desc: Legend says it started crying when its Draconian creators disappeared. However, modern science reveals this is simply its biology.
cobblemon.species.aerapin.name: Aerapin
cobblemon.species.aerapin.desc: It can retract its legs into its body and appear to be an ordinary rock. Stories say they arrived on an asteroid hundreds of years ago.
cobblemon.species.albashell.name: Albashell
cobblemon.species.albashell.desc: It has a calm demeanor and enjoys ferrying passengers on its back. They are commonly employed as an airborne taxi service throughout Altera.
cobblemon.species.amperincus.name: Amperincus
cobblemon.species.amperincus.desc: The resurrected ghost of a pterosaur Pokémon that lived long ago. The reason for its revival is unclear. It enjoys causing mayhem and making loud noises.
cobblemon.species.ramhorn.name: Ramhorn
cobblemon.species.ramhorn.desc: Ramhorn are capable of scaling near-vertical cliff faces with ease. Their diet is rich in minerals found on seaside bluffs.
cobblemon.species.purrchance.name: Purrchance
cobblemon.species.grizzlet.name: Grizzlet
cobblemon.species.grizzlet.desc: It can retract its legs into its body and appear to be an ordinary rock. Stories say they arrived on an asteroid hundreds of years ago.
cobblemon.species.geogriff.name: Geogriff
cobblemon.species.geogriff.desc: When the tiny crystals that continuously grow from beneath its fur shatter, it enters a state of hibernation, and emerges months later with a sharper set.
cobblemon.species.diastryx.name: Diastryx
cobblemon.species.diastryx.desc: A powerful apex predator. It claims entire mountains as its territory, gliding high above and using its keen eyesight to detect any intruders or threats.
cobblemon.species.alteranmeowth.name: AlteranMeowth
cobblemon.species.alteranmeowth.desc: Egg move: Roulette: Deals a random effect to the entire field after dealing damage. For more information, see its entry on the Pokemon Flux Wiki.
cobblemon.species.eucuwala.name: Eucuwala
cobblemon.species.eucuwala.desc: Eucuwala spends the day collecting leaves in the forest canopy. If two Eucuwalas encounter each other, they swap leaves to taste different parts of the forest.
cobblemon.species.gulacuff.name: Gulacuff
cobblemon.species.gulacuff.desc: Gulacuff eats leaves from the trees in its territory. If it runs into another Gulacuff, it will fight, and the winner gets all the leaves the loser has collected.
cobblemon.species.timberawl.name: Timberawl
cobblemon.species.timberawl.desc: Timberawl's punch is so hard, it can knock over a large tree. It whacks trees with its large fists and collects the leaves that fall, until it has eaten its weight in foliage.
cobblemon.species.reptling.name: Reptling
cobblemon.species.reptling.desc: Reptling possesses both reptilian and avian traits. Some say that, millions of years ago, it gained its feathers and wings to survive the attacks of predators.
cobblemon.species.rapteror.name: Rapteror
cobblemon.species.rapteror.desc: Rapteror circles its foe from the sky, and strikes when the enemy is looking away. Its body is made of tightly packed foliage, so it is very light and can make amazing maneuvers in the air.
cobblemon.species.velosaur.name: Velosaur
cobblemon.species.velosaur.desc: Velosaur's wings and scales are made from tough bark that is hard enough to protect it, but light enough to allow it to fly. The scales on Velosaur's back resemble the markings on many poisonous plants near its nesting grounds.
cobblemon.species.yetini.name: Yetini
cobblemon.species.yeteen.name: Yeteen
cobblemon.species.yetitan.name: Yetitan
cobblemon.species.yetitan.desc: 41 Crystal Defense Ice 44 Giga DrainSTAB Grass 47 Roar Normal 51 Ice HammerSTAB Ice 58 Wood HammerSTAB Grass
cobblemon.species.kindlemur.name: Kindlemur
cobblemon.species.kindlemur.desc: Kindlemur swings through the trees searching for dead wood, which it uses to make large fires on the ground. It does this to keep itself warm at night.
cobblemon.species.burmurly.name: Burmurly
cobblemon.species.burmurly.desc: Burmurly swings though the trees with such speed that it has been nicknamed 'the Flaming Flash'. It's very careful not to set the branches from which it swings aflame.
cobblemon.species.merculey.name: Merculey
cobblemon.species.merculey.desc: Merculey's body is filled with a hot acid that makes it very light. It is able to flip and spin to dodge enemy attacks, but it can also use the liquid for hot acid attacks.
cobblemon.species.woolvry.name: Woolvry
cobblemon.species.woolvry.desc: Woolvry has a scarf around its body which keeps its body warm to make fire come out. If the scarf is removed it will die.
cobblemon.species.clokruel.name: Clokruel
cobblemon.species.smoldrine.name: Smoldrine
cobblemon.species.smoldrine.desc: It has thick bands of hair wrapped around its body for protection. It can be vicious and dangerous in the wild, but it is rarely seen outside of captivity.
cobblemon.species.batorch.name: Batorch
cobblemon.species.batrix.name: Batrix
cobblemon.species.vamfire.name: Vamfire
cobblemon.species.vamfire.desc: Lash Out Dark Blast BurnSTAB Fire Burning JealousySTAB Fire Fire PledgeSTAB Fire Heat WaveSTAB Fire Dual Wingbeat Flying Scorching Sands Ground Endeavor Normal Snore Normal Uproar Normal Iron Defense Steel Steel BeamSTAB Steel Steel RollerSTAB Steel U-turn Bug X-Scissor Bug Brutal Swing Dark Nasty Plot Dark Thief Dark Dragon Claw Dragon Charge Beam Electric Thunder Electric Thunderbolt Electric Thunder Wave Electric Cuddle Fairy Brick Break Fighting Focus Blast Fighting Rock Smash Fighting Fire BlastSTAB Fire FlamethrowerSTAB Fire Sunny Day Fire Acrobatics Flying Aerial Ace Flying Shadow Ball Ghost Solar Beam Grass Bulldoze Ground Dig Ground Earthquake Ground Landslide Ground Attract Normal Confide Normal Cut Normal Double Team Normal Double-Edge Normal Facade Normal Frustration Normal Giga Impact Normal Heartfelt Pulse Normal Hidden Power Normal Hyper Beam Normal Protect Normal Return Normal Round Normal Safeguard Normal Sleep Talk Normal Strength Normal Substitute Normal Swagger Normal Swords Dance Normal Work Up Normal Toxic Poison Psyshock Psychic Rest Psychic Rock Slide Rock Rock Tomb Rock Sandstorm Rock Stone Edge Rock Gyro BallSTAB Steel
cobblemon.species.dimetrus.name: Dimetrus
cobblemon.species.dimetrus.desc: Dimetrus uses its large fin to catch currents in the ocean. It can travel many miles using very little energy by doing this, but it is very slow on land.
cobblemon.species.permidon.name: Permidon
cobblemon.species.permidon.desc: Permidon has large fins on its arms which it uses to swim upstream. Permidon can do amazing tricks underwater, but on land it is very slow.
cobblemon.species.lividon.name: Lividon
cobblemon.species.lividon.desc: Lividon is known for its bad temper. It often sleeps on the ocean floor, and if it is awoken it will become furious and attack anything in the area.
cobblemon.species.liqueel.name: Liqueel
cobblemon.species.liqueel.desc: Liqueel's long tail whips through the water as it swims, making it very fast. Some Liqueel use their tails to fight while trying to protect others.
cobblemon.species.electeel.name: Electeel
cobblemon.species.electeel.desc: The electrical current that runs through its body is very powerful. When in danger, Electeel load electricity into their dorsal fins, then discharge it as a powerful shock wave.
cobblemon.species.emporeel.name: Emporeel
cobblemon.species.emporeel.desc: Emporeel's body is so long that when it walks on land, it curls up into very tight coils, which they also do when preparing to launch an electrical attack. The longer the Emporeel, the more powerful its electricity is.
cobblemon.species.lochsea.name: Lochsea
cobblemon.species.nesshoal.name: Nesshoal
cobblemon.species.psyren.name: Psyren
cobblemon.species.aromutt.name: Aromutt
cobblemon.species.aromutt.desc: Aromutt has an amazing sense of smell that lets it seek out lost people and things. It is known as the Domestic Pokemon because it can only be found in captivity. It only lives with humans in cities and towns.
cobblemon.species.odorog.name: Odorog
cobblemon.species.odorog.desc: Odorog has such an amazing sense of smell that it can always smell its way home, hence it never gets lost. It is said that once Odorog smells you, it can track you down anywhere within a 200 mile-radius (320 kilometer-radius).
cobblemon.species.chinchul.name: Chinchul
cobblemon.species.chinchul.desc: Chinchul is treasured by many trainers because of its soft fur, so the softer the fur, the more desired the Chinchul. Even some trainers give it food for its soft fur.
cobblemon.species.chilleap.name: Chilleap
cobblemon.species.chilleap.desc: Though Chilleap's bushy tail is made of fur, it packs a powerful punch. The tail is both thick and heavy, so using the leverage Chilleap gets from its body, it can knock out a foe.
cobblemon.species.chiquail.name: Chiquail
cobblemon.species.chiquail.desc: Chiquail uses the feather on its head to feel which way the wind is blowing. It cannot fly very well but if it catches the wind just right it can sashay into the sky.
cobblemon.species.mavriquail.name: Mavriquail
cobblemon.species.mavriquail.desc: Mavriquail glides through the air with amazing precision by using the feather on its head. From 100 feet in the air it can land on a twig going at top speeds.
cobblemon.species.jayzul.name: Jayzul
cobblemon.species.jayzul.desc: Jayzul's song is very beautiful, so they are loved by many Trainers. They make their nests in trees along paths and pick up crumbs left behind by wandering adventurers.
cobblemon.species.jayzure.name: Jayzure
cobblemon.species.jayzure.desc: Jayzure's blue feathers help it blend into the sky so that it can sneak up on its prey. It also often sneaks up on trainers passing through its territory and pecks them until they leave. It is very aggressive, especially if it's protecting its eggs.
cobblemon.species.hoppiler.name: Hoppiler
cobblemon.species.hoppiler.desc: Hoppiler can jump very high because of its powerful legs. This enables it to escape many foes and breed plentifully.
cobblemon.species.cobworm.name: Cobworm
cobblemon.species.cobworm.desc: When Hoppiler gets caught in a web, it evolves into a form with a hard outer shell to protect itself. Cobworm uses the net as a thick shield against attacking Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.hoppereign.name: Hoppereign
cobblemon.species.hoppereign.desc: Hoppereign has extremely powerful legs, which allow it to spring into the air at any moment, where it can then glide using its large wings. A hard shell covers its body and protects it from many harsh physical attacks.
cobblemon.species.rollip.name: Rollip
cobblemon.species.rollip.desc: Rollip can roll up into a tight ball. It uses this ability to attack and defend itself. Though it is slow on foot, it can roll very fast as a ball.
cobblemon.species.rollipod.name: Rollipod
cobblemon.species.rollipod.desc: Rollipod is curled up into a ball. Its body is changing and growing stronger. When it gets strong enough it will open back up and evolve.
cobblemon.species.isopanzer.name: Isopanzer
cobblemon.species.isopanzer.desc: Evo Barrage Normal - Defense Curl Normal - Scuttle HopSTAB Bug - Bug BiteSTAB Bug - Tackle Normal - PinchSTAB Bug - Harden Normal - Quick Attack Normal - Lock-On Normal - Mud Bomb Ground - Mud Shot Ground 11 Thread LashSTAB Bug 15 Bide Normal 19 Barrage Normal 23 Struggle BugSTAB Bug 29 Iron Defense Steel 32 SteamrollerSTAB Bug 35 Focus Energy Normal 38 Gyro BallSTAB Steel 42 Rolling Press Fighting 45 Rebound StrikeSTAB Steel 49 Leech LifeSTAB Bug 54 Flash CannonSTAB Steel 59 Zap Cannon Electric
cobblemon.species.ploworm.name: Ploworm
cobblemon.species.ploworm.desc: Ploworm digs through the soil underground using the large tooth on its head. It is more commonly seen during the rainy season because it dislikes the wet soil. It has also been spotted in...
cobblemon.species.lumbrill.name: Lumbrill
cobblemon.species.lumbrill.desc: Lumbrill digs through thick layers of stone underground. Its hard steel body protects it from intense pressure and magma streams that it may run into. It is often used by treasure hunters...
cobblemon.species.baybolt.name: Baybolt
cobblemon.species.baybolt.desc: Baybolt lives in the canopy of the Junnin trees. In certain areas it has become the cause of forest fires because it sometimes attracts lightning, which strikes the trees around it.
cobblemon.species.bolteen.name: Bolteen
cobblemon.species.bolteen.desc: Bolteen's ears build up and store electricity, which it then uses for powerful attacks. Small amounts of the stored electricity is also spread through Bolteen's body while it swings through trees.
cobblemon.species.dandyseed.name: Dandyseed
cobblemon.species.dandyseed.desc: Dandyseed is so light it is almost always being carried by the wind. It only stops when it lands and sticks into the ground.
cobblemon.species.dandylie.name: Dandylie
cobblemon.species.dandylie.desc: It is known as the weed Pokemon because after one Dandylie is seen, others start to appear all over in the area. The large buds on its hands and tail are good for physical attacks.
cobblemon.species.withereen.name: Withereen
cobblemon.species.withereen.desc: When the wind blows, seeds fall from Withereen's dried gray body. Some say a wish is granted every time Withereen's seeds are blown into the air.
cobblemon.species.quartzac.name: Quartzac
cobblemon.species.quartzac.desc: Quartzac has a shiny, almost transparent body composed completely of quartz. There are several different colours of Quartzac made from different types of quartz.
cobblemon.species.equazar.name: Equazar
cobblemon.species.equazar.desc: Equazar refracts light in its body causing its enemy to become confused. It can also equalize the light to make itself shine brightly.
cobblemon.species.campyre.name: Campyre
cobblemon.species.campyre.desc: Campyres typically are born from a trainer burning a special type of wood. They love to provide warmth to others and are generally very well-mannered when looked over regularly.
cobblemon.species.wildyre.name: Wildyre
cobblemon.species.wildyre.desc: Campyres typically grow out of control when left unattended, thus causing an evolution into Wildyre. Wildyre are much more fierce and chaotic than their previous evolution, and only want to spread flame.
cobblemon.species.bloatick.name: Bloatick
cobblemon.species.bloatick.desc: Bloatick sucks the energy from its foe until it is blown up like a balloon. It can either use the energy to heal itself, or send back a powerful attack.
cobblemon.species.suckeeto.name: Suckeeto
cobblemon.species.suckeeto.desc: Suckeeto has a large needle on its face which it uses to drain the energy from its enemies. It also sucks the nutrients from trees when it is deep in the forest.
cobblemon.species.stalad.name: Stalad
cobblemon.species.stelimight.name: Stelimight
cobblemon.species.cavernight.name: Cavernight
cobblemon.species.sandstrum.name: Sandstrum
cobblemon.species.sandstrum.desc: Sandstrum hides under the sand on the beach. Trainers sometimes step on it and are surprised when the ground starts to move from under their feet.
cobblemon.species.sanderon.name: Sanderon
cobblemon.species.sanderon.desc: Sanderon's body is made of hard compacted sand. It often sleeps under the sand on a beach and and waits for unsuspecting people or Pokemon to step on its large horn.
cobblemon.species.shoreking.name: Shoreking
cobblemon.species.antini.name: Antini
cobblemon.species.insignel.name: Insignel
cobblemon.species.stagnel.name: Stagnel
cobblemon.species.stagnel.desc: There have been many sightings of Stagnel gathered in the deserts in large quantities, standing still and looking up at the sky. It's completely unknown why they do this.
cobblemon.species.buffhilla.name: Buffhilla
cobblemon.species.buffhilla.desc: Slow and peaceful, Buffhila spend their lives ruminating on the foot hills and fields below large mountains. They stay in groups and protect weaker siblings with their rock hard bodies.
cobblemon.species.bisommit.name: Bisommit
cobblemon.species.bisommit.desc: Easily spooked, their thunderous hooves on the plain can be heard from miles off. Many believe that Bisommit has a connection to the mountains and can cause earthquakes.
cobblemon.species.coyoco.name: Coyoco
cobblemon.species.coyoco.desc: When Coyoco howl, their body compresses and fire spews from their mouth. Its body acts as a bag coated with a fireproof lining filled with hot coals.
cobblemon.species.stuckarp.name: Stuckarp
cobblemon.species.stuckarp.desc: Stuckarp fastens itself to rocks and other objects by using its suction cup mouth. Its hold is so strong that it can stick to a surface for several days.
cobblemon.species.stuckry.name: Stuckry
cobblemon.species.stuckry.desc: Stuckry's flat body has tiny suction cups that allow it to stick to any surface. If in danger, Stuckry will lay flat and protect itself with its hard plated back.
cobblemon.species.plubus.name: Plubus
cobblemon.species.plubus.desc: Because it lives in dark cave water, Publus has no eyes. It can feel vibrations to make its way through the caverns while searching for food.
cobblemon.species.salamink.name: Salamink
cobblemon.species.salamink.desc: Salamink uses the gills on its side to feel the flow of water so it can navigate its way through dark cave water. It is sometimes seen in deep parts of the ocean.
cobblemon.species.frostoss.name: Frostoss
cobblemon.species.frostoss.desc: Frostoss loves to throw snowballs. It has an amazing aim, which is unfortunate for people or Pokemon passing by, but it only does this for fun and never gets mad.
cobblemon.species.kaboo.name: Kaboo
cobblemon.species.kaboo.desc: A grenade Pokemon who mourns the death from past battles at battle grounds.
cobblemon.species.membry.name: Membry
cobblemon.species.fawntia.name: Fawntia
cobblemon.species.reindolph.name: Reindolph
cobblemon.species.reindolph.desc: Reindolph can fly through the air for short distances. No one knows how it can do this, but some suspect it has to do with its crystal hooves.
cobblemon.species.bansheet.name: Bansheet
cobblemon.species.bansheet.desc: Bansheet resembles a sheet. If someone were to lift it, there would be nothing underneath. It was first spotted in the workshop of a tailor.
cobblemon.species.teepolter.name: Teepolter
cobblemon.species.hoodloom.name: Hoodloom
cobblemon.species.hoodloom.desc: Hoodloom typically hides in dark alleyways, and always looking for stuff to loot. They don't like working together, but will team up if it needs to.
cobblemon.species.cloacover.name: Cloacover
cobblemon.species.cloacover.desc: Cloacover are a preferred Pokemon amongst criminal organizations due to their innate evilness. They command Hoodloom, making them collect all sorts of shiny objects in exchange for poffins.
cobblemon.species.indascent.name: Indascent
cobblemon.species.lamplume.name: Lamplume
cobblemon.species.bottoil.name: Bottoil
cobblemon.species.cuncoldron.name: Cuncoldron
cobblemon.species.tarift.name: Tarift
cobblemon.species.tarift.desc: It was believed that Tarift was a different Pokemon millions of years ago, but got stuck in the tar pits and turned into what it is today. Its body is composed mainly of a thick tar that absorbs physical attacks quite well.
cobblemon.species.tarzorus.name: Tarzorus
cobblemon.species.tarzorus.desc: Tarzorus lives deep in tar pits and rarely comes up unless it is disturbed. Legend says it used to be a land dwelling Pokemon that sunk into the tar pits and transformed.
cobblemon.species.tuttby.name: Tuttby
cobblemon.species.tuttby.desc: Tuttby has two dots on its head that act as eyes. Some say the eyes can see into the afterlife and allow it to communicate with passed spirits.
cobblemon.species.whiscleo.name: Whiscleo
cobblemon.species.whiscleo.desc: Whiscleo has large ears that can hear from many miles away. Ancient writings say that it can hear the voices of the past and future as well.
cobblemon.species.pharoar.name: Pharoar
cobblemon.species.pharoar.desc: Pharoar is known as the king of the desert. Ancient writings say it once controlled human beings, who would build giant shrines in honour of their master.
cobblemon.species.equia.name: Equia
cobblemon.species.treiarch.name: Treiarch
cobblemon.species.andromini.name: Andromini
cobblemon.species.smettle.name: Smettle
cobblemon.species.smettle.desc: Smettle is a mischievous Pokemon. It likes to use its quills to make fun of other Pokemon, which doesn't attract it friends.
cobblemon.species.smyucca.name: Smyucca
cobblemon.species.smyucca.desc: Smyucca has a very aggressive temperament. It is strongly forbidden to rub against its sharp spines.
cobblemon.species.demonagave.name: Demonagave
cobblemon.species.demonagave.desc: Demonagave's body is entirely covered by spines. Its Needle Arm is often fatal.
cobblemon.species.pachyball.name: Pachyball
cobblemon.species.pachyball.desc: When Pachyball sneezes, sprays of magma come out of its trunk, burning everything in their path. Before falling asleep, it rolls itself into a ball to keep its body warm, which earned it its name.
cobblemon.species.pachyndou.name: Pachyndou
cobblemon.species.pachyndou.desc: Pachyndou's psychic powers and bright colors are an excellent protection against potential predators. When it feels threatened, smoke comes out of the hole on its head.
cobblemon.species.pachyvory.name: Pachyvory
cobblemon.species.pachyvory.desc: Pachyvory's tusks are very resistant. When they become too big, it melts the end with its fiery breath.
cobblemon.species.squini.name: Squini
cobblemon.species.squini.desc: The harpoon-shaped cap on Squini's head can be illuminated so that it is not lost from sight by its fellows. It emits less and less light as it gets ready to evolve.
cobblemon.species.squinja.name: Squinja
cobblemon.species.squinja.desc: Squinja is a fast and accurate fighter. It generally prefers to keep its enemies at a distance, but is quite capable of close combat.
cobblemon.species.squartial.name: Squartial
cobblemon.species.squartial.desc: Squartial never takes rash risks. Each of its moves is well thought out. Contrary to its pre-evolutions, it is relatively solitary.
cobblemon.species.wormini.name: Wormini
cobblemon.species.wormini.desc: Wormini spends its time digging in the ground and rarely sees the light of day.
cobblemon.species.wormeel.name: Wormeel
cobblemon.species.wormeel.desc: Wormini spends its time digging in the ground and rarely sees the light of day.
cobblemon.species.malarva.name: Malarva
cobblemon.species.malarva.desc: Malarva is a parasite that likes to settle on large Pokemon to feed on their blood. It is said that the first strains of the Pokerus were found on this Pokemon and that it is the cause of its propagation.
cobblemon.species.mosdeng.name: Mosdeng
cobblemon.species.mosdeng.desc: Mosdeng lives in wetlands and attacks in packs, which makes it more dangerous. However, it remains very vulnerable to Swellow which make it one of their favorite meals.
cobblemon.species.mosboom.name: Mosboom
cobblemon.species.mosboom.desc: Mosboom is able to explode in the face of predators to protect its offspring as soon as the need arises. When it stings its preys, it inoculates a very powerful poison capable of making a Ursaring fall in 5 seconds.
cobblemon.species.antager.name: Antager
cobblemon.species.antager.desc: Antager is small but don't be fooled by appearances, it can lift up to 50 times its weight.
cobblemon.species.antoldier.name: Antoldier
cobblemon.species.antoldier.desc: Antoldier have an extraordinary power, they can lift a Snorlax without any efforts. They are used in mines to help humans.
cobblemon.species.hamerry.name: Hamerry
cobblemon.species.hamerry.desc: Hamerry is a very popular Pokemon among children. Its cheeks give off a sweet smell, and give it a very friendly look.
cobblemon.species.hamysos.name: Hamysos
cobblemon.species.hamysos.desc: Hamysos is a festive Pokemon. It is said that its cheeks are actually large Ceriz berries, and that tasting them causes a euphoric state.
cobblemon.species.goatanaa.name: Goatanaa
cobblemon.species.goatanaa.desc: Goatanaa lives in the mountains. It moves according to the weather, when it is hot, it seeks the coolness in the heights and when the winter arrives, it goes down in the valleys.
cobblemon.species.goaturly.name: Goaturly
cobblemon.species.goaturly.desc: Goaturly is bred for its precious wool, which is both soft and resistant. It is used to make rich clothes. It is in perpetual conflict with Frison because of their ego.
cobblemon.species.pomara.name: Pomara
cobblemon.species.pomara.desc: Pomara live near lakes and rivers. They like to gather to parade at the water's edge.
cobblemon.species.dashean.name: Dashean
cobblemon.species.dashean.desc: Dashean is a sea horse. It is able to gallop on the water at impressive speeds.
cobblemon.species.boonny.name: Boonny
cobblemon.species.boonny.desc: Boonny's body is essentially made of meteorite, which does not prevent it from jumping extremely high.
cobblemon.species.rabball.name: Rabball
cobblemon.species.rabball.desc: After evolution, this Pokemon is enclosed in a meteoric shell. It is able to resist the trampling of a horde of Tauros.
cobblemon.species.lagorite.name: Lagorite
cobblemon.species.lagorite.desc: Lagorite uses its arms as both a shield and a sharp blade. A Meteor Mash from this Pokemon knocks out a Rhydon
cobblemon.species.epochbulbasaur.name: EpochBulbasaur
cobblemon.species.epochbulbasaur.desc: They are attracted to shiny crystals and seek nourishment from sapping the energy of other crystals to empower the one on its own back.
cobblemon.species.epochivysaur.name: EpochIvysaur
cobblemon.species.epochivysaur.desc: It has become so deeply intertwined with its crystal that any poacher that seeks to take its crystal will inevitably kill this creature too.
cobblemon.species.epochvenusaur.name: EpochVenusaur
cobblemon.species.epochvenusaur.desc: It is able to make the various crystals on its back turn into different colours as a way of attracting mates.
cobblemon.species.epochcharmander.name: EpochCharmander
cobblemon.species.epochcharmander.desc: It enjoys playing in the mud of certain badlands or barren areas. They prefer to live alone or in very small family units.
cobblemon.species.epochcharmeleon.name: EpochCharmeleon
cobblemon.species.epochcharmeleon.desc: Sometimes found in rocky, mountainous regions, they are adept mountain climbers and can scale uneven terrains with ease.
cobblemon.species.epochcharizard.name: EpochCharizard
cobblemon.species.epochcharizard.desc: Its skin is very oily. It is unclear what substance hangs off its wings, as any previous attempts to harvest some have angered it greatly.
cobblemon.species.epochkoffing.name: EpochKoffing
cobblemon.species.epochkoffing.desc: The result of unifying poisonous gas, steam and a superheated atmosphere. Highly volatile, these Koffing are capable of spewing fireballs.
cobblemon.species.epochweezing.name: EpochWeezing
cobblemon.species.epochweezing.desc: The superheated atmosphere of a volcano makes their chemical composition far more unstable and likely to attract more gaseous tumours on its body.
cobblemon.species.epochgastly.name: EpochGastly
cobblemon.species.epochgastly.desc: Whenever hail falls, you can likely credit a Gastly as being responsible for starting it.
cobblemon.species.epochhaunter.name: EpochHaunter
cobblemon.species.epochhaunter.desc: Haunters are mischievous creatures. Their command of ice allows them to set up icy traps for unsuspecting passerbys.
cobblemon.species.epochgengar.name: EpochGengar
cobblemon.species.epochgengar.desc: Due to its mastery of cloud systems, Gengars are capable of summoning powerful hailstorms and blizzards at will.
cobblemon.species.epochdoduo.name: EpochDoduo
cobblemon.species.epochdoduo.desc: It can channel the power of the night sky into its attacks. It forgoes physical violence in favour of attacking from afar with its nascent mind.
cobblemon.species.epochdodrio.name: EpochDodrio
cobblemon.species.epochdodrio.desc: It is rumoured that each of its heads are simultaneously looking into different timelines and universes to anticipate enemy attacks.
cobblemon.species.epochekans.name: EpochEkans
cobblemon.species.epochekans.desc: The rhythmic sound of an Ekans's tail is enough to put its foe to resting when it can then move in to consume it whole.
cobblemon.species.epocharbok.name: EpochArbok
cobblemon.species.epocharbok.desc: The poison of an Arbok is so corrosive that it can melt steel beams. It is able to manipulate the face on its body into different shapes to fool its prey.
cobblemon.species.epochstaryu.name: EpochStaryu
cobblemon.species.epochstaryu.desc: They are commonly found in caves, rich in ore and other minerals. Its body is translucent and light to the touch.
cobblemon.species.epochstarmie.name: EpochStarmie
cobblemon.species.epochstarmie.desc: It is often mistaken for precious gems because it is able to change its appearance to suit every colour of the rainbow.
cobblemon.species.epochonix.name: EpochOnix
cobblemon.species.epochonix.desc: It can easily blend itself into the surroundings of a glacier. Some explorers have confused sudden movement of a glacier with the movement of an Onix.
cobblemon.species.epochzubat.name: EpochZubat
cobblemon.species.epochzubat.desc: They are naughty Pokemon and often will pull pranks on travelers passing by in their cave.
cobblemon.species.epochgolbat.name: EpochGolbat
cobblemon.species.epochgolbat.desc: Its teeth are much sharper and are capable of draining blood. It is known for its rapid speed and stealth.
cobblemon.species.epochtangela.name: EpochTangela
cobblemon.species.epochtangela.desc: Despite its appearance, it is very lightweight. It is very susceptible to strong breezes and can be knocked around easily.
cobblemon.species.epochmagikarp.name: EpochMagikarp
cobblemon.species.epochmagikarp.desc: This Pokemon is found only in deep water where the current tends to be weaker. It uses its antennae to attract prey.
cobblemon.species.epochgyarados.name: EpochGyarados
cobblemon.species.epochgyarados.desc: It is able to sense movement in the water and can swim quietly. It keeps its eyes closed right up until it opens its mouth to consume its prey.
cobblemon.species.epochponyta.name: EpochPonyta
cobblemon.species.epochponyta.desc: It runs so fast that it looks like it disappears into shadow only to return with a blaze.
cobblemon.species.epochrapidash.name: EpochRapidash
cobblemon.species.epochrapidash.desc: It is the loyal steed of a fallen hero. It burns with fiery passion from the grave as it seeks vengeance for its master's killer.
cobblemon.species.epochgeodude.name: EpochGeodude
cobblemon.species.epochgeodude.desc: Its body is hot to the touch as it was recently formed from magma floes. Simply touching it can cause second degree burns.
cobblemon.species.epochgraveler.name: EpochGraveler
cobblemon.species.epochgraveler.desc: Its eyes flare with fiery power when it gets mad. Deep within it, it carries the power of a volcano and it is highly unstable. Do not anger at any cost.
cobblemon.species.epochgolem.name: EpochGolem
cobblemon.species.epochgolem.desc: The volcanic power that it tries to keep under control has started to seep through its skin. It uses this lava to quickly cauterize flesh wounds.
cobblemon.species.epochdrowzee.name: EpochDrowzee
cobblemon.species.epochdrowzee.desc: It is a brutish Pokemon that will fight others in its tribe for scraps of meat. It gets easily irritated and always resorts to violence.
cobblemon.species.epochhypno.name: EpochHypno
cobblemon.species.epochhypno.desc: It carries around a pendant as a trophy. It is a grossly unpleasant creature as it both farts and snores loudly.
cobblemon.species.epochseel.name: EpochSeel
cobblemon.species.epochseel.desc: It lazes about on small islands when it tires of diving for food. It spends most of its day eating and sleeping.
cobblemon.species.epochdewgong.name: EpochDewgong
cobblemon.species.epochdewgong.desc: It is exceptionally heavy, but it is able to fend off predators with its long horn.
cobblemon.species.epochkabuto.name: EpochKabuto
cobblemon.species.epochkabuto.desc: Swarms of these locust Pokemon have been known for being able to devour fields of crops in minutes.
cobblemon.species.epochkabutops.name: EpochKabutops
cobblemon.species.epochkabutops.desc: Its hunting ability is unparalleled. It is able to lie in wait silently for its prey and then use its sickles to finish the job.
cobblemon.species.epochaerodactyl.name: EpochAerodactyl
cobblemon.species.epochaerodactyl.desc: Its greenish tint is said to have come from this species flying in especially humid, jungly areas.
cobblemon.species.epochkrabby.name: EpochKrabby
cobblemon.species.epochkrabby.desc: They look like harmless sandy rocks while disguised, but when stepped on, they will furiously chase you to pinch you back.
cobblemon.species.epochkingler.name: EpochKingler
cobblemon.species.epochkingler.desc: It is highly versatile as it is able to use its massive pincers to handle and crush rocks like opposable thumbs.
cobblemon.species.epochvoltorb.name: EpochVoltorb
cobblemon.species.epochvoltorb.desc: It is often confused as being a snowball which has resulted in many instances of small children throwing them at others.
cobblemon.species.epochelectrode.name: EpochElectrode
cobblemon.species.epochelectrode.desc: It was formerly the head of a snowman a small child carelessly discarded after they were done playing in the snow.
cobblemon.species.epochweedle.name: EpochWeedle
cobblemon.species.epochweedle.desc: No one will ever suspect an innocuous looking Weedle until it is too late to realize that it has been planting remote surveillance spy bots everywhere.
cobblemon.species.epochkakuna.name: EpochKakuna
cobblemon.species.epochkakuna.desc: It is used for surveillance measures and employs an innocuous Kakuna disguise to avoid attracting attention.
cobblemon.species.epochbeedrill.name: EpochBeedrill
cobblemon.species.epochbeedrill.desc: All of its time spent observing its enemies while in its earlier stages have helped it learn such that it now preys on those that once hunted it.
cobblemon.species.epochmachop.name: EpochMachop
cobblemon.species.epochmachop.desc: With its one eye, it lacks a spatial sense but what it lacks in this sense, it makes up for through brute strength.
cobblemon.species.epochmachoke.name: EpochMachoke
cobblemon.species.epochmachoke.desc: It is prone to entering into a rage when it loses things. The fact that it has only one eye to find lost articles does not help either.
cobblemon.species.epochmachamp.name: EpochMachamp
cobblemon.species.epochmachamp.desc: The addition of its two extra arms has somehow made it even more disoriented than it was previously. However, it hits harder as a result.
cobblemon.species.epochtauros.name: EpochTauros
cobblemon.species.epochtauros.desc: It is incredibly fast and strong. It can charge into walls with reckless abandon.
cobblemon.species.epochelectabuzz.name: EpochElectabuzz
cobblemon.species.epochelectabuzz.desc: It has no fear, and will willingly take on enemies much larger and stronger in size without flinching. Arguably, this can be seen as both a strength and a weakness.
cobblemon.species.epochmagmar.name: EpochMagmar
cobblemon.species.epochmagmar.desc: It can be found both on frozen tundra, glaciers and in frozen oceans roaming in isolation.
cobblemon.species.epochexeggcute.name: EpochExeggcute
cobblemon.species.epochexeggcute.desc: This Pokemon was created as a consequence of a nuclear fallout. It's not clear what it looked like prior to this event.
cobblemon.species.epochexeggutor.name: EpochExeggutor
cobblemon.species.epochexeggutor.desc: It is said that prolonged exposure to this Pokemon can cause illness due to the nuclear radiation it emanates.
cobblemon.species.epochgrimer.name: EpochGrimer
cobblemon.species.epochgrimer.desc: It is found deep in swampy areas. When you find yourself in sinking mud, it is most likely a Grimer holding onto you.
cobblemon.species.epochmuk.name: EpochMuk
cobblemon.species.epochmuk.desc: It is rumoured to guard swamps and appear in deep fog. The sound of its movements are often confused as wailing, giving it the title of Swamp Creature.
cobblemon.species.epochabra.name: EpochAbra
cobblemon.species.epochabra.desc: It meditates for most of the day. Most observers believe it to be asleep but its spirit has transcended to a plane of enlightenment.
cobblemon.species.epochkadabra.name: EpochKadabra
cobblemon.species.epochkadabra.desc: It trains its fists both through repetitive attacks against hard surfaces and also against ethereal forces as regular training.
cobblemon.species.epochalakazam.name: EpochAlakazam
cobblemon.species.epochalakazam.desc: Its Nunchakus are an extension of its arms. It has learned to use them seamlessly and flawlessly.
cobblemon.species.epochpsyduck.name: EpochPsyduck
cobblemon.species.epochpsyduck.desc: The gem on its head is capable of allowing it to see briefly into the future, which allows it to anticipate attacks.
cobblemon.species.epochgolduck.name: EpochGolduck
cobblemon.species.epochgolduck.desc: It has a soothing aura that it emanates that is capable of cleansing toxic environments.
cobblemon.species.epocheevee.name: EpochEevee
cobblemon.species.epocheevee.desc: This Pokemon was subjected to cruelty in life which has affected its unstable genetic makeup, allowing it to evolve into different variations.
cobblemon.species.epochvaporeon.name: EpochVaporeon
cobblemon.species.epochvaporeon.desc: It is a very shy Pokemon and when it spots humans, it is quick to retreat back into deep sands.
cobblemon.species.epochjolteon.name: EpochJolteon
cobblemon.species.epochjolteon.desc: The storm clouds that circle it are very unstable and it is still learning how to fully control and master the energy it produces.
cobblemon.species.epochflareon.name: EpochFlareon
cobblemon.species.epochflareon.desc: The drill on its tail is heavily rusted, which slows it down significantly. However, the drill is sharp and very corrosive which helps it defend itself.
cobblemon.species.epochmeowth.name: EpochMeowth
cobblemon.species.epochmeowth.desc: It likes to challenge other Meowths in its coalition to races on sandy dunes or open fields.
cobblemon.species.epochpersian.name: EpochPersian
cobblemon.species.epochpersian.desc: It is said that the spots on any Persian are always unique in size, shape and pattern.
cobblemon.species.epochrattata.name: EpochRattata
cobblemon.species.epochrattata.desc: The hairs on its back stand when it senses danger. As a result, their population are notoriously difficult to control.
cobblemon.species.epochraticate.name: EpochRaticate
cobblemon.species.epochraticate.desc: Contrary to popular belief, the eye on its tail is how it is able to see versus through its conventional eye sockets.
cobblemon.species.epochslowpoke.name: EpochSlowpoke
cobblemon.species.epochslowpoke.desc: This Pokemon likes to always have a reserve of honey on its tail so in case it is hungry, it can always taste some off the tail rather than trying to find more.
cobblemon.species.epochslowbro.name: EpochSlowbro
cobblemon.species.epochslowbro.desc: Its greediness has increased, and it now likes to have a beehive always within reach since its not enough to just have some honey on its tail as a Slowpoke.
cobblemon.species.epochoddish.name: EpochOddish
cobblemon.species.epochoddish.desc: During full moons, the leaves on their head will sparkle.
cobblemon.species.epochgloom.name: EpochGloom
cobblemon.species.epochgloom.desc: Throughout the lunar cycle, their scents grow progressively stronger and more pleasing.
cobblemon.species.epochvileplume.name: EpochVileplume
cobblemon.species.epochvileplume.desc: During the lunar cycle, pollen is spouted from the centre of its flower to spread and create more Oddish that will bloom by the next lunar cycle.
cobblemon.species.epochhorsea.name: EpochHorsea
cobblemon.species.epochhorsea.desc: They can use their tail fins to give them a quick burst of speed when they find themselves trapped in an aggressive sea current.
cobblemon.species.epochseadra.name: EpochSeadra
cobblemon.species.epochseadra.desc: In dark places, it can control the intensity of the lights on its fins and tails to provide added visibility.
cobblemon.species.epochvenonat.name: EpochVenonat
cobblemon.species.epochvenonat.desc: Their ability to camouflage easily has lead to them becoming a bit of a pest that are hard to exterminate. However, fire is still very useful against them.
cobblemon.species.epochvenomoth.name: EpochVenomoth
cobblemon.species.epochvenomoth.desc: They are considered a pest because they make a habit of eating tree leaves and then masquerading as part of the tree to hide from predators.
cobblemon.species.epochcaterpie.name: EpochCaterpie
cobblemon.species.epochcaterpie.desc: When it senses danger, its antenna will hum enabling it to seek out protection in advance.
cobblemon.species.epochmetapod.name: EpochMetapod
cobblemon.species.epochmetapod.desc: It is very difficult for this Pokemon to protect itself because its eyes glow. If it opens its eyes, it gives away its location to potential predators.
cobblemon.species.epochbutterfree.name: EpochButterfree
cobblemon.species.epochbutterfree.desc: The wing pattern on each of these Pokemon are said to be perfectly unique and never replicated across anyone else of its species.
cobblemon.species.epochmankey.name: EpochMankey
cobblemon.species.epochmankey.desc: It is exceptionally resilient because it is able to use its screeching noise offensively to drown out and annoy anyone that dare crosses its path.
cobblemon.species.epochprimeape.name: EpochPrimeape
cobblemon.species.epochprimeape.desc: A Primeape uses its screeching to get even with people or Pokemon that have previously annoyed it. Only when you have surrendered, will it relent.
cobblemon.species.epochparas.name: EpochParas
cobblemon.species.epochparas.desc: It spreads death and disease wherever it goes. If you see a Paras in a certain environment, it is already too late.
cobblemon.species.epochparasect.name: EpochParasect
cobblemon.species.epochparasect.desc: The mushroom is a measure of its life span. The more decayed it is, the older it is, and therefore the closer to death it is.
cobblemon.species.epochlapras.name: EpochLapras
cobblemon.species.epochlapras.desc: The volcanic formation on its back formed underwater because despite its typing, it is able to navigate safely in deep waters.
cobblemon.species.epochdiglett.name: EpochDiglett
cobblemon.species.epochdiglett.desc: It likes to keep its eyes closed to mask itself as an ordinary gravestone. When people let their guard down, it will spook them.
cobblemon.species.epochdugtrio.name: EpochDugtrio
cobblemon.species.epochdugtrio.desc: It is constantly watching over the graves of close friends and family that passed away and carries the graves around with them.
cobblemon.species.epochpidgey.name: EpochPidgey
cobblemon.species.epochpidgey.desc: It often falls asleep on trees and allows snow to collect. It is actually perfectly content to have the snow accumulate than shake it off when it awakens.
cobblemon.species.epochpidgeotto.name: EpochPidgeotto
cobblemon.species.epochpidgeotto.desc: The ice that forms on its wings can be sharpened and flung at targets like icy projectiles.
cobblemon.species.epochpidgeot.name: EpochPidgeot
cobblemon.species.epochpidgeot.desc: When a flock of Pidgeot gather and collectively flap their wings, they can summon a small localized snow storm.
cobblemon.species.epochchansey.name: EpochChansey
cobblemon.species.epochchansey.desc: The C.H.A.N.S.E.Y model 800 is the upgraded version of the H.A.P.P.I.N.Y 700 and provides enhanced services in addition to healing facilities.
cobblemon.species.epochtentacool.name: EpochTentacool
cobblemon.species.epochtentacool.desc: The starry pattern on its body copies the pattern of the stars in the night sky above it when it is swimming.
cobblemon.species.epochtentacruel.name: EpochTentacruel
cobblemon.species.epochtentacruel.desc: Its head looks suspiciously like a wizard hat leading some people to believe that it has some magical powers that it conceals.
cobblemon.species.epochgrowlithe.name: EpochGrowlithe
cobblemon.species.epochgrowlithe.desc: In various myths, it is said that Growlithe were stationed as guardians to areas of cosmic significance and the guardians of forbidden knowledge.
cobblemon.species.epocharcanine.name: EpochArcanine
cobblemon.species.epocharcanine.desc: In one fable, it is said that the ball Arcanine carries around represents a unique universe. Crushing the ball would be akin to crushing a universe.
cobblemon.species.epochpikachu.name: EpochPikachu
cobblemon.species.epochpikachu.desc: From its tail, it is able to amplify certain nearby sound waves. It uses it to raise the volume in its headphones.
cobblemon.species.epochraichu.name: EpochRaichu
cobblemon.species.epochraichu.desc: From its turntable, it can produce certain musical tracks if you request it.
cobblemon.species.epochgoldeen.name: EpochGoldeen
cobblemon.species.epochgoldeen.desc: This Goldeen is believed to have started multiplying in the sewers after it got exposed to some disposed of chemicals.
cobblemon.species.epochseaking.name: EpochSeaking
cobblemon.species.epochseaking.desc: It splashes around in the dirty water of sewer systems and is not even remotely disturbed by this. In fact, it could not be happier.
cobblemon.species.epochmagnemite.name: EpochMagnemite
cobblemon.species.epochmagnemite.desc: It is sent out by the primary Magnezone mothership as a small observer to study certain environments, take samples and return.
cobblemon.species.epochmagneton.name: EpochMagneton
cobblemon.species.epochmagneton.desc: It is capable of taking high-quality photography with its lenses which make it very useful for studying certain environments.
cobblemon.species.epochspearow.name: EpochSpearow
cobblemon.species.epochspearow.desc: It hunts in small flocks and will chatter among themselves to cooperate and signal to one another when they have found a source of food.
cobblemon.species.epochfearow.name: EpochFearow
cobblemon.species.epochfearow.desc: It hunts out at sea and in oceans. It will dive into the water from a distance to pick up a fish Pokemon such as an Arrokuda when it is hungry.
cobblemon.species.epochjigglypuff.name: EpochJigglypuff
cobblemon.species.epochjigglypuff.desc: When it gets angry, it huffs and puffs to make itself bigger to show it means business. Often though, many people do not take it seriously.
cobblemon.species.epochwigglytuff.name: EpochWigglytuff
cobblemon.species.epochwigglytuff.desc: This Pokemon has grown to such a size that it is able to blow bubbles of its own. This is one method it has to actually create more Igglybuffs.
cobblemon.species.epochditto.name: EpochDitto
cobblemon.species.epochditto.desc: A species that is the subject of intense study by researchers. Some say that it is matter that came from outer space.
cobblemon.species.epochcubone.name: EpochCubone
cobblemon.species.epochcubone.desc: It wields some of the surviving coral from the reefs it inhabits as a weapon to ward off foes.
cobblemon.species.epochmarowak.name: EpochMarowak
cobblemon.species.epochmarowak.desc: Its helmet allows it to breathe underwater. However, it's not known if the coral reefs it is often found in is its natural habitat or not.
cobblemon.species.epochhorseaone.name: EpochHorseaOne
cobblemon.species.epochhorseaone.desc: It is responsible for pollinating many flowers in local fields and forests. When they do so, you can hear a loud buzzing noise.
cobblemon.species.epochseadraone.name: EpochSeadraOne
cobblemon.species.epochseadraone.desc: They roam around in small swarms to appear more threatening. They are capable of applying some deadly stings to anyone that irritates them.
cobblemon.species.epochomanyte.name: EpochOmanyte
cobblemon.species.epochomanyte.desc: It can use its magical hat to perform tricks. It is also capable of stepping into the hat and disappearing but it is not clear where it goes or how it comes back.
cobblemon.species.epochomastar.name: EpochOmastar
cobblemon.species.epochomastar.desc: Its famous trick is to put Pokemon in the hat to make them disappear. It is not clear where the Pokemon goes or how it returns.
cobblemon.species.epochgrimerone.name: EpochGrimerOne
