cobblemon.species.stalittle.name: Stalittle
cobblemon.species.stalittle.desc: Sturdy Pokemon that hide in caves full of mineral-rich water. The rocky spikes on their bodies are deposits of this water.
cobblemon.species.sedinane.name: Sedinane
cobblemon.species.sedinane.desc: Their hair is thick and coarse, commonly getting small rocks and other debris caught in it. Sedinane love to chew on these rocks.
cobblemon.species.carrauntain.name: Carrauntain
cobblemon.species.carrauntain.desc: With powerful jaws and thick, durable legs, this Pokemon is a force to be reckoned with if you step foot in its territory.
cobblemon.species.tuburrow.name: Tuburrow
cobblemon.species.tuburrow.desc: Tuburrow live in caves. They dig elaborate and complex tunnels using their rocky tails.
cobblemon.species.tunnelurm.name: Tunnelurm
cobblemon.species.tunnelurm.desc: With its powerful drill on its head, it powers through even the strongest of metals. They have been found to dig up to 8 kilometers into the earth.
cobblemon.species.audibat.name: Audibat
cobblemon.species.audibat.desc: Playful but mischevous, it's known to fly out of caves at night to mess with unsuspecting Cherm. Its cry can be heard from nearly a mile away.

cobblemon.species.furrocious.name: Furrocious
cobblemon.species.glyptic.name: Glyptic
cobblemon.species.glyptic.desc: Glyptic are filled with mysterious power. They live in desert ruins.

cobblemon.species.cereboost.name: Cereboost
cobblemon.species.pix.name: Pix
cobblemon.species.pix.desc: Pix are born from errors in code lines. It likes to cause trouble by interrupting electrical signals and breaking computer programs.
cobblemon.species.pixe.name: PixE
cobblemon.species.pixe.desc: It is capable of travelling in and out of cyberspace. Large gatherings of Pix-E feed on electrical currents, so they are seen as pests.
cobblemon.species.pixl.name: PixL
cobblemon.species.pixl.desc: Computers spontaneously bug out when Pix-L are nearby. Its formAspects is unstable and constantly changing.
cobblemon.species.twinkluppy.name: Twinkluppy
cobblemon.species.notillunar.name: Notillunar
cobblemon.species.rosinella.name: Rosinella
cobblemon.species.rosinella.desc: These tiny Pokemon are very adventurous and tend to be oblivious when it comes to danger. They often get lost.

cobblemon.species.primmella.name: Primmella
cobblemon.species.primmella.desc: Primmella are very light and wispy pokemon that are swept up even in light breezes. Often times, especially in rain and storms, they clump together and are blown by the strong winds.
cobblemon.species.primmadame.name: Primmadame
cobblemon.species.primmadame.desc: People try to keep close to them and use their floating bodies for protection from the downpour.
cobblemon.species.primmoiselle.name: Primmoiselle
cobblemon.species.primmoiselle.desc: Primmoiselle are very sophisticated and classy Pokemon, but fierce fighters in battle nonetheless.
cobblemon.species.plasduck.name: Plasduck
cobblemon.species.plasduck.desc: Plasduck keep their feet tucked under their body while they float on the surface effortlessly.
cobblemon.species.fauxmingo.name: Fauxmingo
cobblemon.species.swandola.name: Swandola
cobblemon.species.buldough.name: Buldough
cobblemon.species.buldough.desc: It's beloved as a pet among families of all sizes. Both throughout Nosto and overseas, they're often used as a mascot for bakeries because of their resemblance to certain types of pastries.
cobblemon.species.nostandiglett.name: NostanDiglett
cobblemon.species.nostandiglett.desc: It spends most of its time partially underground, leaving only its leaf poking out. Wherever this Pokemon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops.
cobblemon.species.nostandugtrio.name: NostanDugtrio
cobblemon.species.nostandugtrio.desc: Those who have tried to pull it out of the ground haven't had much luck; it has long roots tightly ingrained into the earth.
cobblemon.species.duggout.name: Duggout
cobblemon.species.duggout.desc: The largest head decides where the team goes. They work cooperatively to drill powerfully through tough ground.
cobblemon.species.seasaw.name: Seasaw
cobblemon.species.chainjaw.name: Chainjaw
cobblemon.species.atlarv.name: Atlarv
cobblemon.species.atlagon.name: Atlagon
cobblemon.species.pigstyk.name: Pigstyk
cobblemon.species.lumboar.name: Lumboar
cobblemon.species.hogstead.name: Hogstead
cobblemon.species.planebe.name: Planebe
cobblemon.species.staurbor.name: Staurbor
cobblemon.species.mantaqua.name: Mantaqua
cobblemon.species.nostanshellder.name: NostanShellder
cobblemon.species.nostanshellder.desc: The shell of these Shellder is so durable and tough that even some of the strongest Fighting-types cannot pry it open!
cobblemon.species.nostancloyster.name: NostanCloyster
cobblemon.species.nostancloyster.desc: These Cloyster have developed a large, muscular cannon that can shoot high pressure water at foes, enough to blast through steel!
cobblemon.species.merineon.name: Merineon
cobblemon.species.teslax.name: Teslax
cobblemon.species.teslax.desc: Their bodies are almost completely transparent, making them extremely hard to find in daylight. At night, however, their multicoloured lights flicker beautifully.
cobblemon.species.zexalax.name: Zexalax
cobblemon.species.zexalax.desc: Specialised cords connect each unit together, forming one collective mind. A strong electrical field surrounds them. Anything that breaches that field will be shocked with huge amounts of electricity.
cobblemon.species.diagem.name: Diagem
cobblemon.species.cephalotox.name: Cephalotox
cobblemon.species.feiring.name: Feiring
cobblemon.species.feiring.desc: If it takes a liking to a human, it will give them its ring and protect that person from any harm.
cobblemon.species.pendelf.name: Pendelf
cobblemon.species.pendelf.desc: It pays close attention to its wearer's heartbeat to monitor its health. It radiates an aura that wards off hex.
cobblemon.species.encrona.name: Encrona
cobblemon.species.encrona.desc: Monarchs from the distant past always kept Encrona by their side to protect them from bewitching spells.
cobblemon.species.tilow.name: Tilow
cobblemon.species.tilow.desc: Tilow produce a small, warm flame on top of their head by using an oil they produce inside their bodies.
cobblemon.species.candhoul.name: Candhoul
cobblemon.species.candhoul.desc: Their bodies are very gooey and sticky. They drip behind them as they walk leaving a big mess, so wild Candhoul are often labelled as pests.
cobblemon.species.chandemise.name: Chandemise
cobblemon.species.novil.name: Novil
cobblemon.species.novil.desc: It is said that if you stare into its eye for long enough, you will have visions of unspeakable horrors from the past.
cobblemon.species.azatome.name: Azatome
cobblemon.species.azatome.desc: Each book possesses various writings in an alien language, they are rumoured to tell the story of the end of the universe.
cobblemon.species.necromanos.name: Necromanos
cobblemon.species.necromanos.desc: Necromanos absorb people's souls, leaving only the lifeless body leftover. It is said that each soul becomes a new tendril.
cobblemon.species.vaniteeny.name: Vaniteeny
cobblemon.species.vaniteeny.desc: Vaniteeny are very shy and will not move in the presence of another being. They stand very still on all 4 of their legs.
cobblemon.species.boodoir.name: Boodoir
cobblemon.species.boodoir.desc: Now more powerful, each 4 of its separate faces fight for control over what they will do. Boodoir tend to be indecisive which is hinders their ability to battle.
cobblemon.species.maspook.name: Maspook
cobblemon.species.cresprit.name: Cresprit
cobblemon.species.spectmare.name: Spectmare
cobblemon.species.suravi.name: Suravi
cobblemon.species.pzeigon.name: Pzeigon
cobblemon.species.psypole.name: Psypole
cobblemon.species.psypole.desc: Psypole are very intelligent Pokemon that hatch with an orb. The orb helps them learn to control their psychic abilities.
cobblemon.species.telefrog.name: Telefrog
cobblemon.species.telefrog.desc: Telefrog has the ability to use its psychic powers to full effect. To train Telefrog one should do their best to develop a friendship with it.
cobblemon.species.tarotoad.name: Tarotoad
cobblemon.species.tarotoad.desc: When a person is acting strangely or suspiciously, it is a figure of speech to suggest that a Tarotoad is influencing their thoughts.
cobblemon.species.boxeroo.name: Boxeroo
cobblemon.species.boxeroo.desc: These feisty Pokemon play fight to display their markings. More markings are a source of pride for Boxeroo.
cobblemon.species.marsupunch.name: Marsupunch
cobblemon.species.marsupunch.desc: Marsupunch are proud of their scars, and often attempt to flaunt them in front of other Marsupunch. This inevitably results in more fighting.
cobblemon.species.kankombat.name: Kankombat
cobblemon.species.kankombat.desc: Kankombat are intimidating in stature, standing far taller than the average human grows. So, while it is dangerous to get on the wrong side of a Kankombat, it's quite easy to see them coming.
cobblemon.species.seijitsu.name: Seijitsu
cobblemon.species.seijitsu.desc: Seijitsu are pack Pokemon and become very protective of those close to them. They love to run around and chase other Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.kousetsu.name: Kousetsu
cobblemon.species.kousetsu.desc: Kousetsu consider those close to them to be part of their pack, and will protect them by cuddling up to them for warmth.
cobblemon.species.mangetsu.name: Mangetsu
cobblemon.species.mangetsu.desc: Mangetsu have evolved to control the harsh cold weather, rather than merely surviving it. They use their sharp claws and keen senses to hunt for prey.
cobblemon.species.rockroach.name: Rockroach
cobblemon.species.rockroach.desc: Rockroach mimic stones when trainers pass by. The moment they turn away, however, Rockroach will emerge to follow them.
cobblemon.species.boulderoach.name: Boulderoach
cobblemon.species.boulderoach.desc: Boulderoach chew up rocks to plaster on their shells. They have mined out entire caverns to reinforce the layers of stone and mud.
cobblemon.species.axolil.name: Axolil
cobblemon.species.axolil.desc: Axolil have a petrifying fear of drying out. If taken away from water and released, they will dowse for the nearest source of fresh water.
cobblemon.species.visimander.name: Visimander
cobblemon.species.visimander.desc: Visimander are alert Pokemon, whose sensitivity more than makes up for their blindness. They can physically and psychically map their surroundings in a fraction of a second.
cobblemon.species.webbat.name: Webbat
cobblemon.species.webbat.desc: Webbat's fangs excrete a potent venom, which coagulates blood into a thick, syrupy puck. Due to their small size, Webbat wait to ambush their victims.
cobblemon.species.vamprachne.name: Vamprachne
cobblemon.species.vamprachne.desc: Vamprachne spin their own wings out of sticky gossamer. They store food, attractive objects, and their unruly young in them.
cobblemon.species.cutesnoot.name: Cutesnoot
cobblemon.species.cutesnoot.desc: Cutesnoot love food, and often cause mischief while seeking for it. The easiest way to befriend a Cutesnoot is by leaving out an offering of food.
cobblemon.species.coatisnotti.name: Coatisnotti
cobblemon.species.coatisnotti.desc: Coatisnotti are tricksters who work in packs to steal food from humans and Pokemon. Each pack member has an assigned role in their schemes, based upon the Coatisnotti's strength.
cobblemon.species.ospuny.name: Ospuny
cobblemon.species.ospuny.desc: Ospuny have downy feathers, but rarely make a fuss about preening. They prefer to let their feathers naturally grow and fall out.
cobblemon.species.osprowl.name: Osprowl
cobblemon.species.osprowl.desc: Osprowl practice their flying maneuvers on prey and unsuspecting targets alike. Osprowl keep small collections of objects they have collected in daring flights.
cobblemon.species.ospredator.name: Ospredator
cobblemon.species.ospredator.desc: Ospredator are the bane of humans who attempt to research them. This is because they refuse to let intruders anywhere near their territory.
cobblemon.species.pakrat.name: Pakrat
cobblemon.species.pakrat.desc: Pakrat will live and forage almost anywhere, adding various finds to the pouch of leaves around their middle.
cobblemon.species.bakpakrat.name: Bakpakrat
cobblemon.species.bakpakrat.desc: Bakpakrat are nomadic, wandering the region, so they can deliver mail to humans and Pokemon alike.
cobblemon.species.royalarva.name: Royalarva
cobblemon.species.royalarva.desc: It is said that Royalarva look perpetually sad because they are ashamed of their ugliness.
cobblemon.species.superbpa.name: Superbpa
cobblemon.species.superbpa.desc: Superbpa spend long periods of time sleeping. Even when they are awake, they prefer to lay motionless inside flowers.
cobblemon.species.regalocera.name: Regalocera
cobblemon.species.regalocera.desc: While Regalocera are proud of their majestic beauty, they are far from cocky, spending most of their energy protecting and nourishing weaker Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.carapad.name: Carapad
cobblemon.species.carapad.desc: Carapad use their shells to mimic lily pads. People and Pokemon alike often fall for their disguise. But, if disturbed, Carapad will shoot a jet of water at the offender's face.
cobblemon.species.puripad.name: Puripad
cobblemon.species.puripad.desc: Puripad's air of gentleness draws in smaller Pokemon, who will then rest on their shells.
cobblemon.species.simpaima.name: Simpaima
cobblemon.species.simpaima.desc: It is so often distracted by the light reflecting off its body that it can hardly focus. They struggle to complete complex tasks.
cobblemon.species.arowisen.name: Arowisen
cobblemon.species.arowisen.desc: It is so often distracted by the light reflecting off its body that it can hardly focus. They struggle to complete complex tasks.
cobblemon.species.spidoux.name: Spidoux
cobblemon.species.spidoux.desc: Countless foragers of Vereshad have succumbed to Spidoux's poison after mistaking its abdomen for a Pecha Berry.
cobblemon.species.aracide.name: Aracide
cobblemon.species.aracide.desc: It can envenom the foe by biting or by being bitten. This Pokemon will intentionally leave itself open to attack.
cobblemon.species.mimectar.name: Mimectar
cobblemon.species.mimectar.desc: Mimetcar resemble unsuspecting sunflowers most of the time. If they are attacked, their monstrous true formAspects will appear.
cobblemon.species.skittail.name: Skittail
cobblemon.species.skittail.desc: Timiphid are very weak, but they move fast. They move in unpredictable patterns to avoid being hit by attacks.
cobblemon.species.timiphid.name: Timiphid
cobblemon.species.timiphid.desc: Be careful when approaching Skittail. While they are quite timid, they may caller for help from something bigger.
cobblemon.species.chromite.name: Chromite
cobblemon.species.chromite.desc: When two Chromite meet, they will have a contest by hitting each other. The one whose armor cracks first loses.
cobblemon.species.oviseed.name: Oviseed
cobblemon.species.oviseed.desc: Oviseed almost never move. Doing so requires them to lift their roots, and that takes a lot of time and energy.
cobblemon.species.hoofern.name: Hoofern
cobblemon.species.hoofern.desc: The main body has grown its own legs, and the roots have receded. Hoofern can move freely.
cobblemon.species.asparies.name: Asparies
cobblemon.species.asparies.desc: The roots that were once its legs have grown around the body, protecting the Pokemon as it charges about.
cobblemon.species.pixipetal.name: Pixipetal
cobblemon.species.pixipetal.desc: Pixipetal try to dance, but often lose their balance. They use their vines to keep from falling over.
cobblemon.species.florafay.name: Florafay
cobblemon.species.florafay.desc: Florafay will string together many graceful gestures into a unique dance. Each movement means something different.
cobblemon.species.zapouch.name: Zapouch
cobblemon.species.zapouch.desc: Zapouch's life deep underwater is shrouded in mystery. They come to the surface of the ocean when they are ready to evolve.
cobblemon.species.mannovolt.name: Mannovolt
cobblemon.species.mannovolt.desc: Mannovolt ensnare prey with their appendages and deliver electric shocks. If Mannovolt are not careful, they can shock themselves.
cobblemon.species.hemocto.name: Hemocto
cobblemon.species.hemocto.desc: A tricky parasite, Hemocto will hold on to the nearest living thing and drain it of its blood. They can navigate well even in the murky ocean depths.
cobblemon.species.alucuttle.name: Alucuttle
cobblemon.species.alucuttle.desc: Alucuttle drain the blood of their prey before discarding it. Their sharp teeth were once used for knives.
cobblemon.species.sorroul.name: Sorroul
cobblemon.species.sorroul.desc: Always in tears. While trainers may comfort it to prevent it from wailing, Sorroul's tears will keep flowing.
cobblemon.species.depressoul.name: Depressoul
cobblemon.species.depressoul.desc: Depressoul will actively move away from those that tell it to feel better. It responds best to trainers that are willing to quietly sit beside it.
cobblemon.species.spectorment.name: Spectorment
cobblemon.species.spectorment.desc: The shrieks of Spectorment are said to evoke the most painful memories a person has experienced. Staying near one for extended periods is incredibly difficult to bear.
cobblemon.species.accerval.name: Accerval
cobblemon.species.accerval.desc: They are quick to chase small Pokemon, but will cower away from larger ones.
cobblemon.species.warrush.name: Warrush
cobblemon.species.warrush.desc: Because they run so fast, debris that strikes the body leaves permanent marks. The older a Warrush, the more scars it has.
cobblemon.species.hauntodile.name: Hauntodile
cobblemon.species.hauntodile.desc: It is said that Hauntodile hunts to add the prey's body heat to itself. However, its skin is always cold to the touch.
cobblemon.species.necrodile.name: Necrodile
cobblemon.species.necrodile.desc: Necrodile learn by eating the experiences of the dying. It learned to stand on two legs by eating the memories of humans, or so it is said.
cobblemon.species.gichet.name: Gichet
cobblemon.species.gichet.desc: Gichet have small jaws, but they will clack them together loudly when threatened.
cobblemon.species.crickjaw.name: Crickjaw
cobblemon.species.crickjaw.desc: Crickjaw have small bodies compared to their heads, which have grown substantially during evolution. Their massive jaws are supported by these large craniums.
cobblemon.species.tascorch.name: Tascorch
cobblemon.species.tascorch.desc: Tascorch always have a flame burning at the back of their throat. When they are sick, the fire burns at a lower temperature.
cobblemon.species.tastorture.name: Tastorture
cobblemon.species.tastorture.desc: Tastorture have numerous growths around their upper body. To some trainers, the more growths their Tastorture has, the cooler it is.
cobblemon.species.shrimpink.name: Shrimpink
cobblemon.species.shrimpink.desc: Oddly enough, Shrimpink emit a pleasant aroma that draws in Pokemon and humans alike. Their tough shells make them inedible, however.
cobblemon.species.armaroma.name: Armaroma
cobblemon.species.armaroma.desc: Armaroma emit a sickly-sweet smell from their bodies. It appears to confuse predators that rely on smell.
cobblemon.species.pricklebun.name: Pricklebun
cobblemon.species.pricklebun.desc: Timid and easily frightened, this Pokemon often avoids danger by hiding among cacti and other drybrush. The fruit that grows from its ears is used to make tasty jams and jellies.
cobblemon.species.cackrabbit.name: Cackrabbit
cobblemon.species.cackrabbit.desc: Although less skiddish than its predecessor, this Pokemon will spray needles by violently shaking its body whenever it feels threatened. This makes it a difficult Pokemon for young trainers to train.
cobblemon.species.sonoralope.name: Sonoralope
cobblemon.species.sonoralope.desc: Its powerful arms and legs enable this Pokemon to make huge bounds across the desert landscape. Sonoralope protects Pokemon from danger with thorny, bone-cracking kicks.
cobblemon.species.chubren.name: Chubren
cobblemon.species.chubren.desc: A bit of a glutton, this bird is a nuisance to grass-type Pokemon because of its constant attempts to eat their fruits.
cobblemon.species.roadren.name: Roadren
cobblemon.species.roadren.desc: Roadren speed over desert grounds at over 700 miles per hour. Before they start a run, their tails will flare in warning, letting others know to get out of the way.
cobblemon.species.malleamole.name: Malleamole
cobblemon.species.malleamole.desc: The tendrils on its nose can be shortened and lengthened, to an extent. It moves them around to feel its way forward.
cobblemon.species.shoxin.name: Shoxin
cobblemon.species.shoxin.desc: It will do a handstand just before it sprays poison. The poison is electrically conductive.
cobblemon.species.noxurge.name: Noxurge
cobblemon.species.noxurge.desc: Noxurge will coat their fur in a thin layer of poison. When startled, they will send electricity coursing through it to create a blinding flash.
cobblemon.species.calientoad.name: Calientoad
cobblemon.species.calientoad.desc: This easygoing Pokemon prefers to move as little as possible to conserve energy while avoiding anything flammable.
cobblemon.species.picantoad.name: Picantoad
cobblemon.species.picantoad.desc: This Pokemon has no agility with which to speak of. Instead, it shoots thick jets of lava from its eyes with impeccable accuracy and range.
cobblemon.species.volcantoad.name: Volcantoad
cobblemon.species.volcantoad.desc: The 'toad' in its name is a misnomer - they avoid water as much as they can. An organ in Volcántoad's throat is filled with lava, which they release while scaling mountains.
cobblemon.species.baquini.name: Baquini
cobblemon.species.baquini.desc: Due to overfishing, this Pokemon's population has dropped to almost zero in the wild.
cobblemon.species.modelfin.name: Modelfin
cobblemon.species.modelfin.desc: Modelfin shares an eerie connection with the netting around its neck. It cannot remove it by any means, but Modelfin can unravel the netting at will to astonish unwanted company.
cobblemon.species.muertapoise.name: Muertapoise
cobblemon.species.muertapoise.desc: It is said that the hook this Pokemon carries is used to sink fishing ships as penance for its own death.
cobblemon.species.oreon.name: Oreon
cobblemon.species.oreon.desc: Thought to be a mythical Pokemon, Oreon have only been seen by a small handful of trainers. It's soft, delicious body can regenerate rapidly.
cobblemon.species.hoennianvenonat.name: HoennianVenonat
cobblemon.species.hoennianvenonat.desc: Timid by nature, the wild Venonat in Hoenn prefer to live in damp, dark places. Their large, glowing eyes can see clearly even in total blackness.
cobblemon.species.muramoth.name: Muramoth
cobblemon.species.muramoth.desc: Lucemoth are social and friendly, often times forming close bonds with trainers and Pokemon. They are drawn to bright lights and shiny objects.
cobblemon.species.lucemoth.name: Lucemoth
cobblemon.species.lucemoth.desc: Unlike its relative Venomoth, a Muramoth foregoes flight, instead leaving its wings draped around it's body for protection. They prefer to live in total solitude.
cobblemon.species.drilladin.name: Drilladin
cobblemon.species.hoenniandunsparce.name: HoennianDunsparce
cobblemon.species.hoenniandunsparce.desc: This Pokemon's eyesight is so poor that it can barely see objects directly in front of it. It escapes predators by shocking them with its electric tail.
cobblemon.species.drasparath.name: Drasparath
cobblemon.species.drasparath.desc: It's body is dotted with holdes that loose intense jets of air. When agitated, it will send an electrical current through it's air streams to create violent thunderclouds.
cobblemon.species.hoennianmareanie.name: HoennianMareanie
cobblemon.species.hoennianmareanie.desc: It protects its soft, viscous body with a thick layer of sturdy rock and debris. Prolonged exposure to dry air causes its skin to harden into brittle spines.
cobblemon.species.hoenniantoxapex.name: HoennianToxapex
cobblemon.species.hoenniantoxapex.desc: It disguises itself as a simple rock to catch unsuspecting prey off guard. Toxapex then rams it's entire body into it's victim, paralyzing it with it's toxic spines.
cobblemon.species.mallarki.name: Mallarki
cobblemon.species.mallarki.desc: The sprig of green onion it holds with it's beak is it's weapon of choice. It makes short work of most foes with a single, deft strike.
cobblemon.species.hoennianpinsir.name: HoennianPinsir
cobblemon.species.hoennianpinsir.desc: It grips its prey in its pincers and crushes the life out of them. It can't move if it's cold, so it prefers to inhabit warm, dry places.
cobblemon.species.hoennianteddiursa.name: HoennianTeddiursa
cobblemon.species.hoennianteddiursa.desc: It's palms constantly give off a warm glow. When in distress, the heat from it's palms can become so intense that they burn through even solid metal.
cobblemon.species.hoennianursaring.name: HoennianUrsaring
cobblemon.species.hoennianursaring.desc: Ursaring gather food from trees using their lengthy, extendable tongues. It's fearsome claws are actually intended to aid in peeling hard-skinned fruits.
cobblemon.species.hoenniandodrio.name: HoennianDodrio
cobblemon.species.hoenniandodrio.desc: Its middle head dominates the other two, issuing orders as it sees fit. They often travel alongside wild Marowak when hunting for prey.
cobblemon.species.hoennianskarmory.name: HoennianSkarmory
cobblemon.species.hoennianskarmory.desc: A Pokemon that has a body and wings of molten steel. In the heat of battle, the blades on its wings glow white-hot and emit clouds of burning steam.
cobblemon.species.hoenniantynamo.name: HoennianTynamo
cobblemon.species.hoenniantynamo.desc: It releases a foul odor to ward off any potential predators. They travel in large clusters, resulting in unbearable smells as they move from place to place.
cobblemon.species.hoennianeelektrik.name: HoennianEelektrik
cobblemon.species.hoennianeelektrik.desc: Through frequent shedding of it's skin, this Pokemon grows in size at an incredible rate. It devours sand and leaves behind rare minerals as waste
cobblemon.species.hoennianeelektross.des: An Eelektross is scarcely seen above ground. It's monstrous jaws can crush even the hardest materials beneath the surface of the earth.
cobblemon.species.hoennianmaractus.name: HoennianMaractus
cobblemon.species.hoennianmaractus.desc: Maractus were forced out of the desert due to competition with rival Cacturne. It's ability to survive nonetheless is a testament to its hardiness.
cobblemon.species.silviper.name: Silviper
cobblemon.species.silviper.desc: Silviper roamed the world as a ferocious predator in ancient times. It's long body is fortified with venom-infused silver scales.
cobblemon.species.zangoro.name: Zangoro
cobblemon.species.zangoro.desc: Zangaro are often spoken of in stories meant to frighten misbehaving children. Its black fur cloaks it during the night when it comes out to hunt prey.
cobblemon.species.hoenniantangela.name: HoennianTangela
cobblemon.species.hoenniantangela.desc: It's body is covered in pointy, dead vines that it collects at a young age. If anyone attempts to peer into it's nest to view it's real body, it becomes highly aggressive.
cobblemon.species.hoenniantangrowth.name: HoennianTangrowth
cobblemon.species.hoenniantangrowth.desc: This Pokemon will resort to any means necessary to win in a fight. It stands upright on it's vines to appear larger and more menacing.
cobblemon.species.hoennianpawniard.name: HoennianPawniard
cobblemon.species.hoennianpawniard.desc: Though clumsy and prone to error, a Pawniard will never give up on it's journey to grow stronger. It constantly seeks out new sparring partners.
cobblemon.species.hoennianbisharp.name: HoennianBisharp
cobblemon.species.hoennianbisharp.desc: Chivalrous to a fault, these Pokemon will defend their Trainers with unwavering loyalty. In the wild, they are often seen with a troupe of Pawniard in tow.
cobblemon.species.hoenniansolosis.name: HoennianSolosis
cobblemon.species.hoenniansolosis.desc: Solosis in Hoenn have adapted on a cellular level to resemble common berries. They avoid unwanted attention by hiding within fruit trees.
cobblemon.species.hoennianduosion.name: HoennianDuosion
cobblemon.species.hoennianduosion.desc: It constantly devours berries by absorbing them through it's jelly-like membrane. Their brilliant gold color glows brightly after they finish a meal.
cobblemon.species.hoennianreuniclus.name: HoennianReuniclus
cobblemon.species.hoennianreuniclus.desc: It constantly devours berries by absorbing them through it's jelly-like membrane. Their brilliant gold color glows brightly after they finish a meal.
cobblemon.species.hoenniangoomy.name: HoennianGoomy
cobblemon.species.hoenniangoomy.desc: It uses it's horns to check out it's surroundings. They're very sensitive, so if you grab them, it will feel a strong shock and be unable to move.
cobblemon.species.goolossal.name: Goolossal
cobblemon.species.goolossal.desc: This enormous evolution of Goomy is entirely unique to the Hoenn region. Goolossal are often accompanied by hordes of Goomy that serve them willingly.
cobblemon.species.hoennianshuckle.name: HoennianShuckle
cobblemon.species.hoennianshuckle.desc: A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become juice.
cobblemon.species.hoennianemolga.name: HoennianEmolga
cobblemon.species.hoennianemolga.desc: Emolga swoop down from the sky in an effort to frighten townsfolk. Due to their adorable appearance, however, they are rarely successful.
cobblemon.species.hoennianonix.name: HoennianOnix
cobblemon.species.hoennianonix.desc: There is a cave in a far-away region where this Pokemon is said to have originated from. They migrated to Hoenn when the waters in their homeland grew too warm.
cobblemon.species.chrysalix.name: Chrysalix
cobblemon.species.chrysalix.desc: Chrysalix are a new species discovered by researchers conducting experiments on the crystalline Onix in Shoal Cave. They continue to grow larger with age.
cobblemon.species.hoenniantentacool.name: HoennianTentacool
cobblemon.species.hoenniantentacool.desc: It's body is almost entirely composed of water. It grasps it's foes with it's four long tentacles, then brutally shocks it until it falls unconscious.
cobblemon.species.hoenniantentacruel.des: Despite being smaller than Tentacruel in other regions, this variant is far more aggressive, It can administer deadly jolts of electricity when aggravated.
cobblemon.species.hoennianseel.name: HoennianSeel
cobblemon.species.hoennianseel.desc: Seel hunt for prey in the warm, temperate seas of Hoenn. When threatened, they curl their tailfin into a fist-like ball that can deliver crushing blows.
cobblemon.species.hoenniandewgong.name: HoennianDewgong
cobblemon.species.hoenniandewgong.desc: It's lackadaisical nature often tricks unsuspecting trainers into believing it to be friendly. A swift strike from it's tail-fin teaches them otherwise.
cobblemon.species.hoennianchinchou.name: HoennianChinchou
cobblemon.species.hoennianchinchou.desc: It lives in depth beyond sunlight's reach, waiting patiently for prey to swim by. The lights on its antennae can cause intense hallucinations.
cobblemon.species.hoennianlanturn.name: HoennianLanturn
cobblemon.species.hoennianlanturn.desc: The light-emitting flame on its head is used to lure in unsuspecting prey on the seafloor. It ensnares its victims within its body and siphons their life force.
cobblemon.species.hoennianqwilfish.name: HoennianQwilfish
cobblemon.species.hoennianqwilfish.desc: Qwilfish latch their tails to rocks on the seafloor and wait for unsuspecting prey to swim by. When it spots a target, it unleashes an explosion of toxic fumes.
cobblemon.species.slingray.name: Slingray
cobblemon.species.slingray.desc: It fashions a slingshot-like apparatus to it's fins using kelp from the seafloor. Slingray hunt by leaping out of the ocean and flinging rocks at unsuspecting prey.
cobblemon.species.bawlfrog.name: Bawlfrog
cobblemon.species.hoenniandreepy.name: HoennianDreepy
cobblemon.species.hoenniandreepy.desc: Dreepy are notorious pranksters. They often dart around in packs, looking for humans or Pokemon to play tricks on. It's den is littered with stolen valuables.
cobblemon.species.hoenniandrakloak.name: HoennianDrakloak
cobblemon.species.hoenniandrakloak.desc: Nurturing to a fault, this Pokemon will fervently watch over young Dreepy to keep them out of trouble. It becomes anxious if it has no Dreepy to care for.
cobblemon.species.hoenniandragapult.name: HoennianDragapult
cobblemon.species.hoenniandragapult.desc: Explorers of old would often mistake the Dreepy it carries as additional heads. To this day, this Pokemon is still known as the 'Volcanic Hydra'
cobblemon.species.hoennianregigigas.name: HoennianRegigigas
cobblemon.species.hoennianregigigas.desc: After eons of being sealed away, all that remains of Regigigas is its skeletal structure. In its prime, this Pokemon was capable of reshaping the world.
cobblemon.species.vitellion.name: Vitellion
cobblemon.species.crawb.name: Crawb
cobblemon.species.metunn.name: Metunn
cobblemon.species.armiransceptile.name: ArmiranSceptile
cobblemon.species.armiransceptile.desc: It recides by itself, and is extremely competitive. This Pokemon disintergrates trees and plants.
cobblemon.species.armiranfroakie.name: ArmiranFroakie
cobblemon.species.armiranfroakie.desc: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate smoke. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
cobblemon.species.armiranfrogadier.name: ArmiranFrogadier
cobblemon.species.armiranfrogadier.desc: It can disappear within moments. Now you see it, now you don't.
cobblemon.species.armirangreninja.name: ArmiranGreninja
cobblemon.species.armirangreninja.desc: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements.
cobblemon.species.armiranswellow.name: ArmiranSwellow
cobblemon.species.armiranswellow.desc: It can induce thunderstorms to create attacks. It often targets fishing ships to steal food from netting.
cobblemon.species.sandridger.name: Sandridger
cobblemon.species.sandridger.desc: It uses its large metal claws to defend against predators and dig large dens in the ground.
cobblemon.species.alolansandridger.name: AlolanSandridger
cobblemon.species.alolansandridger.desc: It uses its large metal claws to defend against predators and dig large dens in the ground.
cobblemon.species.armirangrowlithe.name: ArmiranGrowlithe
cobblemon.species.armirangrowlithe.desc: Growlithe adapted extremely quickly to its new environment thanks to its excellent sense of smell.
cobblemon.species.armiranarcanine.name: ArmiranArcanine
cobblemon.species.armiranarcanine.desc: This fleet-footed Pokemon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. Supposedly, it can also run on water.
cobblemon.species.armiranroggenrola.name: ArmiranRoggenrola
cobblemon.species.armiranroggenrola.desc: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
cobblemon.species.armiranboldore.name: ArmiranBoldore
cobblemon.species.armiranboldore.desc: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
cobblemon.species.armirangigalith.name: ArmiranGigalith
cobblemon.species.armirangigalith.desc: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
cobblemon.species.armiranhippopotas.name: ArmiranHippopotas
cobblemon.species.armiranhippopotas.desc: It enshrouds itself with water to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy being dry.
cobblemon.species.armiranhippowdon.name: ArmiranHippowdon
cobblemon.species.armiranhippowdon.desc: It blasts internally stored water from ports on its body to create a towering whirlpool for attack.
cobblemon.species.armirantyranitar.name: ArmiranTyranitar
cobblemon.species.armirantyranitar.desc: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in volcanic areas seeking new opponents to fight.
cobblemon.species.armirangarchomp.name: ArmiranGarchomp
cobblemon.species.armirangarchomp.desc: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
cobblemon.species.ayreianspearow.name: AyreianSpearow
cobblemon.species.ayreianspearow.desc: Populates more in grassy area than cold ones for unknown reasons. It leaves shards of ice wherever it sleeps.
cobblemon.species.ayreianfearow.name: AyreianFearow
cobblemon.species.ayreianfearow.desc: A curious organ inside its abdomen allows it to mantain very cold temperatures no matter where it lives. When its life would be in peril, it incases itself in ice.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvenonat.name: AyreianVenonat
cobblemon.species.ayreianvenonat.desc: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandoduo.name: AyreianDoduo
cobblemon.species.ayreiandoduo.desc: It mimics a snowman to evade predators. Unfortunately, this usually only works on children.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhitmonlee.name: AyreianHitmonlee
cobblemon.species.ayreianhitmonlee.desc: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhitmonchan.name: AyreianHitmonchan
cobblemon.species.ayreianhitmonchan.desc: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
cobblemon.species.ayreianjynx.name: AyreianJynx
cobblemon.species.ayreianjynx.desc: Behind the unassuming face lies a cold set of teeth, which it uses to catch prey. It can levitate for a short while using a weird power.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansnorlax.name: AyreianSnorlax
cobblemon.species.ayreiansnorlax.desc: For some reason, this Pokemon believes it is the king of the mountain, yet the only thing it does all day is resting.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandratini.name: AyreianDratini
cobblemon.species.ayreiandratini.desc: The first instance of Dratini sightings where under a meteor shower, so it is theorized that it came from space.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandragonair.name: AyreianDragonair
cobblemon.species.ayreiandragonair.desc: Dragonair passively stores high amounts of energy in its armor, which is released all at once when its about to evolve.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandragonite.name: AyreianDragonite
cobblemon.species.ayreiandragonite.desc: On par with legendary Pokemon, most humans spend their entire life not even knowing about their existence. The energy generated by them is otherwordly.
cobblemon.species.ayreianlapras.name: AyreianLapras
cobblemon.species.ayreianlapras.desc: Even its existance is a myth, as little sightings have been documented after the war. Rumor has it that it only appears to trainers worth its time.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvulpix.name: AyreianVulpix
cobblemon.species.ayreianvulpix.desc: It burrows in the various dunes of the desert it lives in, and pounces on prey at the opportune moment. It can go without water for weeks.
cobblemon.species.ayreianninetales.name: AyreianNinetales
cobblemon.species.ayreianninetales.desc: It can harness the power of deceased desert dwellers to enhance its own attacks. It ambushes prey in the sandstorms it creates.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvulpixone.name: AyreianVulpixOne
cobblemon.species.ayreianvulpixone.desc: It hunts for fish Pokemon in small ponds by controlling the water stream and lifting it upwards.
cobblemon.species.ayreianninetalesone.de: It sings in a mellow tone to summon powerful tides. Originally an Alolan Ninetales, scientists raised it in a swamp and its metabolism drastically changed.
cobblemon.species.ayreianturtwig.name: AyreianTurtwig
cobblemon.species.ayreianturtwig.desc: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrotle.name: AyreianGrotle
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrotle.desc: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantorterra.name: AyreianTorterra
cobblemon.species.ayreiantorterra.desc: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
cobblemon.species.ayreianbulbasaur.name: AyreianBulbasaur
cobblemon.species.ayreianbulbasaur.desc: From birth, a sticky paste that it produces forms peculiar patterns on its body. Every Bulbasaur has a slightly different formation.
cobblemon.species.ayreianivysaur.name: AyreianIvysaur
cobblemon.species.ayreianivysaur.desc: It burrows itself in sand, then waits for a prey to get closer, which is then showered by a substance similar to glue, blocking its escape.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvenusaur.name: AyreianVenusaur
cobblemon.species.ayreianvenusaur.desc: The clay-like substance it secretes is used as a super glue to patch up its den. It carries other Bulbasaur and Ivysaur in its vase.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancharmander.name: AyreianCharmander
cobblemon.species.ayreiancharmander.desc: The shiny gem on its chest is the very lifeforce of the Pokemon. In the past, poaching severely reduced this Pokemon's population.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancharmeleon.name: AyreianCharmeleon
cobblemon.species.ayreiancharmeleon.desc: Very impatient for its evolution, it feeds on the purest gems in the caves it lives in. While docile, it is quick to anger.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancharizard.name: AyreianCharizard
cobblemon.species.ayreiancharizard.desc: Usually docile, it becomes incredibly aggressive during mating season. The hand-like appendages on its back allow it to excavate dens inside sturdy gems.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansquirtle.name: AyreianSquirtle
cobblemon.species.ayreiansquirtle.desc: While underdeveloped, its tail has enough power to smash aside large boulders.
cobblemon.species.ayreianwartortle.name: AyreianWartortle
cobblemon.species.ayreianwartortle.desc: It takes great care of its golden horns, symbol of its pride. The shinier those horns are, the more respect a Wartortle gets in its colony.
cobblemon.species.ayreianblastoise.name: AyreianBlastoise
cobblemon.species.ayreianblastoise.desc: It uses its tail as a swinging mace, blowing away anything that comes too close. It then delivers the final blow with its prized horns.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancaterpie.name: AyreianCaterpie
cobblemon.species.ayreiancaterpie.desc: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmetapod.name: AyreianMetapod
cobblemon.species.ayreianmetapod.desc: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
cobblemon.species.ayreianbutterfree.name: AyreianButterfree
cobblemon.species.ayreianbutterfree.desc: It uses its wings to stun it's prey for an easy catch.
cobblemon.species.ayreianrattata.name: AyreianRattata
cobblemon.species.ayreianrattata.desc: The rock formation on its tail has hindered is quick movement, but allowed it to deliver heavy damage to it's enemies
cobblemon.species.ayreianraticate.name: AyreianRaticate
cobblemon.species.ayreianraticate.desc: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidgey.name: AyreianPidgey
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidgey.desc: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidgeotto.name: AyreianPidgeotto
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidgeotto.desc: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokemon will fiercely peck at any intruder.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidgeot.name: AyreianPidgeot
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidgeot.desc: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandiglett.name: AyreianDiglett
cobblemon.species.ayreiandiglett.desc: It sits in one location, only bothering those who try to pass directly through it.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandugtrio.name: AyreianDugtrio
cobblemon.species.ayreiandugtrio.desc: It sits in one location, only bothering those who try to pass directly through it.
cobblemon.species.ayreianabra.name: AyreianAbra
cobblemon.species.ayreianabra.desc: It meditates 18 hours a day to sharpen its senses. That said, they aren't very skilled.
cobblemon.species.ayreiankadabra.name: AyreianKadabra
cobblemon.species.ayreiankadabra.desc: More active than its previous formAspects, it stimulates its muscles by running up and down the mountains it lives in.
cobblemon.species.ayreianalakazam.name: AyreianAlakazam
cobblemon.species.ayreianalakazam.desc: Quicker than it looks, it hides in the shade waiting for the perfect moment to strike. Its high intelligence allows it to remember every fighting style.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrimer.name: AyreianGrimer
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrimer.desc: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmuk.name: AyreianMuk
cobblemon.species.ayreianmuk.desc: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangastly.name: AyreianGastly
cobblemon.species.ayreiangastly.desc: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhaunter.name: AyreianHaunter
cobblemon.species.ayreianhaunter.desc: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangengar.name: AyreianGengar
cobblemon.species.ayreiangengar.desc: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvoltorb.name: AyreianVoltorb
cobblemon.species.ayreianvoltorb.desc: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poke Ball, it has zapped many people.
cobblemon.species.ayreianelectrode.name: AyreianElectrode
cobblemon.species.ayreianelectrode.desc: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpinsir.name: AyreianPinsir
cobblemon.species.ayreianpinsir.desc: Its powerful carapace, harder than diamond, lets it shake off even tank shells. The leader of the pack has the most scars on its iron mantle.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantogepi.name: AyreianTogepi
cobblemon.species.ayreiantogepi.desc: This rare bird Pokemon hatches at the top of the coldest peaks, as its fire burns bright even at negative temperatures.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantogetic.name: AyreianTogetic
cobblemon.species.ayreiantogetic.desc: Its highly curious, but its incapability of flying holds it back from exploring new places. Its fire burns bright when its happy.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhoppip.name: AyreianHoppip
cobblemon.species.ayreianhoppip.desc: The eye motifs on its wings have similar properties to hypnotizing devices. It feeds off of dreams.
cobblemon.species.ayreianskiploom.name: AyreianSkiploom
cobblemon.species.ayreianskiploom.desc: The 'planteye' on top of its head releases a somniferous powder. This property is used in narcotics.
cobblemon.species.ayreianjumpluff.name: AyreianJumpluff
cobblemon.species.ayreianjumpluff.desc: By flashing bright lights from its limbs, it causes powerful headaches that eventually knock out its opponents. It flies lowly in the night, hunting for people's dreams.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmantine.name: AyreianMantine
cobblemon.species.ayreianmantine.desc: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
cobblemon.species.ayreianphanpy.name: AyreianPhanpy
cobblemon.species.ayreianphanpy.desc: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandonphan.name: AyreianDonphan
cobblemon.species.ayreiandonphan.desc: An internal organ transmutes the outside moisture into warm water, which acts as a substitute to its blood in extremely cold temperatures.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhitmontop.name: AyreianHitmontop
cobblemon.species.ayreianhitmontop.desc: The energy of the Shiny Stone enlightened this Pokemon to never before seen levels of serenity. It is almost impossible to distract.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansmoochum.name: AyreianSmoochum
cobblemon.species.ayreiansmoochum.desc: It waltzes around kissing anyone that it comes into contact with, while leaving nasty injuries that look like leech bites.
cobblemon.species.ayreianchikorita.name: AyreianChikorita
cobblemon.species.ayreianchikorita.desc: Said to have gone extinct shortly after the war, a few specimen have been found in the natural caves of Citrine Jungle.
cobblemon.species.ayreianbayleef.name: AyreianBayleef
cobblemon.species.ayreianbayleef.desc: The many buds decorating this Pokemon's neck are a fashion icon in a faraway region. Records found after the war imply that this Pokemon may have originated from that land.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmeganium.name: AyreianMeganium
cobblemon.species.ayreianmeganium.desc: These incredibly rare Pokemon formAspects natural shrines in the secluded jungles they live in, adorning them with the pink leaves of its tail.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancyndaquil.name: AyreianCyndaquil
cobblemon.species.ayreiancyndaquil.desc: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokemon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.
cobblemon.species.ayreianquilava.name: AyreianQuilava
cobblemon.species.ayreianquilava.desc: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantyphlosion.name: AyreianTyphlosion
cobblemon.species.ayreiantyphlosion.desc: In the wild, humans are highly advised to stay clear of these Pokemon. They hunt other predators and take their skull upon victory.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantotodile.name: AyreianTotodile
cobblemon.species.ayreiantotodile.desc: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancroconaw.name: AyreianCroconaw
cobblemon.species.ayreiancroconaw.desc: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
cobblemon.species.ayreianferaligatr.name: AyreianFeraligatr
cobblemon.species.ayreianferaligatr.desc: This Pokemon lives to fight, it does not hold personal grudges, it just wants to destroy everything in its path.
cobblemon.species.ayreianspinarak.name: AyreianSpinarak
cobblemon.species.ayreianspinarak.desc: It can blast a blinding light from its back to scare away predators.
cobblemon.species.ayreianariados.name: AyreianAriados
cobblemon.species.ayreianariados.desc: It can blast a blinding light from its back to scare away predators.
cobblemon.species.ayreianstantler.name: AyreianStantler
cobblemon.species.ayreianstantler.desc: The flames that burn on it's back are similar to Ponyta's, in the sense that they wont burn you if it trusts you.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantreecko.name: AyreianTreecko
cobblemon.species.ayreiantreecko.desc: Quite skittish, its diet primarily consists of twigs and leaves. It mimetizes with the environment to escape danger.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrovyle.name: AyreianGrovyle
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrovyle.desc: The sheer power gained from evolution changed this Pokemon's metabolism, as it now behaves like an ambush predator.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansceptile.name: AyreianSceptile
cobblemon.species.ayreiansceptile.desc: It can adapt to any and all environments, sitting at the top of the food chain. Because of this, they are an invasive species in most areas of the world.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantorchic.name: AyreianTorchic
cobblemon.species.ayreiantorchic.desc: Their immense ghostly energy allows them to summon additional limbs for a short time, but their inexperience makes them quite clumsy.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancombusken.name: AyreianCombusken
cobblemon.species.ayreiancombusken.desc: They blend in seemlessly with the shadows, which enable an easy ambush. When ignored, they will sometimes attack their own trainer.
cobblemon.species.ayreianblaziken.name: AyreianBlaziken
cobblemon.species.ayreianblaziken.desc: Wild and unpredictable, their legs kick the life out of their opponents. The floating limbs disappear if they stray too far from the main body.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmudkip.name: AyreianMudkip
cobblemon.species.ayreianmudkip.desc: These Mudkips can be found sleeping soundly under frozen lakes. Their tails connect to the ice above, allowing them to sense vibrations from threats above.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmarshtomp.name: AyreianMarshtomp
cobblemon.species.ayreianmarshtomp.desc: Their icy blankets support their sleeping bodies and provide a shelter for small fish Pokemon. Unfortunately if they wander to close to its snoring mouth they may become a midnight snack.
cobblemon.species.ayreianswampert.name: AyreianSwampert
cobblemon.species.ayreianswampert.desc: Its hibernation can preserve itself for years past the typical life span of a Pokemon its size.
cobblemon.species.ayreianzigzagoon.name: AyreianZigzagoon
cobblemon.species.ayreianzigzagoon.desc: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.
cobblemon.species.ayreianlinoone.name: AyreianLinoone
cobblemon.species.ayreianlinoone.desc: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.
cobblemon.species.ayreianralts.name: AyreianRalts
cobblemon.species.ayreianralts.desc: Its black plumage is said to bring misfortune to others near it.
cobblemon.species.ayreiankirlia.name: AyreianKirlia
cobblemon.species.ayreiankirlia.desc: It uses wind currents to dance about in the night sky, even while hunting.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangardevoir.name: AyreianGardevoir
cobblemon.species.ayreiangardevoir.desc: It has a latent power to read minds. A folktale tells that, long ago, this Pokemon and its 'mirrored image' served a malicious king.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantropius.name: AyreianTropius
cobblemon.species.ayreiantropius.desc: The bunch of fruit around its neck, while delicious, is fiercely guarded by Tropius. They nest in the secluded depths of jungles.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansnorunt.name: AyreianSnorunt
cobblemon.species.ayreiansnorunt.desc: It attaches itself to the ceiling of volcanic caves to absorb heat, which it then releases to fly around.
cobblemon.species.ayreianglalie.name: AyreianGlalie
cobblemon.species.ayreianglalie.desc: It can shoot concentrated energy waves from its horns. Its fire burns with a bright blue when it's enraged.
cobblemon.species.ayreiannosepass.name: AyreianNosepass
cobblemon.species.ayreiannosepass.desc: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.
cobblemon.species.ayreianaron.name: AyreianAron
cobblemon.species.ayreianaron.desc: When Aron evolves, it leaves behind molten pebbles. In ancient times, people would collect Aron's shed rocks to warm themselves.
cobblemon.species.ayreianlairon.name: AyreianLairon
cobblemon.species.ayreianlairon.desc: During territorial disputes, Lairon emits high amounts of steam. Close inspection of their magma armor reveals scratches and dents.
cobblemon.species.ayreianaggron.name: AyreianAggron
cobblemon.species.ayreianaggron.desc: The temperature inside Aggron's core can be compared to that of an industrial furnace. When threatened, it blows molten rock out of the pores on its back.
cobblemon.species.ayreianroselia.name: AyreianRoselia
cobblemon.species.ayreianroselia.desc: It will fire rapid strikes from the toxic flowers on its hands if it feels threatened.
cobblemon.species.ayreiannumel.name: AyreianNumel
cobblemon.species.ayreiannumel.desc: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancamerupt.name: AyreianCamerupt
cobblemon.species.ayreiancamerupt.desc: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantrapinch.name: AyreianTrapinch
cobblemon.species.ayreiantrapinch.desc: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvibrava.name: AyreianVibrava
cobblemon.species.ayreianvibrava.desc: The loss in power during this phase has changed Vibrava's metabolism, now only feeding on plants. They are very skittish and will most likely flee when threatened.
cobblemon.species.ayreianflygon.name: AyreianFlygon
cobblemon.species.ayreianflygon.desc: The loss in power during this phase has changed Vibrava's metabolism, now only feeding on plants. They are very skittish and will most likely flee when threatened.
cobblemon.species.ayreianswablu.name: AyreianSwablu
cobblemon.species.ayreianswablu.desc: While cute and seemingly docile, it angers really quickly. They nest in areas most often hit by thunderstorms.
cobblemon.species.ayreianaltaria.name: AyreianAltaria
cobblemon.species.ayreianaltaria.desc: Only seen during thunderstorms, they brave the dark skies uncontested in both ferocity and boldness.
cobblemon.species.ayreianlunatone.name: AyreianLunatone
cobblemon.species.ayreianlunatone.desc: Different types of music can be heard coming from it, depending on the mood it's in.
cobblemon.species.ayreianrelicanth.name: AyreianRelicanth
cobblemon.species.ayreianrelicanth.desc: Said to be an incredibly old species gone extinct, a few specimen have begun appearing near the shores of Ayrei. They look lifeless at a glance.
cobblemon.species.ayreianabsol.name: AyreianAbsol
cobblemon.species.ayreianabsol.desc: Records released to the public just after the war state that Absol instinctively punished those that would bring harm to the forests near the conflict.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpachirisu.name: AyreianPachirisu
cobblemon.species.ayreianpachirisu.desc: The two sides of Pachirisu are a perfect parallel to each other. While the pale one barely looks alive, the other is hyperactive and dangerous.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmunchlax.name: AyreianMunchlax
cobblemon.species.ayreianmunchlax.desc: It feels immense joy from harassing others. You'll often find them in the wild, throwing rocks or snow at people and Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.ayreianriolu.name: AyreianRiolu
cobblemon.species.ayreianriolu.desc: Still new to the concept of Cyberspace, this Pokemon is the bioproduct of superfluous files from Lucario.
cobblemon.species.ayreianlucario.name: AyreianLucario
cobblemon.species.ayreianlucario.desc: By controlling the virtual realm, it can mess with its opponent's data values. However, a virus may find its way inside Lucario when its guard is down.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmantyke.name: AyreianMantyke
cobblemon.species.ayreianmantyke.desc: It burrows underground and shocks it's enemy from below as a surprise attack.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangallade.name: AyreianGallade
cobblemon.species.ayreiangallade.desc: With its latent powers, it can force anyone to do its bidding. A folktale tells that, long ago, this Pokemon and its 'mirrored image' served a malicious king.
cobblemon.species.ayreianshinx.name: AyreianShinx
cobblemon.species.ayreianshinx.desc: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
cobblemon.species.ayreianluxio.name: AyreianLuxio
cobblemon.species.ayreianluxio.desc: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
cobblemon.species.ayreianluxray.name: AyreianLuxray
cobblemon.species.ayreianluxray.desc: When in danger, the pattern on its forehead shines brightly. Its retractable claws are overcharged with high voltage electricity.
cobblemon.species.ayreianbudew.name: AyreianBudew
cobblemon.species.ayreianbudew.desc: Rarely seen in the wild, these pokemon remain particularly buried to gain nutrients. What looks like a mask is in reality a hardened shell that gives its soft body protection. When panicked it releases a spore that reduces agression, but can be very poisonous.
cobblemon.species.ayreianroserade.name: AyreianRoserade
cobblemon.species.ayreianroserade.desc: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandrifloon.name: AyreianDrifloon
cobblemon.species.ayreiandrifloon.desc: They are very fond of people and the positivity they can express. They are often found parading large festivals and parties.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandrifblim.name: AyreianDrifblim
cobblemon.species.ayreiandrifblim.desc: This Pokemon always radiates with bright colors. Lost travelers or adventurers who follow it always find their way home.
cobblemon.species.ayreianfroslass.name: AyreianFroslass
cobblemon.species.ayreianfroslass.desc: It can be seen regularly taking command of others. However, it prefers to work with its likeminded counterpart.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansnivy.name: AyreianSnivy
cobblemon.species.ayreiansnivy.desc: When they're in good health, the liquid metal they cover themselves with doesn't stick to surfaces.
cobblemon.species.ayreianservine.name: AyreianServine
cobblemon.species.ayreianservine.desc: The liquid metal its body is made of is so dense that its an incredibly heavy Pokemon, despite its minute size.
cobblemon.species.ayreianserperior.name: AyreianSerperior
cobblemon.species.ayreianserperior.desc: Its body is made up by more than 85% of liquid metal. To protect itself, it slowly exhales a noxious gas, even while sleeping.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantepig.name: AyreianTepig
cobblemon.species.ayreiantepig.desc: It can be seen sleeping soundly in lava lakes. A sick Tepig can be dangerous, as it will drool the accumulated magma from its nostrils.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpignite.name: AyreianPignite
cobblemon.species.ayreianpignite.desc: Completely different from its pre-evolution, this pokemon is savage and unruly. It stores high quantities of magma to prepare for evolution.
cobblemon.species.ayreianemboar.name: AyreianEmboar
cobblemon.species.ayreianemboar.desc: The metal shackles all over its body contain the otherwise unbridled fire energy of its core. Long ago, an Emboar with broken shackles made scorched earth of a metropolis.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidove.name: AyreianPidove
cobblemon.species.ayreianpidove.desc: It snobs other Pokemon, even shoving them aside when there's food nearby. Due to its small size, most of the time it's sent running with its tail between its legs.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantranquill.name: AyreianTranquill
cobblemon.species.ayreiantranquill.desc: Adored by old ladies, they are often found in videos online due to their grumpy nature. Seeing one in the wild is a rare sight.
cobblemon.species.ayreianunfezant.name: AyreianUnfezant
cobblemon.species.ayreianunfezant.desc: In the past, the commanding presence of Unfezant was enough to make entire civilizations bow to it. Those that stood in its way were showered by powerful toxins.
In the past, the commanding presence of Unfezant was enough to make entire civilizations bow to it. Those that stood in its way were showered by powerful toxins.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansandile.name: AyreianSandile
cobblemon.species.ayreiansandile.desc: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing snow aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the tundra as if it's swimming.
cobblemon.species.ayreiankrokorok.name: AyreianKrokorok
cobblemon.species.ayreiankrokorok.desc: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see well in water, Krokorok aren't adept swimmers.
cobblemon.species.ayreiankrookodile.name: AyreianKrookodile
cobblemon.species.ayreiankrookodile.desc: This PokÃ©mon is known as the Bully of the Tundra. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through permafrost with ease.
cobblemon.species.ayreianaxew.name: AyreianAxew
cobblemon.species.ayreianaxew.desc: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn't a concern.
cobblemon.species.ayreianfraxure.name: AyreianFraxure
cobblemon.species.ayreianfraxure.desc: Fraxure uses it's blade like tusks to cut down anyone who threatens it's territory, and unlike it's predecessor, their tusks can grow back.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhaxorus.name: AyreianHaxorus
cobblemon.species.ayreianhaxorus.desc: With it's nearly indestructable blade like tusks, this Pokemon is able to take nearly any opponent head on without consequence.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandruddigon.name: AyreianDruddigon
cobblemon.species.ayreiandruddigon.desc: Devious and opportunistic, it flies through Cyberspace in search of vulnerable files to infect. Unreliable sources say that they were made by a group of hackers that opposed the war.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantimburr.name: AyreianTimburr
cobblemon.species.ayreiantimburr.desc: Timburr seem to love the idea of building homes out of wood, but lose their mind at the site of steel.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangurdurr.name: AyreianGurdurr
cobblemon.species.ayreiangurdurr.desc: It carries around a giant log for hours upon hours without rest.
cobblemon.species.ayreianconkeldurr.name: AyreianConkeldurr
cobblemon.species.ayreianconkeldurr.desc: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandeerling.name: AyreianDeerling
cobblemon.species.ayreiandeerling.desc: At night, their horns glow with light, allowing them to communicate with other members of the herd. They are believed to have near-human intelligence.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansawsbuck.name: AyreianSawsbuck
cobblemon.species.ayreiansawsbuck.desc: These Sawsbuck grow more powerful the more knowledge they acquire, signified by the glow of their antlers. The ones with the most luminous antlers are the leaders of the herd.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvenipede.name: AyreianVenipede
cobblemon.species.ayreianvenipede.desc: Known to be territorial, they gnaw at mineral deposits and use them as fuel for their electricity.
cobblemon.species.ayreianwhirlipede.name: AyreianWhirlipede
cobblemon.species.ayreianwhirlipede.desc: They're wild and ill-tempered, but when properly trained can provide electricity to an entire neighborhood.
cobblemon.species.ayreianscolipede.name: AyreianScolipede
cobblemon.species.ayreianscolipede.desc: When threatened, Scolipede can amplify its livewires and produce enough electricity to bask an entire city in flourescent light.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandwebble.name: AyreianDwebble
cobblemon.species.ayreiandwebble.desc: The plant on top of its back secretes a sticky substance similar to glue, which is why sometimes Dwebble will have items attached to it, like Heart Scales.
cobblemon.species.ayreianarchen.name: AyreianArchen
cobblemon.species.ayreianarchen.desc: While its weight prevents it from flying, it can jump up to 30 feet in the air.
cobblemon.species.ayreianarcheops.name: AyreianArcheops
cobblemon.species.ayreianarcheops.desc: Scientists believe this was the true formAspects of Archeops, millions of years ago. Its legs are powerful enough to overturn a truck, but it is still unable to fly.
cobblemon.species.ayreianminccino.name: AyreianMinccino
cobblemon.species.ayreianminccino.desc: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancinccino.name: AyreianCinccino
cobblemon.species.ayreiancinccino.desc: Its body secretes oil that this Pokemon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
cobblemon.species.ayreianducklett.name: AyreianDucklett
cobblemon.species.ayreianducklett.desc: They're always seen either dancing or sleeping if not soaring gracefully through the air.
cobblemon.species.ayreianswanna.name: AyreianSwanna
cobblemon.species.ayreianswanna.desc: Swanna start to dance at dawn. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvanillite.name: AyreianVanillite
cobblemon.species.ayreianvanillite.desc: Unable to survive in cold areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air to cause sandstorms. It burrows into the sand to resting.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvanillish.name: AyreianVanillish
cobblemon.species.ayreianvanillish.desc: Unable to survive in cold areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air to cause sandstorms. It burrows into the sand to resting.
cobblemon.species.ayreianvanilluxe.name: AyreianVanilluxe
cobblemon.species.ayreianvanilluxe.desc: Its outer shell is as hot as the inside of an active volcano. It obliviously burns everything in its vicinity to a crisp, be it friend or foe.
cobblemon.species.ayreianskiddo.name: AyreianSkiddo
cobblemon.species.ayreianskiddo.desc: These Pokemon prefer to live in areas with harsh climate, as they can withstand most elements.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangogoat.name: AyreianGogoat
cobblemon.species.ayreiangogoat.desc: Being incredibly defensive of their offspring, these Pokemon will purposely cause avalanches to scare away mountain climbers.
cobblemon.species.ayreianphantump.name: AyreianPhantump
cobblemon.species.ayreianphantump.desc: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantrevenant.name: AyreianTrevenant
cobblemon.species.ayreiantrevenant.desc: A collection of lost spirits, with the sole purpose of defending wildlife from those who seek to destroy it.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpancham.name: AyreianPancham
cobblemon.species.ayreianpancham.desc: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpangoro.name: AyreianPangoro
cobblemon.species.ayreianpangoro.desc: Angrier than a raging inferno, it pummels opponents with a fiery might. The fire emanating from its body is hot enough to melt the metal of a jet plane.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancarbink.name: AyreianCarbink
cobblemon.species.ayreiancarbink.desc: The bands of iron spinning around it's core protect it from almost every kind of attack.
cobblemon.species.ayreianklefki.name: AyreianKlefki
cobblemon.species.ayreianklefki.desc: Radiating with electricity, it was commonly used to access electronically locked facilities.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpumpkaboo.name: AyreianPumpkaboo
cobblemon.species.ayreianpumpkaboo.desc: When taking spirits to the afterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to those of adults.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangourgeist.name: AyreianGourgeist
cobblemon.species.ayreiangourgeist.desc: Soft cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are resting in the afterlife.
cobblemon.species.ayreiannoibat.name: AyreianNoibat
cobblemon.species.ayreiannoibat.desc: It likes to think it has wings that allow it to fly when in reality it just floats around.
cobblemon.species.ayreiannoivern.name: AyreianNoivern
cobblemon.species.ayreiannoivern.desc: While it may look intimidating, it has a gentle and caring disposition. That said, it will shoot down anyone threatening its protege with beams of light.
cobblemon.species.ayreianfennekin.name: AyreianFennekin
cobblemon.species.ayreianfennekin.desc: This Pokemon is only seen near secluded icy lakes. They only emerge to drink from the springs when they are alone.
cobblemon.species.ayreianbraixen.name: AyreianBraixen
cobblemon.species.ayreianbraixen.desc: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
cobblemon.species.ayreiandelphox.name: AyreianDelphox
cobblemon.species.ayreiandelphox.desc: Travelers may be able to witness the songs of these foxes during an aurora. However, their voices also enhance the ice they use to chase off unwanted company.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantyrunt.name: AyreianTyrunt
cobblemon.species.ayreiantyrunt.desc: This is an ancient Pokémon. It has a violent disposition, and it uses its hefty jaws to tear everything apart.
cobblemon.species.ayreiantyrantrum.name: AyreianTyrantrum
cobblemon.species.ayreiantyrantrum.desc: After being buried for 100,000,000 years in a volcano, this Pokémon has been altered by the heat. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.
cobblemon.species.ayreianlitleo.name: AyreianLitleo
cobblemon.species.ayreianlitleo.desc: It can be found in greatly polluted areas. The fumes that emit from their mane can knock out a full-grown adult.
cobblemon.species.ayreianpyroar.name: AyreianPyroar
cobblemon.species.ayreianpyroar.desc: Adapted to the polluted grounds that have become its territory, it preys upon the smaller Pokémon in the urban landscape and defends its territory viciously from humankind.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancutiefly.name: AyreianCutiefly
cobblemon.species.ayreiancutiefly.desc: It propels itself forward by combusting its sweat, which creates a small explosion as it is similar to gunpowder.
cobblemon.species.ayreianribombee.name: AyreianRibombee
cobblemon.species.ayreianribombee.desc: During the New Year night, multiple Ribombee can be seen fluttering in the sky, creating eye-striking explosions via their peculiar powder.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmimikyu.name: AyreianMimikyu
cobblemon.species.ayreianmimikyu.desc: Said to be a furious spirit that inhabited a popular doll. When said doll is damaged, the hatred of the specter takes formAspects.
cobblemon.species.ayreianyungoos.name: AyreianYungoos
cobblemon.species.ayreianyungoos.desc: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangumshoos.name: AyreianGumshoos
cobblemon.species.ayreiangumshoos.desc: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrookey.name: AyreianGrookey
cobblemon.species.ayreiangrookey.desc: It attacks with rapid jolts of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more charged.
cobblemon.species.ayreianthwackey.name: AyreianThwackey
cobblemon.species.ayreianthwackey.desc: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.
cobblemon.species.ayreianrillaboom.name: AyreianRillaboom
cobblemon.species.ayreianrillaboom.desc: Its ferocious drumming summons violent thunderstorms. It uses wind currents to direct its electric attacks.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansizzlipede.name: AyreianSizzlipede
cobblemon.species.ayreiansizzlipede.desc: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
cobblemon.species.ayreiancentiskorch.des: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokemon also has large and very sharp fangs.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhatenna.name: AyreianHatenna
cobblemon.species.ayreianhatenna.desc: Aware of its cuteness, it invites itself in the dens of other Pokemon and slowly fills them with spider webs.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhattrem.name: AyreianHattrem
cobblemon.species.ayreianhattrem.desc: Its leg-hairs have enough power to bend a metal pole in two. Because of this, they have no natural predators, and thrive in gloomy forests.
cobblemon.species.ayreianhatterene.name: AyreianHatterene
cobblemon.species.ayreianhatterene.desc: It plays with its prey with unimaginable cruelty, as it feeds off of terror. Usually, it leaves the poor victim's life hanging on by a thread, literally.
cobblemon.species.ayreianobstagoon.name: AyreianObstagoon
cobblemon.species.ayreianobstagoon.desc: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
cobblemon.species.ayreianalcremie.name: AyreianAlcremie
cobblemon.species.ayreianalcremie.desc: A run-in with a mixer caused the cream to spiral. Those lucky enough to taste its rich flavour say it's to die for.
cobblemon.species.ayreiansprigatito.name: AyreianSprigatito
cobblemon.species.ayreiansprigatito.desc: When it knows it cannot win, it will messily summon a cloud of poisonous gas and attempt a quick getaway.
cobblemon.species.ayreianfloragato.name: AyreianFloragato
cobblemon.species.ayreianfloragato.desc: Floragato deftly wields the poisonous flower buds under its hoodie, throwing them at opponents like grenades.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmeowscarada.des: While it may look innocent, it has a dangerous personality. It tricks other Pokemon into accepting its bouquet, which then erupts into a shower of venomous spikes.
cobblemon.species.ayreianquaxly.name: AyreianQuaxly
cobblemon.species.ayreianquaxly.desc: They aim for a clean mind state, but they are still inexperienced, and will anger quickly.
cobblemon.species.ayreianquaxwell.name: AyreianQuaxwell
cobblemon.species.ayreianquaxwell.desc: They nest behind waterfalls, meditating for up to 10 hours a day. That said, the slightest mischief can send them into a frenzy.
cobblemon.species.ayreianquaquaval.name: AyreianQuaquaval
cobblemon.species.ayreianquaquaval.desc: After reaching a crystal clear state of mind, this Pokemon can execute even the most head-spinning dance moves flawlessly.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmagnemite.name: AyreianMagnemite
cobblemon.species.ayreianmagnemite.desc: At times, Magnemite runs out of fuel and ends up on the ground. If you give coal to a grounded Magnemite, it'll start moving again.
cobblemon.species.ayreianmagneton.name: AyreianMagneton
cobblemon.species.ayreianmagneton.desc: The two heads that aren't constantly burning are always trying to detatch themselves from the third head, with little result.
cobblemon.species.magnemelt.name: Magnemelt
cobblemon.species.magnemelt.desc: It is so surrounded by magma that you'll almost never see it's original body.
cobblemon.species.ayreianluvdisc.name: AyreianLuvdisc
cobblemon.species.ayreianluvdisc.desc: It floats about pretending to be dead, waiting for its prey to approach before attacking.
cobblemon.species.loathedisc.name: Loathedisc
cobblemon.species.loathedisc.desc: It floats about pretending to be dead, waiting for its prey to approach before attacking.
cobblemon.species.gyropass.name: Gyropass
cobblemon.species.gyropass.desc: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
cobblemon.species.amacorala.name: Amacorala
cobblemon.species.amacorala.desc: It's hard as rock skin, and fast firing water from it's head made it the perfect frontline during conflict.
cobblemon.species.solacor.name: Solacor
cobblemon.species.solacor.desc: When a Corsola's home waters get polluted, there is a chance that it may evolve into Solacor as a means of survival. Solacor's rocky armor is fragile and crumbling, but can be manipulated however it sees fit to protect its watery core.
cobblemon.species.dunmyth.name: Dunmyth
cobblemon.species.dunmyth.desc: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
cobblemon.species.dundragon.name: Dundragon
