cobblemon.species.rhinplink.name: Rhinplink
cobblemon.species.rhinplink.desc: Its back is covered by rock-like plate. Its horn is like natural fertilizer and can be used to plant any crops.
cobblemon.species.trunkorn.name: Trunkorn
cobblemon.species.trunkorn.desc: The trunk on its horn is known as one of the hardest woods on the world. It willingly lets people harvest its trunk when it overgrows.
cobblemon.species.rhintain.name: Rhintain
cobblemon.species.rhintain.desc: Its massive front legs have a pressure of 130,000-pounds. Even titanium can bend under its pressure.
cobblemon.species.skindling.name: Skindling
cobblemon.species.skindling.desc: Skindling's back is covered with a flammable substance. It sets itself on fire to scare away predators.
cobblemon.species.skingnite.name: Skingnite
cobblemon.species.skingnite.desc: During combat, its body generates a lot of energy and heats up very quickly. To cool down, it uses small geysers located on its back.
cobblemon.species.eruptile.name: Eruptile
cobblemon.species.eruptile.desc: When enraged, it enters a state of overheating. During this state, it randomly releases lava eruptions from his back.
cobblemon.species.dampybara.name: Dampybara
cobblemon.species.dampybara.desc: When its fur is wet it become slippery like oil. It uses that advantage to escape even from the clasped jaws.
cobblemon.species.glovet.name: Glovet
cobblemon.species.glovet.desc: Is increases the weight of its gloves by filling them with water. That water is used to make its punches hit even harder.
cobblemon.species.mortarine.name: Mortarine
cobblemon.species.mortarine.desc: Its big gloves contain pressurized water. During impact all water is rapidly released empowering its blow.
cobblemon.species.petidaw.name: Petidaw
cobblemon.species.petidaw.desc: This little bird loves shiny things. It often steals goods completely unaware.
cobblemon.species.croober.name: Croober
cobblemon.species.croober.desc: Croobers prove they worth through stealing. The more loot one owns the more respect it has among its species.
cobblemon.species.ravendler.name: Ravendler
cobblemon.species.ravendler.desc: It's an average sized bird that likes to steal everything it is interested with, no matter who this thing belongs to. Sometimes convinces other Pokémon to steal for its.
cobblemon.species.chubboink.name: Chubboink
cobblemon.species.chubboink.desc: It covers itself with a layer of mud to protect its skin. Often prefers hiding in tall grass to avoid danger.
cobblemon.species.muchog.name: Muchog
cobblemon.species.muchog.desc: During battle it easily enters a rampaging state, that makes its attacks more likely to miss. Despite of its chaotic behavior it makes a great companion.
cobblemon.species.mikitarianbuneary.name: MikitarianBuneary
cobblemon.species.mikitarianbuneary.desc: It adapted to nightlife style. Under the night cover it sneak to the farmlands to steal crops.
cobblemon.species.mikitarianlopunny.name: MikitarianLopunny
cobblemon.species.mikitarianlopunny.desc: It likes to toy with anyone who wander into the forest at night. It uses any opportunity to steal from humans.
cobblemon.species.furrva.name: Furrva
cobblemon.species.furrva.desc: Its fur is pointy and gives itches when touched, this discourages predators from hunting on it.
cobblemon.species.kocomb.name: Kocomb
cobblemon.species.kocomb.desc: Its shell is covered by sweet substance that a certain Pokémon loves to lick. In exchange for its sweet taste, that Pokémon protects Kocomb from predators.
cobblemon.species.granebee.name: Granebee
cobblemon.species.granebee.desc: In its hive it takes the role of a collector. While gathering nectar it is guarded by Beelitant.
cobblemon.species.beelitant.name: Beelitant
cobblemon.species.beelitant.desc: In its hive it takes the role of a protector. It guards Granebees while they are gathering nectar and helps to transport it.
cobblemon.species.hopidey.name: Hopidey
cobblemon.species.hopidey.desc: Due to its short legs it has a disability to walk properly. Instead of walking it uses jumps to move.
cobblemon.species.raknaleap.name: Raknaleap
cobblemon.species.raknaleap.desc: Its legs act like springs. By pressing its body against the ground, its legs squeeze so tightly that the release of this pressure results in a powerful leap.
cobblemon.species.lilleo.name: Lilleo
cobblemon.species.lilleo.desc: Lilleos disobedience and chaotic nature make it incredibly hard to train. It must see the trainer as an alpha to obey.
cobblemon.species.germeit.name: Germeit
cobblemon.species.germeit.desc: Its mane is rough and jagged. Making physical contact with its fur can easily damage skin and inject various diseases.
cobblemon.species.mikitarianspritzee.des: It emits a scent that confuses those who smell it. There are rumors that Spritzees leads confused victims to Traumatisse's lairs.
cobblemon.species.traumatisse.name: Traumatisse
cobblemon.species.traumatisse.desc: Anyone who finds himself in its lair will slowly lose consciousness. It will do precise surgery that cures any diseases but leave patient with deep trauma.
cobblemon.species.troutle.name: Troutle
cobblemon.species.troutle.desc: In the early stage of its life, it doesn't have any stripe. Basculins will not attack Troutle unless its stripe is visible.
cobblemon.species.basstile.name: Basstile
cobblemon.species.basstile.desc: Basstilles are the leaders of Basculins schools. If a Basculin in its school evolve, then two Basstiles fight for leadership. The loser is banished.
cobblemon.species.cabat.name: Cabat
cobblemon.species.cabat.desc: To remain unseen it hangs motionless on the cave ceiling, during this act it looks completely like stalactite. During mating season it migrate to snowy mountains.
cobblemon.species.femalecabat.name: FemaleCabat
cobblemon.species.femalecabat.desc: Its fur is snow-white, which makes it easy to lost track of it in the snow. During mating season it awaits for migrating males.
cobblemon.species.stalat.name: Stalat
cobblemon.species.stalat.desc: For some reason it evolved without a partner. Sometimes at night you can hear its sad screech.
cobblemon.species.stalass.name: Stalass
cobblemon.species.stalass.desc: For some reason it evolved without a partner. During the mating season, it will reject other males and remain alone forever.
cobblemon.species.packbats.name: Packbats
cobblemon.species.packbats.desc: Cabats evolve into this Pokémon during mating season. They never splits up and always help each other out.
cobblemon.species.femalepackbats.name: FemalePackbats
cobblemon.species.femalepackbats.desc: Cabats evolve into this Pokémon during mating season. They never splits up and always helps each other out.
cobblemon.species.sprousy.name: Sprousy
cobblemon.species.sprousy.desc: Very friendly and playful Pokémon. Sproutsy blooms in the company of people it fully trusts.
cobblemon.species.petalnia.name: Petalnia
cobblemon.species.petalnia.desc: It can be distrustful at first. If a trainer manages to create a strong bond with it, Petalnias will make a loyal companion.
cobblemon.species.floramona.name: Floramona
cobblemon.species.floramona.desc: Only the most trustworthy can befriend a Floramona. Its strength reflect the trust of its trainer.
cobblemon.species.geocko.name: Geocko
cobblemon.species.geocko.desc: Always found in places with a lot of vertical surfaces, such as mountains or caves. This Pokémon sheds its rocky tail onto its predator's head to stun it.
cobblemon.species.grexclub.name: Grexclub
cobblemon.species.grexclub.desc: Grexclub sheds its own tail and uses it like a club. Due to its calm nature, it never attack unless it's necessary.
cobblemon.species.geolidon.name: Geolidon
cobblemon.species.geolidon.desc: Known by its destructive force, Geolidons can create small earthquakes by a single swing of its club into the ground.
cobblemon.species.mikitarianoricorio.des: It confuses its foes by jumping from one leg to another. This Oricorio movement is unpredictable but organized.
cobblemon.species.mikitarianyamask.name: MikitarianYamask
cobblemon.species.mikitarianyamask.desc: The spirit of a person sacrificed in some ritual became this Pokémon. Its carrying a mask that the person was wearing in its last moments.
cobblemon.species.platerigus.name: Platerigus
cobblemon.species.platerigus.desc: This Pokémon has written text on it that no one can read. People say that whoever reads it will know the true date of the beginning of the end of everything.
cobblemon.species.sphertle.name: Sphertle
cobblemon.species.sphertle.desc: When it hides into its shell, it starts to roll uncontrollably. In this state it can easily break through brick walls.
cobblemon.species.wroomtoise.name: Wroomtoise
cobblemon.species.wroomtoise.desc: When it rolls, it can easily travel through any terrain. It leaving behind a trail in the formAspects of a shallow ditch.
cobblemon.species.octolet.name: Octolet
cobblemon.species.octolet.desc: An extremely strange creature with a strong self-awareness. There are rumors that it comes from another planet.
cobblemon.species.octokinepus.name: Octokinepus
cobblemon.species.octokinepus.desc: It never loses focus no matter the situation. Octokinepus psychic powers allows it to invade other creatures minds.
cobblemon.species.mantoon.name: Mantoon
cobblemon.species.mantoon.desc: It can inflate its wings to float on the water surface. People often use Montoon to learn swimming.
cobblemon.species.stormanta.name: Stormanta
cobblemon.species.stormanta.desc: This Pokémon can often be seen riding large waves during storms. People like to use it for extreme surfing.
cobblemon.species.hauntray.name: Hauntray
cobblemon.species.hauntray.desc: When sailing on the sea at night, a small blue light can be observed under the water. This is a school of Hauntrays.
cobblemon.species.phantabys.name: Phantabys
cobblemon.species.phantabys.desc: The light of his lantern attracts souls, which he then devours. The more it consumes, the brighter its light becomes.
cobblemon.species.sneepy.name: Sneepy
cobblemon.species.sneepy.desc: The strong scent of coffee wafts around Sneepy. It's impossible to fall asleep when you're around this Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.flambafee.name: Flambafee
cobblemon.species.flambafee.desc: The coffee beans ripening on its body are a delicacy among gourmets. Harvesting these beans is a challenge because Flambafee likes to eat them.
cobblemon.species.homurant.name: Homurant
cobblemon.species.homurant.desc: It stores a very hot substance in its abdomen. To defend its colony from a predator, it increases the pressure in its abdomen and explodes.
cobblemon.species.commant.name: Commant
cobblemon.species.commant.desc: Its body is not very durable. Individuals sneak into the Durants or Homurants colony to steal their eggs and raise them as their own.
cobblemon.species.mikitarianfalinks.name: MikitarianFalinks
cobblemon.species.mikitarianfalinks.desc: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.
cobblemon.species.goobolt.name: Goobolt
cobblemon.species.goobolt.desc: Goobolt's slime stores electricity well. It is used by humans to create batteries and accumulators.
cobblemon.species.chargoo.name: Chargoo
cobblemon.species.chargoo.desc: It likes to charge itself with electricity by climbing high-voltage poles. When fully charged, the tip of its shell lights up.
cobblemon.species.plasmatina.name: Plasmatina
cobblemon.species.plasmatina.desc: Plasmatina covers its lair with electrically conductive slime. When someone enters its area, it releases a powerful discharge.
cobblemon.species.flampy.name: Flampy
cobblemon.species.flampy.desc: At first glance, it looks safe and friendly. But if someone carelessly approaches it, then it strikes.
cobblemon.species.murasalem.name: Murasalem
cobblemon.species.murasalem.desc: Murasalem is very aggressive by nature. During combat, it attacks madly until it tires out.
cobblemon.species.crishy.name: Crishy
cobblemon.species.crishy.desc: Living in polluted lakes made its body resistant to diseases. Its infected body became its defense system against predators.
cobblemon.species.contamullet.name: Contamullet
cobblemon.species.contamullet.desc: Contamullet body has adapted to diseases to such an extent, that curing them will lead to its death.
cobblemon.species.timpot.name: Timpot
cobblemon.species.timpot.desc: A very timid Pokémon that doesn't like being exposed. Once seen, it runs away and looks for a new hiding place.
cobblemon.species.prankmare.name: Prankmare
cobblemon.species.prankmare.desc: It loves hiding in various objects to scare people and Pokémon. Every successful prank fills it with joy.
cobblemon.species.slidune.name: Slidune
cobblemon.species.slidune.desc: By lying on the sand and wiggling its tail, it can move extremely fast. Slidune live in deserts since a long time ago.
cobblemon.species.duntesert.name: Duntesert
cobblemon.species.duntesert.desc: It can bury itself in sand in the blink of an eye. While in the sand, it moves with extraordinary agility.
cobblemon.species.glyptoblock.name: Glyptoblock
cobblemon.species.glyptoblock.desc: There is a pleasant warmth around Glyptoblock. Other Pokemon like lying in its warm.
cobblemon.species.furnadon.name: Furnadon
cobblemon.species.furnadon.desc: The fiery core placed in its shell never burns out. In self-defense, Furnadon increases the temperature of its shell, burning anyone who touches it.
cobblemon.species.dorewee.name: Dorewee
cobblemon.species.dorewee.desc: A friendly and very lovable Pokémon. Its sounds resemble a squeaky toy.
cobblemon.species.doperami.name: Doperami
cobblemon.species.doperami.desc: When Doperami makes a high-pitched sound, all the glass in the area shatters. There were cases where people lost consciousness from its high pitch.
cobblemon.species.peclay.name: Peclay
cobblemon.species.peclay.desc: Peclay's clay shell protects it from being carried away by a sandstorm. It uses its strong legs to launch itself like a cannonball.
cobblemon.species.tektalon.name: Tektalon
cobblemon.species.tektalon.desc: To increase the power of its kicks, it covers its legs with a clay coating. Some Tektalons create a helmet from clay on their head.
cobblemon.species.munchill.name: Munchill
cobblemon.species.munchill.desc: Munchill lies buried in the snow, waiting to clench its jaws at the first thing that comes by. Once it grabs something in its jaws, it won't let go.
cobblemon.species.crunchill.name: Crunchill
cobblemon.species.crunchill.desc: Its jaws can freeze anything it bites. Crunchill then brutally shatters the frozen object.
cobblemon.species.lediastra.name: Lediastra
cobblemon.species.lediastra.desc: When Lediastra strikes, its fists shine as bright as a star. It can be seen at night when the sky is clear.
cobblemon.species.glanchog.name: Glanchog
cobblemon.species.glanchog.desc: It works great as a home guard Pokémon. It is so focused that it almost never blinks and anyone who looks directly into its eyes will be confused.
cobblemon.species.porygona.name: PorygonA
cobblemon.species.porygona.desc: It's the first prototype of Porygon. Often freezes in place analyzing what to do next and its movement is chaotic.
cobblemon.species.mikitariannoctowl.name: MikitarianNoctowl
cobblemon.species.sufferub.name: Sufferub
cobblemon.species.sufferub.desc: It appeared out of nowhere and quickly spread throughout the forests. It appears to be closely related to Weedle.
cobblemon.species.inhalis.name: Inhalis
cobblemon.species.inhalis.desc: Its cocoon is flexible and very durable, but if something breaks it, Inhalis dies immediately.
cobblemon.species.gasarnet.name: Gasarnet
cobblemon.species.gasarnet.desc: Artificially created Pokémon by a mad scientist. It spreads toxic fumes in its surroundings, which is why it is considered as a biological hazard.
cobblemon.species.lambi.name: Lambi
cobblemon.species.lambi.desc: Its body is covered with a thick layer of wool. This coating allows it to survive in extremely low temperatures.
cobblemon.species.mourin.name: Mourin
cobblemon.species.mourin.desc: It can move extremely agilely on very steep surfaces. keeping up with it in mountainous terrain is almost impossible.
cobblemon.species.keerin.name: Keerin
cobblemon.species.keerin.desc: Legends say that it can be found high in snowy mountains. Travelers describe it as a mysterious creature that walks on a frozen lake during the full moon.
cobblemon.species.flarepent.name: Flarepent
cobblemon.species.flarepent.desc: It wraps around prey and increases its own body temperature. Victims captured like this are cooked alive.
cobblemon.species.singepent.name: Singepent
cobblemon.species.singepent.desc: The black part at the end of its tail keeps heat for long time. Its tail functions like a thermal knife.
cobblemon.species.conflevour.name: Conflevour
cobblemon.species.conflevour.desc: Conflevours adore to stay above the others. Due to its proudness it wants to be perceived as the superior creature.
cobblemon.species.geckrow.name: Geckrow
cobblemon.species.geckrow.desc: Geckrow live in humid jungles and constantly climb the large trees. In the morning, they soak up the sunlight from the canopy, but when the day turns too hot, they descend to the floor to cool themselves in mud pools.
cobblemon.species.goanopy.name: Goanopy
cobblemon.species.goanopy.desc: Goanopy spend most of their time resting on the wide bows of tree branches, soaking up the sun, and only descend to hunt for prey. To discourage scavengers, they haul their meals high above the jungle floor before eating them.
cobblemon.species.varanitor.name: Varanitor
cobblemon.species.varanitor.desc: Unlike their earlier evolved forms, Varanitor spend much of their time on the ground resting alongside stream beds and basking in streams of sunlight that reach the floor. If they feel they are not getting enough sunlight, they will uproot and knock over large trees to clear the sky.
cobblemon.species.hissiorite.name: Hissiorite
cobblemon.species.hissiorite.desc: The base of it's neck emits super-heated gas that envelopes its body and causes it to have fewer inches off the ground, similar to a hot air balloon.
cobblemon.species.cobarett.name: Cobarett
cobblemon.species.cobarett.desc: It covers itself in thick, billowing smoke so that it can slide easily through thick brush. The source of the smoke is its molten body temperature.
cobblemon.species.pythonova.name: Pythonova
cobblemon.species.pythonova.desc: It is short tempered and when enraged, the flames on its back burn hotter and its smoke tail becomes thicker and longer.
cobblemon.species.ninoala.name: Ninoala
cobblemon.species.ninoala.desc: Concept, design, front sprite, and type by Feyrah on DeviantArt. Icon by Plouton. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.koaninja.name: Koaninja
cobblemon.species.koaninja.desc: Concept, design, front sprite, and type by Feyrah on DeviantArt. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.anu.name: Anu
cobblemon.species.anu.desc: Concept, design, sprite, type, and dex flavor by Princess-Phoenix Name by Dawn23 This fakemon originates from Princess-Phoenix's 'Project Freemon' on DeviantArt. Evo line: Incomplete
cobblemon.species.merlicun.name: Merlicun
cobblemon.species.merlicun.desc: It isn't considered very useful in any way what so ever. It seems to just want to crawl around and eat leaves.
cobblemon.species.firomenis.name: Firomenis
cobblemon.species.firomenis.desc: It isn't considered very useful in any way what so ever. It seems to just want to crawl around and eat leaves.
cobblemon.species.baoby.name: Baoby
cobblemon.species.baoby.desc: Baoby travel from river to river in search of water to drink and store. The leafy ossicones on its head conceal movable points that act similar to a dowsing rod. Many creatures follow Baoby in droughts.
cobblemon.species.baobaraffe.name: Baobaraffe
cobblemon.species.baobaraffe.desc: Concept, design, sprites, name, and type by Princess-Phoenix This fakemon originates from Princess-Phoenix's 'Project Freemon' on DeviantArt. The original inspiration for this fakemon came from reading an article about how the baobab trees have huge fat trunks because it stores water in them, but due to droughts the trees were collapsing a few years ago. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.nuenflu.name: Nuenflu
cobblemon.species.nuenflu.desc: Nuenflu secretly spreads diseases during the winter months.
cobblemon.species.drashimi.name: Drashimi
cobblemon.species.drashimi.desc: Concept, design, sprites, and type by Princess-Phoenix Name assist credit to Tenrio This fakemon originates from Princess-Phoenix's 'Project Freemon' on DeviantArt. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.tsushimi.name: Tsushimi
cobblemon.species.tsushimi.desc: Concept, design, sprites, and type by Princess-Phoenix Name assist credit to Tenrio This fakemon originates from Princess-Phoenix's 'Project Freemon' on DeviantArt. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.tobishimi.name: Tobishimi
cobblemon.species.tobishimi.desc: Concept, design, sprites, and type by Princess-Phoenix Name assist credit to Tenrio This fakemon originates from Princess-Phoenix's 'Project Freemon' on DeviantArt. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.baulder.name: Baulder
cobblemon.species.baulder.desc: Baulder has lived in the depths of Mythan for almost 7,000 years. It is said that this Pokemon is incredibly smart.
cobblemon.species.dreadrock.name: Dreadrock
cobblemon.species.dreadrock.desc: Dredrock have one of the toughest coats known in Pokemon history, it's sad the weight of 5,000 tons can't even break it.
cobblemon.species.tekagon.name: Tekagon
cobblemon.species.tekagon.desc: Tekagon roam their territory in search of plants to eat. They are blind, but can feel vibrations through the ground from great distances. Tekagon recognize the vibrations their family gives off.
cobblemon.species.nymbi.name: Nymbi
cobblemon.species.nymbi.desc: Concept, Name, Type by Smiley Fakemon Front sprite TheGreatZeKro Icon by Plouton These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.deember.name: Deember
cobblemon.species.deember.desc: Concept, Name, Type by Smiley Fakemon Front sprite TheGreatZeKro These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.lavee.name: Lavee
cobblemon.species.lavee.desc: Lavee was known for its incredibly fast swimming skills in lava, this Pokemon can handle tempatures up to 750,000,000 degrees.
cobblemon.species.lavare.name: Lavare
cobblemon.species.lavare.desc: Lavee was known for its incredibly fast swimming skills in lava, this Pokemon can handle tempatures up to 750,000,000 degrees.
cobblemon.species.efflutal.name: Efflutal
cobblemon.species.efflutal.desc: Concept, Name, Type by Arnik Sprites by Anarlaurendil These designs/sprites are originally created for an abandoned french GBA ROM-hack called 'Pokémon Cristal de Jade', and now features in Pokémon Sacred Phoenix
cobblemon.species.hayog.name: Hayog
cobblemon.species.hayog.desc: Hayog have a strong instinct to build themselves homes, unfortunately they tend to choose flimsy building materials. The hay that grows on its back is very soft and provides Hayog comfort and security.
cobblemon.species.hogouse.name: Hogouse
cobblemon.species.hogouse.desc: Design, name, type, flavour, and sprites by Scotsman333 These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.hogriks.name: Hogriks
cobblemon.species.hogriks.desc: Losing the grass typing on evolution has made Hogriks' body much less susceptible to being blown down. Often found resting near small villages, Hogriks will let small Pokemon take refuge inside its fortified body.
cobblemon.species.webruiser.name: Webruiser
cobblemon.species.webruiser.desc: Webruiser stands on its mandibles and swings at its foes with its legs, its thorax has a fake face to act as a punching bag for enemies. It may look dazed or confused as it stumbles around the battlefield, but this is a tactic to deter its opponents. Its punches are wild but calculated.
cobblemon.species.pilfetch.name: Pilfetch
cobblemon.species.pilfetch.desc: Design, Name, and Sprites by AceTrainerAvery These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.criminalis.name: Criminalis
cobblemon.species.criminalis.desc: Design, Name, and Sprites by AceTrainerAvery These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack.
cobblemon.species.pasturlo.name: Pasturlo
cobblemon.species.pasturlo.desc: Pasturlo tries its best to stay asleep at all times, but gets extremely angry when it is awoken from its slumber.
cobblemon.species.brambull.name: Brambull
cobblemon.species.brambull.desc: A thick cover of leaves coats their wooly mane and covers over their eyes, though they can still see fine.
cobblemon.species.maizotaur.name: Maizotaur
cobblemon.species.maizotaur.desc: The leaves that grow over Maizotaur's shoulders and back occasionally will attract nesting bird Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.minamai.name: Minamai
cobblemon.species.minamai.desc: Design, Name, Front sprite by Rattila Back sprite by KajiAtsui Overworld by Pantastic These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.marelstorm.name: Marelstorm
cobblemon.species.marelstorm.desc: Designed by Rattila Front and Back sprite by KajiAtsui Overworld by Pantastic These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.tormine.name: Tormine
cobblemon.species.tormine.desc: When threatened, Tormine swiftly ignites its coal stores and produces a powerful blast of heat and gas, hot enough to melt metal ore, to ward away its attacker.
cobblemon.species.sunnydra.name: Sunnydra
cobblemon.species.sunnydra.desc: On sunny days, they sit very still with their faces turned to the sun, soaking in the warmth. If disturbed, they become highly aggressive.
cobblemon.species.cryscross.name: Cryscross
cobblemon.species.cryscross.desc: The 4 points of their bodies can be very sharp to the touch. They normally drift around lazily, but large groups of them are sometimes blown through the air, causing many potentially dangerous cuts to anything in their path.
cobblemon.species.wolfman.name: Wolfman
cobblemon.species.wolfman.desc: G/S Betamon Front sprites by PansyGum Overworld Sprite by WolfPP Cry by Skurleton These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.warwolf.name: Warwolf
cobblemon.species.warwolf.desc: G/S Betamon Front sprites and Re-named by PansyGum Overworld Sprite by WolfPP These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.coralya.name: Coralya
cobblemon.species.coralya.desc: Coralya are only said to appear in water that is completely untainted by human kind. Often, reports of Coralya population booms will arise around the same time as Suicune sightings. When it leaves its home, it carries about a gallon of its home water with it, and is known to regularly spend time ridding the water of any impurities it may come into contact with on its travels.
cobblemon.species.dunymph.name: Dunymph
cobblemon.species.dunymph.desc: Designed, typed, and named by Jess Jackdaw Sprited by PansyGum Overworld Sprite by WolfPP These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.dunrago.name: Dunrago
cobblemon.species.dunrago.desc: Designed, typed, and named by Jess Jackdaw Design modified and Sprited by PansyGum Overworld Sprite by WolfPP These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.titaneon.name: Titaneon
cobblemon.species.titaneon.desc: Titaneon came from an anonymous 'leak' of new Eeveelutions that were supposedly going to be in Sword+Shield and has been submitted to the Fakemon Festival Pack by PansyGum. These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack.
cobblemon.species.galeon.name: Galeon
cobblemon.species.trantima.name: Trantima
cobblemon.species.trantima.desc: Designed and sprited by Mechamudskipper This mon is free-to-use via the Fakemon Festival Pack! Please ensure you assign credit properly.
cobblemon.species.gireamer.name: Gireamer
cobblemon.species.gireamer.desc: Designed and Named by Jess Jackdaw Sprited by PansyGum Overworld Sprite by WolfPP These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.nitmarig.name: Nitmarig
cobblemon.species.nitmarig.desc: Designed, typed, and named by Jess Jackdaw Sprited by PansyGum Overworld Sprite by WolfPP These designs/sprites are originally from the Fakemon Festival Pack. Evo line: Complete
cobblemon.species.moosid.name: Moosid
cobblemon.species.moosid.desc: Moosid are rarely involved in the affairs of other Pokémon, preferring to keep to themselves. Notoriously aggressive, a Moosid will pursue any perceived threat or prey relentlessly, until either they fall, or it does.
cobblemon.species.egoelk.name: Egoelk
cobblemon.species.egoelk.desc: Egoelk are eternally calm, rarely seen to react to external provocation unless absolutely necessary. It is said that, if befriended, it is possible to see the future by looking through the space between its horns.
cobblemon.species.suprago.name: Suprago
cobblemon.species.suprago.desc: Suprago are often leaders of their communities. They have high moral values, and can often be found with a gaggle of smaller Pokémon in tow. Peaceful in nature, a Suprago will not attack unless it senses a threat to its charges.
cobblemon.species.timberry.name: Timberry
cobblemon.species.timberry.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.howliage.name: Howliage
cobblemon.species.howliage.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.botanine.name: Botanine
cobblemon.species.botanine.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.saurky.name: Saurky
cobblemon.species.saurky.desc: Occasionally, this Pokemon is distributed as a Starter for new trainers.
cobblemon.species.crestaka.name: Crestaka
cobblemon.species.crestaka.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.avipex.name: Avipex
cobblemon.species.avipex.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.bonfur.name: Bonfur
cobblemon.species.bonfur.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.tindursa.name: Tindursa
cobblemon.species.tindursa.desc: Concept, design, name, type, and sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.sizzly.name: Sizzly
cobblemon.species.sizzly.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.lollybog.name: Lollybog
cobblemon.species.lollybog.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.brewtrid.name: Brewtrid
cobblemon.species.brewtrid.desc: Concept, design, name, type, and sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.forbiddron.name: Forbiddron
cobblemon.species.forbiddron.desc: Concept, design, name, type, and sprites by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.plushion.name: Plushion
cobblemon.species.plushion.desc: Because of its natural padding Plushion is unfazed by drops and falls, but will cry if its bow is torn. It enjoys snuggling next to trainers and will often get underfoot in an attempt to get closer.
cobblemon.species.rocotton.name: Rocotton

cobblemon.species.snagajin.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.burrb.name: Burrb
cobblemon.species.burrb.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.spikonsia.name: Spikonsia
cobblemon.species.spikonsia.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.varmot.name: Varmot
cobblemon.species.varmot.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Inomplete
cobblemon.species.trablur.name: Trablur
cobblemon.species.trablur.desc: Trablur avoid any place that has ever been a dwelling for humans. Some people say they have seen it in the distance while alone in the wilderness, but no tracks have ever been found.
cobblemon.species.vizitid.name: Vizitid
cobblemon.species.vizitid.desc: Vizitid are first noticed from very far away, but often go unrecognized. If one is seen again, on each subsequent viewing it will appear slightly closer, drawing nearer each time it is seen.
cobblemon.species.thissblade.name: Thissblade
cobblemon.species.thissblade.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Fakeathon 2020: Day 8 - UK ; Based on the thistle Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.snoblin.name: Snoblin
cobblemon.species.snoblin.desc: Snome live deep inside mountains and come to the surface at night to scavenge for food. Because they are not used to living with other creatures they inadvertently damage crops and other plant life with their natural icy bodies.
cobblemon.species.froll.name: Froll
cobblemon.species.froll.desc: Froll do not like to leave their lairs even in winter, instead sending out Snome to gather food. A single Froll may sit in the same spot for years at a time, growing ever larger.
cobblemon.species.flyrry.name: Flyrry
cobblemon.species.flyrry.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.wyntry.name: Wyntry
cobblemon.species.wyntry.desc: Concept, design, name, type, sprites, and dex entry by Magiscarf on Deviant Art Originally made for Magiscarf's Calta Dex. Evo Line: Complete
cobblemon.species.gardial.name: Gardial
cobblemon.species.gardial.desc: Travelers respectful of the forest may happen upon campfires made from Gardial's antlers. However, heedless travelers will find their fires repeatedly snuffed out.
cobblemon.species.appalyp.name: Appalyp
cobblemon.species.appalyp.desc: Appalyp bullies other sea creatures into giving it food by threatening to show them its face. However, no one has actually seen what its face looks like.
cobblemon.species.sycoral.name: Sycoral
cobblemon.species.sycoral.desc: Found only on deserted islands, Sycoral are hostile to anyone who sets foot in their territory. They will use countless tricks and curses to repel trespassers.
cobblemon.species.nemesusa.name: Nemesusa
cobblemon.species.nemesusa.desc: Fearsome and powerful, a single Revusa can sink a dozen ships. Those who have looked into its eyes have trouble speaking about their experience.
cobblemon.species.fencival.name: Fencival
cobblemon.species.fencival.desc: It leaps into battle, heedless of the danger, enjoying duels so much it will even delay a fight it could easily win. It will not attack an opponent whose back is turned.
cobblemon.species.enderbird.name: Enderbird
cobblemon.species.enderbird.desc: This Pokemon guards the edges of volcanic lakes, warning away other Pokemon who attempt to navigate across the surface. If its warning is ignored, it will attack.
cobblemon.species.lizquent.name: Lizquent
cobblemon.species.lizquent.desc: With its 'special' fist, it can punch at mach speeds and prefers one hit KOs. Despite the intimidating looks, it has a heart of gold.
cobblemon.species.cubtus.name: Cubtus
cobblemon.species.cubtus.desc: It's fur may look cuddly, but it's littered with many tiny thorns. However, they rather feel like little dull pin-pricks. The only thing that is not completely covered with thorns is the fur ruffle around the neck. It's rather soft.
cobblemon.species.paddorn.name: Paddorn
cobblemon.species.paddorn.desc: It could easily get along without water for several weeks. The less it has drunk, the sharper and harder the thorns are on its body.
cobblemon.species.maanzagaro.name: Maanzagaro
cobblemon.species.maanzagaro.desc: Grizzlash have affection for their friends and fury for their enemies. One fierce punch can lead to major injuries and destruction.
cobblemon.species.flambah.name: Flambah
cobblemon.species.flambah.desc: Its horns are constantly powered with a high heat from the inside, which, if wanted, can reach a temperature of up to 500°. It depends mostly on the mood.
cobblemon.species.ramligh.name: Ramligh
cobblemon.species.ramligh.desc: A lofty Pokémon, mostly because of it's wool's appearance. And because of that they mostly keep distance to water and rain.
cobblemon.species.vulkynamo.name: Vulkynamo
cobblemon.species.vulkynamo.desc: With it's unique hooves it can gallop over any lava or fire. The horns on it's head is charged with high electricity.
cobblemon.species.sharkin.name: Sharkin
cobblemon.species.sharkin.desc: It loves everything that has to do with water and splashes around in it. Sadly it isn't that flexible on land.
cobblemon.species.mawrine.name: Mawrine
cobblemon.species.mawrine.desc: Mawrine can produce an outstanding speed in the water, which is exactly the opposite on land. With it's echolocation, it can find prey underwater pretty quickly.
cobblemon.species.orcanfrak.name: Orcanfrak
cobblemon.species.orcanfrak.desc: The scales have developed into titanium-like metal during evolution. It resists almost every missile.
cobblemon.species.phasmox.name: Phasmox
cobblemon.species.teumixen.name: Teumixen
cobblemon.species.arfruff.name: Arfruff
cobblemon.species.laelupus.name: Laelupus
cobblemon.species.woodpeckit.name: Woodpeckit
cobblemon.species.woodpeckit.desc: Their nests consist mainly of nutshells. These are stuffed then with soft leaves for a comfortable hatching place.
cobblemon.species.peckster.name: Peckster
cobblemon.species.peckster.desc: They take Pidgeot as an idol and want to be like them. They practise their speed each day to get as fast as they are.
cobblemon.species.peckussion.name: Peckussion
cobblemon.species.peckussion.desc: Percudart are often taken as a quick detour for mail because they have an extemely keen sense of orientation. On confrontration, they dive towards you like a dart.
cobblemon.species.inferpillar.name: Inferpillar
cobblemon.species.inferpillar.desc: Once a year there is a hatcling ceremony of their kind, where forests are covered with red silk, where many eggs are hidden, waiting to hatch.
cobblemon.species.flamupet.name: Flamupet
cobblemon.species.flamupet.desc: As they fear the bird-like Pokémon and are not capable of running away from the predators, they tend to hide inside tree trunks until they would evolve.
cobblemon.species.flamothra.name: Flamothra
cobblemon.species.flamothra.desc: Etymology It's a play on the words 'Flame' and 'Mothra,' the latter of which is a reference to the giant moth-like creature from the Godzilla franchise
cobblemon.species.gnaphid.name: Gnaphid
cobblemon.species.locusteror.name: Locusteror
cobblemon.species.punling.name: Punling
cobblemon.species.floretaya.name: Floretaya
cobblemon.species.grandrupe.name: Grandrupe
cobblemon.species.happetite.name: Happetite
cobblemon.species.happetite.desc: Beneath its mask is a mouth that can stretch far, able to gobble down large meals without any effort.
cobblemon.species.serposter.name: Serposter
cobblemon.species.serposter.desc: It's head looks confusingly similar to a berry plant. Serposter uses this as a advantage to ambush prey or foes. Once caught, it is almost impossible to escape.
cobblemon.species.venobat.name: Venobat
cobblemon.species.noseferatu.name: Noseferatu
cobblemon.species.tryprock.name: Tryprock
cobblemon.species.tryprock.desc: Tryprock rarely venture into the open. Preferring the safety of underground environments, they feel most at ease amidst magnetic fields. Tryprock's glowing eye possesses a unique scanning ability, allowing it to detect and track magnetic fields, crucial for navigating the underground. These Pokémon sustain themselves by feeding on minerals found deep within the earth.
cobblemon.species.trypagnet.name: Trypagnet
cobblemon.species.trypagnet.desc: Despite its slow levitation, Trypagnet's increased size and magnetic prowess make it a force to be reckoned with in its underground habitat. These Pokémon are known to form intricate formations, working together to create magnetic fields that aid in navigation and communication across expansive subterranean networks. With its evolved capabilities, Trypagnet becomes a cornerstone of the underground ecosystem, contributing to the delicate balance of magnetic forces that shape its hidden world.
cobblemon.species.trypolisk.name: Trypolisk
cobblemon.species.trypolisk.desc: Its ragged, lengthy structure now houses multiple glowing eyes, each tuned to magnetic frequencies. Legends speak of Trypolisk's ability to decipher the earth's magnetic heartbeat, providing an uncanny sense of impending geological shifts. Trainers who encounter Trypolisk may unknowingly witness its influence, as the very ground seems to respond to the guardian's silent commands.
cobblemon.species.grimlin.name: Grimlin
cobblemon.species.grimlin.desc: Its oversized nose is a keen sensor, allowing it to sniff out potential prey or hidden treasures. Known for its aggressive nature, Grimlin is often spotted ambushing unsuspecting targets, stealing items, or playfully hurling rocks at travelers and reveling in their reactions.
cobblemon.species.grumpelstil.name: Grumpelstil
cobblemon.species.grumpelstil.desc: While they may seem festive, Grumpelstil is far from friendly. These Fire Trolls are notorious for their ambush tactics, lying in wait for unsuspecting prey and leaping out with surprising agility. Grumpelstil fiercely guards its territory, using a combination of intimidating postures and the flare of its fiery crown. Encroaching on its turf is ill-advised, as this Fire Troll Pokémon will not hesitate to defend its home with aggressive attacks. Trainers must exercise caution and respect boundar
cobblemon.species.oozegrim.name: Oozegrim
cobblemon.species.oozegrim.desc: Oozegrim is a master of stealth, often lurking beneath murky waters or hidden in the shadows of bridges. When a potential prey draws near, it pounces with surprising agility, using the element of surprise to overwhelm its target. Travelers are cautioned to exercise vigilance when traversing areas known to be inhabited by Oozegrim.
cobblemon.species.kopiuzu.name: Kopiuzu
cobblemon.species.kopiuzu.desc: They dine heartily on every possible cable to saturate themselves with the electricity. This often causes short circuits.
cobblemon.species.kebuzu.name: Kebuzu
cobblemon.species.purazu.name: Purazu
cobblemon.species.molore.name: Molore
cobblemon.species.molore.desc: Molore is known for its impressive burrowing skills, which it uses to navigate underground tunnels and create its own burrows. Its back is covered in spikey, electrically charged fur that can stun predators, making it difficult for them to attack. Despite its clumsy appearance, Molore is surprisingly quick and nimble when it needs to be, using its sharp claws to dig through soil and rocks.
cobblemon.species.minerolt.name: Minerolt
cobblemon.species.lunuhu.name: Lunuhu
cobblemon.species.oracowl.name: Oracowl
cobblemon.species.plagfowl.name: Plagfowl
cobblemon.species.plagfowl.desc: Plagfowl, a misunderstood Pokémon that is thought to bring misfortune and illness upon people, but is actually very harmless. It often lives alone because of that.
cobblemon.species.misphecy.name: Misphecy
cobblemon.species.piedow.name: Piedow
cobblemon.species.piedow.desc: The coat of Piedoe is very soft, dense and usually colored in a light brown tone. It often headbutts trees to strengthen it's head.
cobblemon.species.ceryneer.name: Ceryneer
cobblemon.species.kabby.name: Kabby
cobblemon.species.kabby.desc: It is covered with a thick layer of fur that defies almost any cold. Even newborns are very tough.
cobblemon.species.avalak.name: Avalak
cobblemon.species.olysosianbuneary.name: OlysosianBuneary
cobblemon.species.olysosianbuneary.desc: Having adapted to the cold harsh environment of the colder regions, they mostly use their frosty fur as a easy defense against their opponents.
cobblemon.species.olysosianlopunny.name: OlysosianLopunny
cobblemon.species.bubby.name: Bubby
cobblemon.species.bubby.desc: They can do almost nothing and are exposed to danger. As a result, they hide in the depths of the ocean.
cobblemon.species.coarsent.name: Coarsent
cobblemon.species.yinyan.name: Yinyan
cobblemon.species.yinyan.desc: To be told to be connected to the spiritual realm of the world. They have become extremely rare and are only found in very specific waters.
cobblemon.species.vivater.name: Vivater
cobblemon.species.vivater.desc: In their magnificent presence they roam the oceans, sing their leaf-shaped arms to move forward.
cobblemon.species.hydrona.name: Hydrona
cobblemon.species.squishid.name: Squishid
cobblemon.species.squishid.desc: Squishid's small size and white coloration help it to blend into the ocean floor, making it difficult to spot by predators. Its unique fins on its head enable it to swim quickly through the water and maneuver with ease. It's red-marked tentacles are often used to attract prey or ward off enemies. Squishid is known for its mischievous behavior and enjoys playing pranks on other Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.squidgeist.name: Squidgeist
cobblemon.species.squidgeist.desc: Squidgeist is the evolved form of Squishid. Its small size and white coloration help it blend into the ocean floor, but it has become more aggressive and territorial than its previous form. Its fins have grown longer and sharper, giving it greater speed and maneuverability. Squidgeist's red-marked tentacles are now more pronounced and intimidating, serving as a warning to potential predators. Its ghostly aura and spectral powers make it a fearsome and mysterious creature of the deep.
cobblemon.species.qoxipus.name: Qoxipus
cobblemon.species.qoxipus.desc: The outer layer of its skin is covered with a poisonous liquid coming from devouring the toxic silt of the waters. It wouldn't be wise to touch.
cobblemon.species.plaxista.name: Plaxista
cobblemon.species.lapili.name: Lapili
cobblemon.species.tasmon.name: Tasmon
cobblemon.species.tasmon.desc: Tasmon's small frame allows it to navigate urban environments with ease, darting through dark alleys and narrow streets. This mischievous pup has a penchant for playful deception, often hiding in the shadows and surprising unsuspecting passersby. Its oversized paws may seem clumsy, but they conceal sharp claws that Tasmon employs in its clever antics.
cobblemon.species.casanovil.name: Casanovil
cobblemon.species.casanovil.desc: In moonlit caves, Casanovil's slender silhouette becomes even more elusive. It is said that the echoes of its haunting laughter linger, serving as a warning to those who dare trust too easily in the dark. Casanovil's alluring gaze can captivate even the most resolute trainers. Once ensnared, victims often find themselves drawn into a web of deception, their trust shattered by the Deceitful Devil Pokémon's cunning maneuvers.
cobblemon.species.lavaleon.name: Lavaleon
cobblemon.species.chamelaze.name: Chamelaze
cobblemon.species.lavyrm.name: Lavyrm
cobblemon.species.lavyrm.desc: They have a very slimy layer of mucus around their body, which can get up to over 100°C. In oder to keep the mucus layer, they often swim in volcanoes and magma caverns.
cobblemon.species.maganon.name: Maganon
cobblemon.species.maganon.desc: Volcanon is a master of manipulating heat, often using it to melt rocks to slurp them up or to make nests. Its body is coated with a sticky, lava-like substance that is incredibly hot to the touch, making it dangerous to get too close to. Its eyes are a piercing orange color with fire-like streams emanating from them.
cobblemon.species.eruptinon.name: Eruptinon
cobblemon.species.eruptinon.desc: As Eruptinon grows and matures, it spends more time deep in the heart of volcanoes, basking in the intense heat and absorbing the energy of the molten rock around it. Its rocky skin acts as a natural shield, protecting it from the searing heat of the magma and allowing it to move through the fiery depths with ease. Eruptinon's powerful cannon-like head and fiery eyes strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to challenge it.
cobblemon.species.tortorge.name: Tortorge
cobblemon.species.tortorge.desc: The steel forge atop its shell blazes with the intensity of a forge at full operation, emitting molten steel that can leave scorching burns on its opponents. Despite its fearsome appearance, Tortorge is a gentle giant, utilizing its molten steel attacks only as a last resort.
cobblemon.species.alphayena.name: Alphayena
cobblemon.species.pepstep.name: Pepstep
cobblemon.species.pepstep.desc: Pepstep, the Pepper Lizard Pokemon. Pepstep's tail is reminiscent of a pepper, and it uses it to attract prey. It is said that the more vibrant the colors on its tail, the spicier its fire breath becomes. Its flexible legs allow it to climb even the steepest of cliffs, and its sharp claws make it a formidable opponent in battle. Despite its small size, Pepstep has a fiery spirit and never backs down from a challenge. Pepstep is commonly found in warm, rocky areas, such as deserts or volcanic re
cobblemon.species.devilance.name: Devilance
cobblemon.species.devilance.desc: Devilance, the Firearm Tail Pokemon. Devilance stands upright on its hind legs, ready to strike with its powerful arms and sharp claws. Its horns have grown even larger, and it can launch them like missiles to take down even the toughest opponents. Its fiery breath is hotter than ever, and it can now use its tail as a weapon, delivering powerful blows to its foes. Despite its fierce appearance, Devilance is a loyal companion to those it trusts, and it will go to great lengths to protect its trai
cobblemon.species.twoghast.name: Twoghast
cobblemon.species.twoghast.desc: It has been told that breaking a urn would cause years of misfortune. Souls of Pokemon and Human are apperently trapped inside of it and fused to one Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.forcaken.name: Forcaken
cobblemon.species.olysosianscroul.name: OlysosianScroul
cobblemon.species.olysosianscroul.desc: Scroul is a mischievous and curious Pokémon, known to wander around ancient ruins and libraries in search of ancient scrolls to play with. It often uses its clamps to hold onto and carry multiple scrolls at once, and it has been known to swap the contents of different scrolls just for fun. Despite its playful nature, Scroul can be quite protective of the scrolls it considers its own and will fiercely defend them from anyone who tries to take them away.
cobblemon.species.scrolock.name: Scrolock
cobblemon.species.scrolock.desc: Scrolock is known for its eerie presence, often appearing in dark, abandoned areas where it likes to haunt unsuspecting travelers. It can also use its paper arms to grab onto its opponents and drain their energy, making it a formidable opponent in battle.
cobblemon.species.skarawel.name: Skarawel
cobblemon.species.skarawel.desc: Skarawel, the Golden Beetle Pokémon. Skarawel is often mistaken for jewelry due to its shimmering, golden body. It is found in the deserts and tombs where it nests inside walls. Although it may seem harmless, its swarms can cause significant damage to wooden structures.
cobblemon.species.traplat.name: Traplat
cobblemon.species.traplat.desc: It burrows itself into the ground, leaving only its sturdy trap visible. When a threat approaches, the trap's retractable spikes will shoot up, providing an effective defense mechanism for Traplat. Its preferred habitats are rocky terrains, desert temples, and ruins. Traplat's red marking, which runs along the length of its body, is a warning sign to potential predators that it is not an easy target. In the wild, Traplat can often be found living in desert ruins or underground caverns, where i
cobblemon.species.trapolem.name: Trapolem
cobblemon.species.allnown.name: Allnown
cobblemon.species.allnown.desc: It appeared as the maker of the Unown and stores all their knowledge that they learn outside like an encyclopedia. It uses these to communicate with humans.
cobblemon.species.mageleon.name: Mageleon
cobblemon.species.chereon.name: Chereon
cobblemon.species.rustank.name: Rustank
cobblemon.species.rustank.desc: Its stubborn nature is matched only by its steely resolve, and it is said that nothing can stand in its way when it sets its mind to a task. The rust-colored metal of its body is constantly heated by the coals and firestones it consumes, and its eyes glow yellow from the intense heat. Rustank's ears, tail, and mane are made of pipes that can unleash hot steam or smoke, and it can use the openings on its abdomen and legs to release bursts of scorching heat.
cobblemon.species.steamare.name: Steamare
cobblemon.species.steamare.desc: It is said that this mechanical creature gained sentience after being built by a group of engineers. Steamare is feared by those who cross its path, as it is fiercely protective of the factories it calls home. This Pokémon is known to be very selective about its trainers, only allowing those it trusts to ride on its back. It feeds on coal, firestones, and gasoline to fuel its powerful engine, and it can withstand incredible amounts of heat and pressure.
cobblemon.species.artikit.name: Artikit
cobblemon.species.sabretal.name: Sabretal
cobblemon.species.solsaur.name: Solsaur
cobblemon.species.spinerno.name: Spinerno
cobblemon.species.olysosianskorupi.name: OlysosianSkorupi
cobblemon.species.olysosiandrapion.name: OlysosianDrapion
cobblemon.species.snugub.name: Snugub
cobblemon.species.plushug.name: Plushug
cobblemon.species.draconaut.name: Draconaut
cobblemon.species.draconaut.desc: Draconaut hatchlings are born from comet eggs that crash-land on Earth. They spend their early days floating around in search of food, using their powerful feet and hand flames to propel themselves through the air. Despite their small size, they are highly intelligent and possess a strong connection to the cosmos.
cobblemon.species.nebulazer.name: Nebulazer
cobblemon.species.velocidron.name: Velocidron
cobblemon.species.cupidove.name: Cupidove
cobblemon.species.kismean.name: Kismean
cobblemon.species.kryuu.name: Kryuu
cobblemon.species.kryuu.desc: The body temperature is absolutely frigid. It#s scales are impossible to touch, as it immediately turns unfortunate souls to ice.
cobblemon.species.kryoalis.name: Kryoalis
cobblemon.species.kryoalis.desc: In the stillness of the night, this guardian serpent graces the skies, leaving behind a mesmerizing aurora spectacle that captivates all who witness it. As it soars through the heavens, its scales emit an otherworldly glow, creating an enchanting dance of lights that mirrors the beauty of the northern lights. Many ancient tales speak of Kryoalis guiding lost souls with its soothing glow, ensuring they find their way through the vast, snow-covered landscapes.
cobblemon.species.phyuu.name: Phyuu
cobblemon.species.phyuu.desc: It is always born from the ashes instead from an normal egg. Throughout the life it always carries the ashes around until it evolves.
cobblemon.species.phosos.name: Phosos
cobblemon.species.phosos.desc: Its wings are said to possess the colors of the rainbow, and it is revered for its ability to heal and soothe with its mystical fire. Legends tell of its appearance being an omen of hope during times of crisis, as it descends from the skies to aid those in need.
cobblemon.species.anyuu.name: Anyuu
cobblemon.species.anufelis.name: Anufelis
cobblemon.species.anufelis.desc: Legends speak of Anufelis guiding lost souls to their resting place or even back to life. Trainers brave the treacherous sandstorms of the Infernal Dunes in search of its temple, but few return, and the whereabouts of the Guardian remain a mystery.
cobblemon.species.kaisaos.name: Kaisaos
cobblemon.species.kaisaos.desc: It's core is pulsating with deranged energy, glitching everything around itself into a disorted mess. It's mere presence is a threat to the universe.
cobblemon.species.monokron.name: Monokron
cobblemon.species.monokron.desc: It's energy source streams from it's back. The environment around itself disorts into very simplified geometric shapes. The colours evaporate and everything becomes one.
cobblemon.species.klepeck.name: Klepeck
cobblemon.species.klepeck.desc: It is attracted to shiny objects, often collecting them in its nest. This little trickster is quick-witted and swift in flight, making it a challenge for Trainers to catch. It enjoys taunting other Pokémon and people, showcasing its intelligence by imitating various sounds it hears in its surroundings.
cobblemon.species.magusong.name: Magusong
cobblemon.species.yukibi.name: Yukibi
cobblemon.species.yukiku.name: Yukiku
cobblemon.species.safrion.name: Safrion
cobblemon.species.saffry.name: Saffry
cobblemon.species.nagamufin.name: Nagamufin
cobblemon.species.nagamufin.desc: Legend has it that anyone who gazes directly into its eyes is instantly paralyzed. To avoid this, Nagamufin often keeps its eyes hidden, but it can use them to sense the emotions and intentions of others, allowing it to anticipate and playfully prank them.
cobblemon.species.mediva.name: Mediva
cobblemon.species.ladivy.name: Ladivy
cobblemon.species.terrino.name: Terrino
cobblemon.species.mermana.name: Mermana
cobblemon.species.fabumera.name: Fabumera
cobblemon.species.dideep.name: Dideep
cobblemon.species.searkat.name: Searkat
cobblemon.species.mosaile.name: Mosaile
cobblemon.species.krokoblok.name: Krokoblok
cobblemon.species.mosalegod.name: Mosalegod
cobblemon.species.flufflet.name: Flufflet
cobblemon.species.chrysow.name: Chrysow
cobblemon.species.worrym.name: Worrym
cobblemon.species.sangorko.name: Sangorko
cobblemon.species.vesitanchespin.name: VesitanChespin
cobblemon.species.vesitanchespin.desc: Es ist sehr schläfrig. Wenn es träumt, kann es für kurze Zeit in die Zukunft schauen.
cobblemon.species.vesitanquilladin.name: VesitanQuilladin
cobblemon.species.vesitanquilladin.desc: Die Krone auf seinem Kopf schützt es vor Ablenkungen, sodass es in Ruhe zur jeder Zeit meditieren kann. Das Auge auf dem Bauch dient zur Abschreckung.
cobblemon.species.vesitanchesnaught.name: VesitanChesnaught
cobblemon.species.vesitanchesnaught.desc: Meditation hat diesem Pokémon erlaubt in seinen Träumen durch Zeit und Raum zu reisen. Man sagt es hat schon alles gesehen.
cobblemon.species.vesitanfennekin.name: VesitanFennekin
cobblemon.species.vesitanfennekin.desc: Anstelle eines Snacks kaut es unterwegs auf einem Knochen herum. Knochensammeln ist seine größte Leidenschaft.
cobblemon.species.vesitanbraixen.name: VesitanBraixen
cobblemon.species.vesitanbraixen.desc: In seinem Schweif steckt ein Knochen, den es bei Bedarf zum Kampf einsetzt, um mehr Knochen zu sammeln.
cobblemon.species.vesitandelphox.name: VesitanDelphox
cobblemon.species.vesitandelphox.desc: Stolz präsentiert dieses Pokémon die Knochen seiner Gegner, die es als Schweif hinterher zieht.
cobblemon.species.vesitanfroakie.name: VesitanFroakie
cobblemon.species.vesitanfroakie.desc: Wenn sich dieses Pokémon bedroht fühlt, sondert es ein Gift ab, was schmerzt wie tausend Grad heiße Flammen.
cobblemon.species.vesitanfrogadier.name: VesitanFrogadier
cobblemon.species.vesitanfrogadier.desc: Es ist unglaublich agil und schnell. Bei seiner Jagd auf Gegner spuckt es kleine Feuerbälle auf sie, für einen gerösteten Snack.
cobblemon.species.vesitangreninja.name: VesitanGreninja
cobblemon.species.vesitangreninja.desc: Kaum hat man es erspäht, verschwindet es auch schon wieder. Alles was man sieht ist das Lichtbild seiner Flamme, die an Sternschnuppen erinnert.
cobblemon.species.vesitanscatterbug.name: VesitanScatterbug
cobblemon.species.vesitanscatterbug.desc: Es reguliert seine Körpertemperatur mit dem Puder, das seinen Körper bedeckt, und kommt deswegen in jedem Klima und jeder Region zurecht.
cobblemon.species.vesitanspewpa.name: VesitanSpewpa
cobblemon.species.vesitanspewpa.desc: Es lebt versteckt im schattigen Dickicht. Wird es von einem Feind angegriffen, stellt es sein Fell zur Abschreckung zu scharfen Spitzen auf.
cobblemon.species.vesitanvivillon.name: VesitanVivillon
cobblemon.species.vesitanvivillon.desc: Vivillon kommen weltweit mit den unterschiedlichsten Flügelmusterungen vor. In Vesita entwickelte es heilende Kräfte.
cobblemon.species.vesitanflabebe.name: VesitanFlabebe
cobblemon.species.vesitanflabebe.desc: Hat es eine Blume gefunden, die ihm gefällt, lebt es sein Leben lang in Symbiose mit ihr. Es lässt sich unbekümmert vom Wind treiben.
cobblemon.species.vesitanfloette.name: VesitanFloette
cobblemon.species.vesitanfloette.desc: Es fliegt auf Wiesen umher und kümmert sich um welkende Blumen. Es setzt deren geheime Kräfte frei und nutzt diese zum Kämpfen.
cobblemon.species.vesitanflorges.name: VesitanFlorges
cobblemon.species.vesitanflorges.desc: Wunderschöne Blumengärten sind sein Revier. Sollte sich jemand ungewollt nähern, setzt es ein tödliches Giftgas frei.
cobblemon.species.vesitanskiddo.name: VesitanSkiddo
cobblemon.species.vesitanskiddo.desc: Man sagt, es sei eines der ersten Pokémon, die mit Menschen zusammengelebt haben. Es ist sehr ruhig und friedfertig.
cobblemon.species.vesitangogoat.name: VesitanGogoat
cobblemon.species.vesitangogoat.desc: Durch ihr sehr robustes Fell können sie ganze Gebirgszüge unbeschadet herunterrollen. Der Aufstieg dauert allerdings ewig.
cobblemon.species.vesitanspritzee.name: VesitanSpritzee
cobblemon.species.vesitanspritzee.desc: Der von ihm verströmte Duft verzückt jeden, der ihn riecht. Es benutzt ihn um seine Gegner kurzzeitig zu kontrollieren.
cobblemon.species.vesitanaromatisse.name: VesitanAromatisse
cobblemon.species.vesitanaromatisse.desc: Wie Pilzsporen breitet sich der vor ihm versprühte Duft im Körper des Gegners aus. Wenige Sekunden später werden sie zu willenlosen Sklaven.
cobblemon.species.vesitanswirlix.name: VesitanSwirlix
cobblemon.species.vesitanswirlix.desc: Es stößt weiße Fäden aus, die so süß und klebrig wie Zuckerwatte sind, sich jedoch in Sekunden entzünden lassen.
cobblemon.species.vesitanslurpuff.name: VesitanSlurpuff
cobblemon.species.vesitanslurpuff.desc: Die Flamme auf seinem Kopf kann bis zu 685°C heiß werden. Es hilft deshalb oft in Konditoreien aus.
cobblemon.species.vesitaninkay.name: VesitanInkay
cobblemon.species.vesitaninkay.desc: Mit den blinkenden Punkten auf seinem Körper raubt es Gegnern den Kampfeswillen. Es nutzt diese Gelegenheit, um sich zu verstecken.
cobblemon.species.vesitanmalamar.name: VesitanMalamar
cobblemon.species.vesitanmalamar.desc: Mit seinen hypnotischen Kräften lockt es Gegner an, hält sie mit den Tentakeln an seinem Kopf fest und zersetzt sie dann mit Verdauungssekret.
cobblemon.species.vesitanbinacle.name: VesitanBinacle
cobblemon.species.vesitanbinacle.desc: Bithora bewohnen jeweils zu zweit einen Felsen. Entzweien sie sich im Streit, sucht sich eines der beiden einen neuen Felsen als Unterkunft.
cobblemon.species.vesitanbarbaracle.name: VesitanBarbaracle
cobblemon.species.vesitanbarbaracle.desc: Arme und Beine verfügen über eigene Gehirne, was ihnen relative Bewegungsfreiheit gewährt. Sie ordnen sich jedoch zumeist den Befehlen des Kopfes unter.
cobblemon.species.vesitanskrelp.name: VesitanSkrelp
cobblemon.species.vesitanskrelp.desc: Als verfaulter Seetang getarnt, lauert es auf Beute und bespritzt alles und jeden, der sich ahnungslos nähert, mit flüssigem Gift, bevor es ihm den Rest gibt.
cobblemon.species.vesitandragalge.name: VesitanDragalge
cobblemon.species.vesitandragalge.desc: Es heißt, dass die Besatzung von Schiffen, die sich in Tandraks Hoheitsgebiet begeben, nicht mehr lebend zurückkehrt.
cobblemon.species.vesitanclauncher.name: VesitanClauncher
cobblemon.species.vesitanclauncher.desc: Durch körpereigene metallartige Absonderungen feuert es wie eine Pistole kleine Kügelchen ab, die aus kurzer Distanz selbst Felsen zerschmettern.
cobblemon.species.vesitanclawitzer.name: VesitanClawitzer
cobblemon.species.vesitanclawitzer.desc: Aus seinen gewaltigen Scheren feuert es riesige Stahlkugeln ab, die ganze Klippen zum Einsturz bringen können.
cobblemon.species.vesitanhelioptile.name: VesitanHelioptile
cobblemon.species.vesitanhelioptile.desc: Die Zellen der Hautlappen, die sich beidseitig an seinem Kopf befinden, erzeugen Strom, wenn sie von Sonnenstrahlen beschienen werden.
cobblemon.species.vesitanheliolisk.name: VesitanHeliolisk
cobblemon.species.vesitanheliolisk.desc: Die Strommenge, die ein Elezard mit ausgebreiteten Hautlappen durch Umwandlung von Sonnenstrahlen erzeugt, genügt zur Versorgung eines Wolkenkratzers.
cobblemon.species.vesitanhawlucha.name: VesitanHawlucha
cobblemon.species.vesitanhawlucha.desc: Ungeachtet seines kleinen Wuchses, erweist es sich, dank seiner Kampftechnik, gegenüber größeren Gegnern wie Machomei oder Hariyama als ebenbürtig.
cobblemon.species.vesitandedenne.name: VesitanDedenne
cobblemon.species.vesitandedenne.desc: Mit seinem Schwanz zapft es Lebenskraft von seinen Opfern ab, um Energie zu tanken, die es über seine Schnurrhaare wieder entlädt.
cobblemon.species.vesitangoomy.name: VesitanGoomy
cobblemon.species.vesitangoomy.desc: Sein Körper ist von einer schleimigen Schicht umhüllt, an der gegnerische Tritte und Schläge abgleiten, ohne Schaden anzurichten.
cobblemon.species.vesitansliggoo.name: VesitanSliggoo
cobblemon.species.vesitansliggoo.desc: Es verjagt Gegner durch Absonderung eines alles zersetzenden Schleims. Die zurückgebildeten Augäpfel des Pokémon gewähren ihm keine Sicht.
cobblemon.species.vesitangoodra.name: VesitanGoodra
cobblemon.species.vesitangoodra.desc: Es greift den Gegner mit ausfahrbaren Fühlern an. Aufgrund seiner Blindheit benutzt es diese ebenfalls zur Orientierung und Naruhngssuche.
cobblemon.species.vesitanbergmite.name: VesitanBergmite
cobblemon.species.vesitanbergmite.desc: Es wehrt gegnerische Angriffe mit seinem in Eis gehüllten Körper ab. Bruchstellen bessert es mit aus kalter Luft gewonnenem neuen Eis aus.
cobblemon.species.vesitanavalugg.name: VesitanAvalugg
cobblemon.species.vesitanavalugg.desc: Mit den zahlreichen Arktip auf seinem Rücken sieht es aus wie ein Flugzeugträger aus Eis.
cobblemon.species.vesitannoibat.name: VesitanNoibat
cobblemon.species.vesitannoibat.desc: Selbst ein gestandener Ringer geht bei den 200 000 Hz hohen Ultraschallwellen dieses Pokémon unweigerlich in die Knie.
cobblemon.species.vesitannoivern.name: VesitanNoivern
cobblemon.species.vesitannoivern.desc: Es fliegt in finsterer, mondloser Nacht umher und macht Jagd auf achtlose Beute. Ist bei Dunkelheit jedem Gegner überlegen.
cobblemon.species.herovor.name: Herovor
cobblemon.species.herovor.desc: Herovor mostly lives in the forest it was born in, which it is very protective of. As they grow, leaves sprout on their shells.
cobblemon.species.forestone.name: Forestone
cobblemon.species.forestone.desc: Forestone supports smaller Pokémon and helps grow wildlife in its habitat by spreading seeds that grow on its leaves.
cobblemon.species.mountree.name: Mountree
cobblemon.species.mountree.desc: Mountree guards its forest against any danger, willing to risk its life to help those in need. Its shell is as hard as granite.
cobblemon.species.purrlit.name: Purrlit
cobblemon.species.purrlit.desc: Purrlit are very playful Pokémon and they're easily distracted by the smallest things. One can tell how happy a Purrlit is by the warmth of his snout.
cobblemon.species.purryo.name: Purryo
cobblemon.species.purryo.desc: Purryo is a rapscallion among Pokémon, loving to cause mischief with other Purryo. Perhaps this is why it usually fears to evolve into the well-behaved Flearoe.
cobblemon.species.flearoe.name: Flearoe
cobblemon.species.flearoe.desc: Flearoe attacks by exhaling hot breath that singes its opponents. Its fur produces heat on its own and is sometimes used to produce winter clothes.
cobblemon.species.salatad.name: Salatad
cobblemon.species.salatad.desc: Salatad are born in small bodies of water and live there until they evolve. Their powerful tails make them excellent swimmers for escaping predators.
cobblemon.species.salanip.name: Salanip
cobblemon.species.salanip.desc: More adapted to land than its previous evolution, Salanip has developed sharper claws. Its poison sacs allow it to stun prey.
cobblemon.species.salaslam.name: Salaslam
cobblemon.species.salaslam.desc: This Pokémon can slug prey with its powerful arms and tail. Salaslam can excrete toxins through its mouth and skin.
cobblemon.species.hamstar.name: Hamstar
cobblemon.species.hamstar.desc: This Pokémon is a favored pet because of its soft fur and gentle nature. It has been said that touching the star on the back of a Hamstar will bring you good luck.
cobblemon.species.snuffuzz.name: Snuffuzz
cobblemon.species.snuffuzz.desc: Snuffuzz are known for their extremely soft fur. Bird Pokémon often collect their shed winter coats each spring for their nests.
cobblemon.species.budcherp.name: Budcherp
cobblemon.species.budcherp.desc: Budcherp are capable of limited human speech through mimicry, often speaking phrases to warn or alert people of potential nearby threats.
cobblemon.species.budsoar.name: Budsoar
cobblemon.species.budsoar.desc: Budsoar are watchful protectors of the forests, directing lost travelers to safety with their glowing feathers and warning them of any danger.
cobblemon.species.elecritter.name: Elecritter
cobblemon.species.elecritter.desc: Elecritter is a very agile Pokémon. They store static electricity in their fur as they run, which is released when irritated or frightened.
cobblemon.species.weashock.name: Weashock
cobblemon.species.weashock.desc: Weashock are more capable of controlling their electricity. They have sharp minds and use electricity to stimulate themselves for faster reflexes.
cobblemon.species.stickit.name: Stickit
cobblemon.species.stickit.desc: Stickit will burrow themselves underground near the roots of trees to resting. Their tough backs assist in defending against predators.
cobblemon.species.stickut.name: Stickut
cobblemon.species.stickut.desc: Only one Stickut inhabits each tree in the forest. If another Stickut appears, they'll fight to toss their opponent off. The victor stays while the loser seeks a new tree.
cobblemon.species.cheepip.name: Cheepip
cobblemon.species.cheepip.desc: Cheepip travel in large flocks. Sometimes there are such large amounts of them together that, when resting, they make can make entire rock faces look covered in grass.
cobblemon.species.aeroma.name: Aeroma
cobblemon.species.aeroma.desc: Although big, Aeroma is known to be gentle and caring companions. Their voices have therapeutic power, and their songs brighten even the dullest gardens.
cobblemon.species.lavenseed.name: Lavenseed
cobblemon.species.lavenseed.desc: Lavenseed spends most of their day basking in sunlight for necessary nutrients. They are attracted to kind people, though large crowds may scare them away.
cobblemon.species.lavenbelle.name: Lavenbelle
cobblemon.species.lavenbelle.desc: Lavenbelle emanate an aroma from their skin. Because of this, their fallen petals are often used in perfumes and aromatherapy.
cobblemon.species.lavenrina.name: Lavenrina
cobblemon.species.lavenrina.desc: Lavenrina are graceful and agile. They give off a soothing aroma as they dance ballet, being famous for their many ballet shows around Rikoto.
cobblemon.species.moonky.name: Moonky
cobblemon.species.moonky.desc: Moonky can be difficult to train due to their rambunctious nature. They're said to have come from the moon ages ago.
cobblemon.species.lunape.name: Lunape
cobblemon.species.lunape.desc: Lunape are mischievous ones, often using their psychic powers to play tricks on others. Their antics especially worsens on the full moon.
cobblemon.species.tadart.name: Tadart
cobblemon.species.tadart.desc: Being small and fragile, Tadart uses its leaf to camouflage into the forest environment and keep itself afloat in the water to avoid predators.
cobblemon.species.dartoad.name: Dartoad
cobblemon.species.dartoad.desc: Dartoad make use of their leaf-like tail both for shielding itself from drying out on sunny days and as a water dish on rainy days.
cobblemon.species.doveheart.name: Doveheart
cobblemon.species.doveheart.desc: It's said the very presence of a single Doveheart can calm even the tensest of situations. If both a male and a female appear, mortal enemies can become lifelong allies.
cobblemon.species.spidox.name: Spidox
cobblemon.species.spidox.desc: A single bite from Spidox can cause nausea and drowsiness for several hours. They will often attempt to web whatever they bite, regardless of size.
cobblemon.species.widox.name: Widox
cobblemon.species.widox.desc: Despite the stigma and fear surrounding them, Widox venom was a key research material in creating the first Antidotes and Full Heals.
cobblemon.species.glowig.name: Glowig
cobblemon.species.glowig.desc: Glowig live in dark forests, with a main diet of leaves. Their glow, while essential for their sight in the dark, makes them easy picking for Flying-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.glocoon.name: Glocoon
cobblemon.species.glocoon.desc: Glocoon covers their glowing spots with leaves to avoid detection. When they are spotted by predators, they blind them with a sudden flash of light.
cobblemon.species.glowing.name: Glowing
cobblemon.species.glowing.desc: Glowing can generate light so strong that it can illuminate the forest as if no trees are blocking the sun. Travelers rely on them to find their way out of the forest.
cobblemon.species.stotox.name: Stotox
cobblemon.species.stotox.desc: Hikers and tourists sometimes come back after a mountainous walk feeling dizzy and faint. This is due to them stepping on a Stotox's poisonous spike.
cobblemon.species.bouldox.name: Bouldox
cobblemon.species.bouldox.desc: Bouldox's spikes are coated in a powerful poison that affects the nervous system. A single touch of these spikes can paralyze a person for hours.
cobblemon.species.crystox.name: Crystox
cobblemon.species.crystox.desc: Despite their appearance, Crystox are entirely organic Pokémon. Their crystals are actually crystallized poison, and their toxicity is not weakened in this state.
cobblemon.species.jumple.name: Jumple
cobblemon.species.jumple.desc: Some Jumple can jump a hundred times higher than themselves. However, they are easily blown away by the wind and end up miles away from the forests where they live.
cobblemon.species.casspring.name: Casspring
cobblemon.species.casspring.desc: Casspring's legs act like springs, rendering them capable of jumping very high. It is often for people to be startled when they land from the sky out of nowhere.
cobblemon.species.flowby.name: Flowby
cobblemon.species.flowby.desc: Although small and light, Flowby can use its control over the wind to create strong breezes that are capable of lifting an adult off their feet.
cobblemon.species.nimblow.name: Nimblow
cobblemon.species.nimblow.desc: Because Nimblow's bodies mostly consist of water vapor, they shrink during droughts and grow during rainy seasons.
cobblemon.species.cirribus.name: Cirribus
cobblemon.species.cirribus.desc: Cirribus live very far up in the atmosphere. On rare occasions, masses of Cirribus would join together to form massive storm clouds capable of great devastation.
cobblemon.species.pixwee.name: Pixwee
cobblemon.species.pixwee.desc: It's said that seeing Pixwee while lost in the woods grants you luck to find your way out. This myth persists as Pixwee continues to make their home near human settlements.
cobblemon.species.pixilily.name: Pixilily
cobblemon.species.pixilily.desc: A tale in Rikoto is that if you catch a Pixilily, they'll grant you a wish. This is derived from records of grateful Pixilily who gather berries and objects for their trainers.
cobblemon.species.ugling.name: Ugling
cobblemon.species.ugling.desc: Due to their undeveloped wings, Ugling are unable to fly. On the other hand, they're very skilled swimmers, able to dive for over 10 minutes for food.
cobblemon.species.swellegant.name: Swellegant
cobblemon.species.swellegant.desc: Even though they are one of the most beautiful Pokémon in Rikoto, Swellegant are extremely vain. They spend most of their time staring at their reflections in ponds.
cobblemon.species.angling.name: Angling
cobblemon.species.angling.desc: Angling are especially small among Water-type Pokémon. By using their cute eyes as a defense mechanism, they convince predators to hunt for other Pokémon instead.
cobblemon.species.angelish.name: Angelish
cobblemon.species.angelish.desc: Known as the 'Jewel of the Open Sea', Angelish love to swim in the ocean. They fall sick and become dull-colored when kept in an aquarium or other enclosed areas.
cobblemon.species.angelight.name: Angelight
cobblemon.species.angelight.desc: Angelight are considered one of the most beautiful Pokémon in the oceans of Rikoto, and yet they do not actively look down on other Pokémon for not being as beautiful.
cobblemon.species.rubbunny.name: Rubbunny
cobblemon.species.rubbunny.desc: Rubbunny are capable of extreme feats of agility, ricocheting between foes with incredible force. Myths say that they can jump to the moon and bounce back.
cobblemon.species.aquad.name: Aquad
cobblemon.species.aquad.desc: Aquad often swim against river currents to train their muscles. They swish their strong tails to help themselves keep steady.
cobblemon.species.smaqua.name: Smaqua
cobblemon.species.smaqua.desc: Smaqua train by standing on rocks in the center of whitewater rapids, avoiding and smashing any obstacles that may wash down the river.
cobblemon.species.vennap.name: Vennap
cobblemon.species.vennap.desc: Vennap excretes a sweet, honey-like scent to attract prey. As they get close enough, Vennap spits sticky goo onto the prey and traps them, allowing for no escape.
cobblemon.species.monstrap.name: Monstrap
cobblemon.species.monstrap.desc: Monstrap is an extremely cunning predator. Scientists have discovered that their existence pre-dates even some extinct, fossilized Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.lophug.name: Lophug
cobblemon.species.lophug.desc: Lophug's ears give off a unique chemical when wrapped around a person or another Pokémon, relieving pain and causing wounds to heal faster.
cobblemon.species.beopup.name: Beopup
cobblemon.species.beopup.desc: Beopup hunt in packs, in every pack there's an Alpha. To be Alpha they must know a certain move, if another Beopup learns that move, it can compete for the role of Alpha.
cobblemon.species.werehide.name: Werehide
